(transconductance) 基础指标 Core metrics 栅压变一点，漏电流跟着变多少：ΔID/ΔVGS，单位 S。 How much drain current changes per small change in gate voltage: ΔID/ΔVGS, in siemens. 实际含义 What it is gm = ∂ID/∂VGS，在固定 VDS 的偏置点上取。它是晶体管把输入电压信号转换成输出电流信号的“放大倍率”。 gm = ∂ID/∂VGS at a fixed VDS bias point. It is the factor by which the transistor converts an input voltage signal into an output current signal. 表征什么 What it tells you 器件对输入信号的响应强度，决定放大器的增益、带宽和输入参考噪声。 How strongly the device responds to an input signal; it sets amplifier gain, bandwidth and input-referred noise. 数值越大 / 越小意味着什么 Bigger vs. smaller 越大越好：同样电流下 gm 越大，增益越高、速度越快、折算到输入的噪声越小。但 gm 本身随电流上升，所以单看 gm 没有意义，要看 gm/ID。 Larger is better: at the same current, higher gm means more gain, more speed and less input-referred noise. But gm rises with current, so gm alone means little; look at gm/ID. 打个比方 Analogy 像水龙头的灵敏度：把手转一点点，水流变化多少。灵敏的龙头 gm 大。 Like the sensitivity of a faucet: turn the handle a little, how much does the flow change? A sensitive faucet has high gm. 怎么测 How it is measured 扫 ID–VGS 曲线后对 VGS 求导；高频下用 S 参数转 Y 参数，取 Re(Y21)。求导会放大噪声，要平滑或用细步长、多次平均。 Sweep ID–VGS and differentiate; at high frequency convert S- to Y-parameters and take Re(Y21). Differentiation amplifies noise, so smooth or use fine steps and averaging. 相关： Related: gm/ID gm/ID gds 与 ro gds and ro gm/gds gm/gds 在指南中：
模拟器件的四大指标是 gm/ID、gm/gds、fT 和 AVT
 → In the guide: 
The four main analog device metrics are gm/ID, gm/gds, fT and AVT
 → gm/ID（跨导效率） gm/ID (transconductance efficiency) 基础指标 Core metrics 每 1 A 电流能换来多少 gm，单位 S/A 或 1/V。模拟设计的“油耗”指标。 How much gm each ampere of current buys, in S/A (1/V). Analog design's fuel-efficiency number. 实际含义 What it is gm 除以漏电流 ID。它只取决于器件处于哪个反型程度，和 W 基本无关，所以能把不同尺寸的器件放在同一张图上比较。 gm divided by drain current. It depends mainly on the inversion level, not on W, so devices of different sizes can be compared on one chart. 表征什么 What it tells you 偏置点的位置：弱反型、中等反型还是强反型；也就是功耗效率和速度之间的取舍。 Where the bias point sits — weak, moderate or strong inversion — and therefore the trade-off between power efficiency and speed. 数值越大 / 越小意味着什么 Bigger vs. smaller 越大越省电：约 25–35 S/A 时在弱反型区，效率最高但速度慢；约 5 S/A 以下在强反型区，速度快但费电。常用的折中在 10–15 S/A。理论上限约为 1/(n·kT/q)，室温下大约 30–40 S/A。 Higher means more power-efficient: around 25–35 S/A is weak inversion, most efficient but slow; below about 5 S/A is strong inversion, fast but power-hungry. The usual compromise is 10–15 S/A. The theoretical ceiling is about 1/(n·kT/q), roughly 30–40 S/A at room temperature. 打个比方 Analogy 像汽车的油耗：同样一升油（电流）跑多远（gm）。低速档省油但慢，高速档快但费油。 Like fuel economy: how far (gm) each liter of fuel (current) takes you. Low gear saves fuel but is slow; high gear is fast but thirsty. 怎么测 How it is measured 从 ID–VGS 扫描计算 gm 再除以 ID，画 gm/ID 对 ID/(W/L) 的曲线；每个 L 一条。Murmann 的 gm/ID 工具包可直接在开源 PDK 上生成。 Compute gm from an ID–VGS sweep and divide by ID; plot gm/ID against ID/(W/L), one curve per L. Murmann's gm/ID kit generates these on open PDKs. 典型数值 Typical numbers 【常识】弱反型上限约 1/(n·UT)，n≈1.2–1.5，UT≈26 mV。 [Textbook] Weak-inversion ceiling ≈ 1/(n·UT), with n ≈ 1.2–1.5 and UT ≈ 26 mV. 相关： Related: 反型系数 IC 与弱/中等/强反型 Inversion coefficient gm gm fT fT 在指南中：
模拟器件的四大指标是 gm/ID、gm/gds、fT 和 AVT
 → In the guide: 
The four main analog device metrics are gm/ID, gm/gds, fT and AVT
 → 反型系数 IC 与弱/中等/强反型 Inversion coefficient (IC) and weak/moderate/strong inversion 基础指标 Core metrics 把偏置点归一化的刻度：IC<0.1 弱反型，0.1–10 中等反型，>10 强反型。 A normalized scale for the bias point: IC < 0.1 weak, 0.1–10 moderate, > 10 strong inversion. 实际含义 What it is IC = ID / (I_spec·W/L)，I_spec 是工艺相关的特征电流（EKV 模型）。它衡量沟道里反型电荷有多“满”。 IC = ID / (I_spec·W/L), where I_spec is a process-dependent specific current (EKV model). It measures how ‘full’ the channel inversion charge is. 表征什么 What it tells you 器件工作在哪种导电机制：弱反型以扩散电流为主（指数关系），强反型以漂移电流为主（平方律或速度饱和）。 Which conduction regime the device is in: diffusion-dominated in weak inversion (exponential), drift-dominated in strong inversion (square law or velocity saturation). 数值越大 / 越小意味着什么 Bigger vs. smaller IC 越小，gm/ID 越高但 fT 越低、器件越大；IC 越大则相反。最佳折中通常在中等反型。 Lower IC gives higher gm/ID but lower fT and bigger devices; higher IC does the opposite. The best compromise is usually moderate inversion. 打个比方 Analogy 像水管的开度：开一条缝（弱反型）水流细但每份压力都用得很省；全开（强反型）流量大但浪费也大。 Like how far a valve is open: a crack (weak inversion) gives a thin but efficient flow; wide open (strong inversion) gives big flow with more waste. 怎么测 How it is measured 从 gm/ID–ID 曲线拟合出 I_spec 和斜率因子 n，再换算 IC。 Fit I_spec and slope factor n from the gm/ID–ID curve, then convert to IC. 相关： Related: gm/ID gm/ID fT fT 在指南中：
模拟器件的四大指标是 gm/ID、gm/gds、fT 和 AVT
 → In the guide: 
The four main analog device metrics are gm/ID, gm/gds, fT and AVT
 → fT（特征频率） fT (transition frequency) 基础指标 Core metrics 电流增益降到 1 时的频率，≈ gm/(2π·Cgg)；衡量器件本征速度。 The frequency at which current gain falls to 1, ≈ gm/(2π·Cgg); the device's intrinsic speed. 实际含义 What it is 短路电流增益 |h21| 等于 1 时的频率。近似为 gm 除以 2π 倍的总栅电容 Cgg。 The frequency where short-circuit current gain |h21| reaches 1. Approximately gm divided by 2π times total gate capacitance Cgg. 表征什么 What it tells you 器件“推得动”自己栅电容的能力，即本征带宽。 How well the device can drive its own gate capacitance — its intrinsic bandwidth. 数值越大 / 越小意味着什么 Bigger vs. smaller 越大越快。但 fT 随 gm/ID 下降而上升，所以要说“在某个 gm/ID 下的 fT”才有可比性。电路实际可用带宽通常只有 fT 的十分之一左右。 Higher is faster. fT rises as gm/ID falls, so compare ‘fT at a given gm/ID’. Usable circuit bandwidth is typically about a tenth of fT. 打个比方 Analogy 像一个人能多快把自己的行李搬上车：力气（gm）大、行李（电容）轻，就快。 Like how fast someone can load their own luggage: more strength (gm) and lighter bags (capacitance) mean faster. 怎么测 How it is measured 片上 S 参数测量（去嵌入焊盘和走线后）转 h21，外推到 0 dB；或用 DC 的 gm 加 CV 测的 Cgg 估算。 On-wafer S-parameters, de-embedded, converted to h21 and extrapolated to 0 dB; or estimate from DC gm and CV-measured Cgg. 典型数值 Typical numbers 14 nm FinFET 报道的 fT 约 314/285 GHz（n/p），见指南 §3。 14 nm FinFET reports fT ≈ 314/285 GHz (n/p); see guide §3. 相关： Related: fmax fmax Cgg / Cgd Cgg / Cgd gm/ID gm/ID 在指南中：
模拟器件的四大指标是 gm/ID、gm/gds、fT 和 AVT
 → In the guide: 
The four main analog device metrics are gm/ID, gm/gds, fT and AVT
 → fmax（最高振荡频率） fmax (maximum oscillation frequency) 基础指标 Core metrics 功率增益降到 1 的频率；比 fT 更受栅电阻和 Cgd 影响。 Frequency where power gain falls to 1; more sensitive to gate resistance and Cgd than fT. 实际含义 What it is 单向功率增益（Mason U）等于 1 时的频率，是器件还能做功率放大的最高频率。 The frequency where unilateral power gain (Mason's U) equals 1 — the highest frequency at which the device can still amplify power. 表征什么 What it tells you 射频能力，同时反映栅电阻 Rg、Cgd 和输出电导这些寄生。 RF capability, reflecting parasitics such as gate resistance Rg, Cgd and output conductance. 数值越大 / 越小意味着什么 Bigger vs. smaller 越大越适合射频。fmax 远低于 fT 通常说明栅电阻太大，GAA 的多层金属栅要特别注意这一点。 Higher suits RF better. fmax far below fT usually means gate resistance is too high — a watch item for GAA's multi-layer metal gates. 打个比方 Analogy fT 是发动机转速，fmax 是车真正跑出来的速度；传动（栅电阻）漏得多，再高转速也白搭。 fT is engine RPM; fmax is the speed the car actually reaches. If the drivetrain (gate resistance) leaks, high RPM is wasted. 怎么测 How it is measured S 参数计算 Mason U 或 MAG，外推到 0 dB。版图上双侧栅接触能明显改善。 Compute Mason's U or MAG from S-parameters and extrapolate to 0 dB. Double-sided gate contacts improve it markedly. 相关： Related: fT fT S 参数与去嵌入 S-parameters and de-embedding 在指南中：
模拟器件的四大指标是 gm/ID、gm/gds、fT 和 AVT
 → In the guide: 
The four main analog device metrics are gm/ID, gm/gds, fT and AVT
 → Cgg / Cgd（栅电容） Cgg / Cgd (gate capacitances) 基础指标 Core metrics Cgg 是栅极看进去的总电容；Cgd 是栅到漏的跨接电容，会被 Miller 效应放大。 Cgg is total capacitance seen at the gate; Cgd is gate-to-drain, multiplied by the Miller effect. 实际含义 What it is Cgg = Cgs + Cgd + Cgb（含本征和寄生部分）。Cgd 跨接在输入和输出之间。 Cgg = Cgs + Cgd + Cgb, intrinsic plus parasitic. Cgd bridges input and output. 表征什么 What it tells you 驱动这个器件要付出的“负载”，决定速度和功耗；Cgd 还决定反馈和稳定性。 The load you pay to drive the device, setting speed and power; Cgd also sets feedback and stability. 数值越大 / 越小意味着什么 Bigger vs. smaller 越小越好。Cgd/Cgg 比值高说明寄生占比大，fT 和 fmax 都会受损；GAA 的内侧墙和栅到源漏电容是重点。 Smaller is better. A high Cgd/Cgg ratio means parasitics dominate and hurt both fT and fmax; GAA inner spacers and gate-to-S/D capacitance are the focus. 打个比方 Analogy 像推车上的货：Cgg 是总重量，Cgd 是一根把你和后面车厢连起来的绳子，你一动它反拽你。 Like cargo on a cart: Cgg is the total weight; Cgd is a rope tying you to the car behind, pulling back whenever you move. 怎么测 How it is measured CV 测量（分离 Cgs/Cgd 需要分端口连接），或从 S 参数转 Y 参数取虚部。 CV measurements (split terminals to separate Cgs/Cgd), or from Y-parameter imaginary parts. 相关： Related: fT fT fmax fmax 在指南中：
模拟器件的四大指标是 gm/ID、gm/gds、fT 和 AVT
 → In the guide: 
The four main analog device metrics are gm/ID, gm/gds, fT and AVT
 → VT（阈值电压） VT (threshold voltage) 基础指标 Core metrics 器件开始导通的栅压；模拟里更关心它的失配和随温度、应力的漂移。 The gate voltage where the device turns on; analog cares more about its mismatch and drift with temperature and stress. 实际含义 What it is 沟道表面形成反型层所需的栅压，常用恒流法或最大跨导外推法定义。 The gate voltage needed to form the inversion layer, defined by constant-current or max-gm extrapolation. 表征什么 What it tells you 开关点和偏置点的位置，以及多 VT 选项带来的设计自由度。 The switching point and bias position, and the design freedom of multi-VT options. 数值越大 / 越小意味着什么 Bigger vs. smaller 对模拟而言绝对值不是关键，关键是两个“相同”器件之间的 ΔVT（失配）越小越好，以及 VT 随温度变化可预测。低 VT 给更多电压裕量但漏电大。 For analog the absolute value matters less than ΔVT between two ‘identical’ devices (smaller is better) and a predictable temperature drift. Low VT gives more headroom but more leakage. 打个比方 Analogy 像门槛高度：门槛高低本身好商量，但一对双胞胎门槛高度不一样，就是麻烦。 Like a doorstep height: the height itself is negotiable, but two ‘twin’ doors with different steps are a problem. 怎么测 How it is measured ID–VGS 扫描后用恒流法或 gm 最大点线性外推法提取；失配需要成对器件统计。 Extract from ID–VGS by constant current or max-gm linear extrapolation; mismatch needs paired-device statistics. 相关： Related: AVT / Aβ AVT / Aβ ZTC ZTC 失配 Mismatch 在指南中：
模拟器件看"偏置点上的小信号比值"，而不是 Ion/Ioff
 → In the guide: 
Analog devices are judged by "small-signal ratios at a bias point", not Ion/Ioff
 → SS（亚阈值摆幅） SS (subthreshold swing) 基础指标 Core metrics 亚阈值区电流增大 10 倍需要的栅压，室温极限约 60 mV/dec。 Gate voltage needed for a 10× current increase below threshold; ~60 mV/dec limit at room temperature. 实际含义 What it is SS = dVGS/d(log10 ID)，在弱反型区量。 SS = dVGS/d(log10 ID), measured in weak inversion. 表征什么 What it tells you 栅极静电控制的好坏，也直接对应弱反型 gm/ID 的上限。 Quality of gate electrostatic control; it directly sets the weak-inversion gm/ID ceiling. 数值越大 / 越小意味着什么 Bigger vs. smaller 越小越好，越接近 60 mV/dec 越理想；SS 小 → 弱反型 gm/ID 高 → 低功耗模拟更有利。GAA 报道约 65 mV/dec。 Smaller is better, ideally near 60 mV/dec; low SS means higher weak-inversion gm/ID, good for low-power analog. GAA reports ≈ 65 mV/dec. 打个比方 Analogy 像音量旋钮的灵敏度：转一格就让声音大十倍，转的角度越小越灵。 Like a volume knob: the less you turn it for a 10× louder sound, the more sensitive it is. 怎么测 How it is measured ID–VGS 半对数图上取亚阈值段斜率的倒数。 Inverse slope of the subthreshold region on a semilog ID–VGS plot. 相关： Related: gm/ID gm/ID DIBL DIBL 在指南中：
Nanosheet/GAA：静电控制更好，难点转到寄生、热和无源器件
 → In the guide: 
Nanosheet/GAA: better electrostatics, with the hard problems shifting to parasitics, heat and passives
 → ZTC（零温度系数点） ZTC (zero-temperature-coefficient point) 基础指标 Core metrics 某个栅压下，电流几乎不随温度变化；可用作温度稳定的偏置点。 A gate voltage where current barely changes with temperature; a temperature-stable bias point. 实际含义 What it is 温度升高时 VT 下降（电流增加）而迁移率下降（电流减少），两者抵消的那个 VGS。 As temperature rises, VT falls (more current) while mobility falls (less current); ZTC is the VGS where they cancel. 表征什么 What it tells you 器件温度敏感性的平衡点。 The balance point of the device's temperature sensitivity. 数值越大 / 越小意味着什么 Bigger vs. smaller 偏置在 ZTC 附近，电流随温度变化最小；远离它则温漂大。imec 的 nanosheet 数据显示 25–200 °C 存在清晰的 ZTC。 Biasing near ZTC minimizes current drift with temperature; far from it, drift grows. imec nanosheet data show a clear ZTC from 25 to 200 °C. 打个比方 Analogy 像一杯冷热各半的水：一边升温一边降温，刚好温度不变。 Like mixing hot and cold water so the temperature stays the same. 怎么测 How it is measured 多个温度下测 ID–VGS，找各曲线的交点。 Measure ID–VGS at several temperatures and find where the curves cross. 相关： Related: VT VT 在指南中：
模拟器件的四大指标是 gm/ID、gm/gds、fT 和 AVT

 → Ion/Ioff 与 CV/I（逻辑指标） Ion/Ioff and CV/I (logic metrics) 基础指标 Core metrics 逻辑器件的核心指标：开态电流、关态漏电和门延迟；模拟器件不以它们为主。 Core logic metrics: on-current, off-leakage and gate delay; analog does not lead with them. 实际含义 What it is Ion 是 VGS=VDS=VDD 时的电流，Ioff 是 VGS=0 时的漏电，CV/I 近似一级门延迟。 Ion is current at VGS = VDS = VDD; Ioff is leakage at VGS = 0; CV/I approximates one gate delay. 表征什么 What it tells you 大信号开关的速度和静态功耗。 Large-signal switching speed and static power. 数值越大 / 越小意味着什么 Bigger vs. smaller Ion 越大越快，Ioff 越小越省电。但模拟器件工作在偏置点的小信号区，这两个数很少直接决定模拟性能。 Higher Ion is faster, lower Ioff saves power. But analog works in small-signal mode at a bias point, so these rarely decide analog performance directly. 打个比方 Analogy 逻辑器件是电灯开关，只关心开得快、关得严；模拟器件是调光旋钮，关心中间每一档有多稳。 A logic device is a light switch — fast on, fully off; an analog device is a dimmer — every position in between must be stable. 怎么测 How it is measured 在 VDD 下测 ID–VGS 端点；CV/I 用环形振荡器或 Ieff 估算。 ID–VGS endpoints at VDD; CV/I from ring oscillators or Ieff. 相关： Related: Drive / 驱动电流 Drive current 门延迟 CV/I Gate delay CV/I gm/ID gm/ID gm/gds gm/gds 在指南中：

 → 增益与输出 Gain & output 7 DIBL（漏致势垒降低） DIBL (drain-induced barrier lowering) 增益与输出 Gain & output 漏压升高把源端势垒“压低”，VT 随 VDS 下降；单位 mV/V。 Raising drain voltage lowers the source barrier so VT falls with VDS; in mV/V. 实际含义 What it is 短沟道里漏极电场穿透到源端，降低载流子注入势垒。用 ΔVT/ΔVDS 量化。 In short channels the drain field reaches the source and lowers the injection barrier. Quantified as ΔVT/ΔVDS. 表征什么 What it tells you 栅对沟道的控制力有多强，也是输出电导 gds 的主要来源之一。 How firmly the gate controls the channel; also a main source of output conductance gds. 数值越大 / 越小意味着什么 Bigger vs. smaller 越小越好。DIBL 大意味着漏压会“插手”电流，gds 变大、本征增益变低。FinFET 和 GAA 的 DIBL 明显低于平面器件，这是它们增益更高的原因。 Smaller is better. Large DIBL lets the drain ‘interfere’ with current, raising gds and cutting intrinsic gain. FinFET and GAA have much lower DIBL than planar, which is why their gain is higher. 打个比方 Analogy 像隔壁房间太吵：本该只听老师（栅）的话，结果被窗外（漏）的声音带偏。 Like a noisy room next door: the class should only follow the teacher (gate) but gets pulled off by the noise outside (drain). 怎么测 How it is measured 在低 VDS 和高 VDS 下各提一次 VT，相减除以 VDS 差。 Extract VT at low and high VDS; divide the difference by the VDS step. 典型数值 Typical numbers 45 nm 级 FinFET 原型报道 DIBL 约 46/44 mV/V，见指南 §1。 A 45 nm-class FinFET prototype reported DIBL ≈ 46/44 mV/V; see guide §1. 相关： Related: gds 与 ro gds and ro gm/gds gm/gds CLM CLM 在指南中：

 → gds 与 ro（输出电导与输出电阻） gds and ro (output conductance and resistance) 增益与输出 Gain & output 漏压变一点，电流跟着变多少：∂ID/∂VDS；倒数 ro 是输出电阻。 How much current changes per small change in drain voltage: ∂ID/∂VDS; its inverse ro is output resistance. 实际含义 What it is 饱和区里理想器件的电流不随 VDS 变，实际会因为沟道长度调制和 DIBL 缓慢上升，这个斜率就是 gds。 In saturation an ideal device's current is independent of VDS; in reality CLM and DIBL make it creep up, and that slope is gds. 表征什么 What it tells you 器件作为电流源有多“硬”。 How ‘stiff’ the device is as a current source. 数值越大 / 越小意味着什么 Bigger vs. smaller gds 越小（ro 越大）越好：电流源越理想，放大器增益越高。gds 随 L 加长而变小，这就是模拟喜欢长沟道的原因。 Smaller gds (larger ro) is better: a more ideal current source and more amplifier gain. gds falls as L grows, which is why analog likes long channels. 打个比方 Analogy 像一根软管接水龙头：管子越硬，下游压力怎么变流量都不变；管子软，压力一变流量就跟着变。 Like a hose: a stiff one keeps the flow constant whatever the downstream pressure; a soft one lets flow follow the pressure. 怎么测 How it is measured ID–VDS 扫描后对 VDS 求导。要注意自热会让 DC 测的 gds 偏小甚至为负，高频下要用 S 参数（Re(Y22)）测。 Differentiate an ID–VDS sweep. Self-heating can make DC gds look small or even negative; measure at high frequency with S-parameters (Re(Y22)). 相关： Related: gm/gds gm/gds VEA VEA CLM CLM 自热 Self-heating and thermal resistance Rth 在指南中：

 → gm/gds（本征增益） gm/gds (intrinsic gain) 增益与输出 Gain & output 单个晶体管能给出的最大电压增益：gm 乘 ro，常用 dB 表示。 The maximum voltage gain a single transistor can give: gm times ro, often in dB. 实际含义 What it is 把输入电压变成电流（gm），再由自己的输出电阻（ro）变回电压，两者相乘就是一个器件在理想负载下的电压放大倍数。 The device turns input voltage into current (gm), and its own output resistance (ro) turns it back into voltage; the product is its voltage gain with an ideal load. 表征什么 What it tells you 器件作为放大器的“天花板”，决定一级放大最多能放大多少倍、需要几级或要不要 cascode。 The device's ceiling as an amplifier: how much one stage can amplify, and whether you need more stages or cascodes. 数值越大 / 越小意味着什么 Bigger vs. smaller 越大越好。20 倍约 26 dB，100 倍为 40 dB。它随 L 增大、随 gm/ID 增大而上升。从平面到 FinFET 本征增益提高约 2–10 倍；imec 研究用 nanosheet 约 46 dB（≈200 倍）。 Bigger is better: 20× ≈ 26 dB, 100× = 40 dB. It rises with longer L and higher gm/ID. Going from planar to FinFET raised intrinsic gain by about 2–10×; imec research nanosheets reach ≈ 46 dB (≈ 200×). 打个比方 Analogy 像杠杆：gm 是你使的力能撬动多少，ro 是支点有多稳；支点一晃（ro 小），力气再大也撬不起来。 Like a lever: gm is how much your push moves, ro is how solid the pivot is; a wobbly pivot (low ro) wastes any push. 怎么测 How it is measured 同一偏置下分别提取 gm（ID–VGS）和 gds（ID–VDS）相除；画 gm/gds 对 gm/ID、每个 L 一条曲线。高频下用 Y21/Y22 避开自热。 Extract gm (ID–VGS) and gds (ID–VDS) at the same bias and divide; plot gm/gds versus gm/ID, one curve per L. Use Y21/Y22 at high frequency to avoid self-heating. 典型数值 Typical numbers Intel 22FFL 模拟器件 GM×Rout 47/54/60；GF 14 nm FinFET 约 40/34（n/p）；见指南 §3。 Intel 22FFL analog devices: GM×Rout 47/54/60; GF 14 nm FinFET ≈ 40/34 (n/p); see guide §3. 相关： Related: gm gm gds 与 ro gds and ro VEA VEA 叠栅 / 串联器件 Stacked gates / series devices Cascode 与 gain boosting Cascode and gain boosting 在指南中：

 → VEA（Early 电压） VEA (Early voltage) 增益与输出 Gain & output ID/gds，单位 V；把输出电阻折算成一个电压，越大越像理想电流源。 ID/gds in volts; output resistance expressed as a voltage — larger is closer to an ideal current source. 实际含义 What it is 饱和区 ID–VDS 曲线向负 VDS 方向外推与横轴相交处的电压绝对值，等于 ID/gds。 The magnitude where saturation ID–VDS lines, extrapolated backward, cross the VDS axis; equals ID/gds. 表征什么 What it tells you 与电流无关的输出电阻品质；本征增益 ≈ (gm/ID)·VEA。 Current-independent output-resistance quality; intrinsic gain ≈ (gm/ID)·VEA. 数值越大 / 越小意味着什么 Bigger vs. smaller 越大越好，并大致与 L 成正比（常用 VEA/L 表示单位长度的 Early 电压）。imec nanosheet 研究器件报道约 30 V。 Larger is better and roughly proportional to L (often quoted as VEA/L). imec research nanosheets report about 30 V. 打个比方 Analogy 像弹簧的硬度系数：把输出电阻这件事换成一个和电流大小无关的数，便于比较。 Like a spring constant: it turns output resistance into one number independent of current, easy to compare. 怎么测 How it is measured VEA = ID/gds，在指定 VDS 和过驱动下取；也可用外推法。 VEA = ID/gds at specified VDS and overdrive; or by extrapolation. 相关： Related: gds 与 ro gds and ro gm/gds gm/gds CLM CLM 在指南中：

 → CLM（沟道长度调制） CLM (channel-length modulation) 增益与输出 Gain & output VDS 增大时夹断点向源端移动，有效沟道变短，电流上升。 As VDS rises the pinch-off point moves toward the source, shortening the effective channel and raising current. 实际含义 What it is 饱和区夹断区随 VDS 变宽，有效 L 变短。 In saturation the pinch-off region widens with VDS, shortening effective L. 表征什么 What it tells you 输出电导 gds 的经典来源之一（另一个是 DIBL）。 One classic source of gds (the other is DIBL). 数值越大 / 越小意味着什么 Bigger vs. smaller 影响越小越好；L 越长，同样的夹断长度变化占比越小，所以长沟道 gds 小。 Less is better; with longer L the same pinch-off change is a smaller fraction, so long channels have lower gds. 打个比方 Analogy 像排队：队尾（漏端）被挤掉几个人，长队几乎没感觉，短队就明显变短。 Like a queue losing a few people at the end: a long queue barely notices; a short one shrinks noticeably. 怎么测 How it is measured 通过不同 L 的 gds 对比分离 CLM 与 DIBL 的贡献。 Separate CLM from DIBL by comparing gds across several L. 相关： Related: gds 与 ro gds and ro DIBL DIBL 在指南中：

 → Halo / pocket 注入 Halo / pocket implant 增益与输出 Gain & output 在源漏两端打的高掺杂“口袋”，抑制短沟道效应，但伤害长沟道模拟器件的输出电阻。 Heavily doped pockets at source and drain that suppress short-channel effects but hurt long-channel analog output resistance. 实际含义 What it is 逻辑工艺为控制最小 L 器件的 VT 滚降而加的倾斜注入。 An angled implant added in logic processes to control VT roll-off at minimum L. 表征什么 What it tells you 逻辑优化与模拟需求冲突的典型例子。 A textbook case of logic optimization conflicting with analog needs. 数值越大 / 越小意味着什么 Bigger vs. smaller 对模拟：halo 越重，长器件的 gds 越大、出现长沟道 DIBL 和反向短沟道效应，本征增益降低。FinFET/GAA 的无掺杂沟道基本不再依赖 halo。 For analog, heavier halo means higher gds in long devices, long-channel DIBL and reverse short-channel effect, and lower gain. Undoped FinFET/GAA channels largely drop the halo. 打个比方 Analogy 像为了防短跑选手抢跑在起点加的护栏，对长跑选手反而是绊脚石。 Like hurdles added at the start to stop sprinters jumping the gun — a trip hazard for distance runners. 怎么测 How it is measured 比较有无 halo 或不同 L 下的 VT–L 和 gds–L 曲线。 Compare VT–L and gds–L curves with and without halo or across L. 相关： Related: gds 与 ro gds and ro DIBL DIBL 在指南中：

 → 电压裕量（headroom） Voltage headroom 增益与输出 Gain & output 电源电压里扣掉每个器件维持饱和所需的电压后，留给信号摆动的空间。 What remains of the supply for signal swing after each device takes the voltage it needs to stay saturated. 实际含义 What it is 每个堆叠的器件都要至少 VDS,sat（≈过驱动电压）才能保持饱和。 Each stacked device needs at least VDS,sat (≈ overdrive) to stay in saturation. 表征什么 What it tells you 能堆几层 cascode、信号能摆多大。 How many cascodes you can stack and how large the signal can swing. 数值越大 / 越小意味着什么 Bigger vs. smaller 越大越好。先进节点 VDD 不到 1 V，裕量很紧，cascode 和叠栅都受限，所以模拟常借用电压更高的 I/O 器件。 More is better. Advanced nodes run below 1 V, so headroom is tight, limiting cascodes and stacks; analog often borrows higher-voltage I/O devices. 打个比方 Analogy 像一层楼的净高：每层楼板（器件）都占高度，楼板越多留给人（信号）的空间越小。 Like ceiling height: every floor slab (device) takes height, leaving less room for people (signal). 怎么测 How it is measured 从 ID–VDS 找饱和点，或由 gm/ID 估算 VDS,sat ≈ 2/(gm/ID)。 Find the saturation knee on ID–VDS, or estimate VDS,sat ≈ 2/(gm/ID). 相关： Related: Cascode 与 gain boosting Cascode and gain boosting 厚氧 I/O 器件 Thick-oxide I/O devices 在指南中：

 → 噪声 Noise 8 Flicker noise（1/f 噪声，闪烁噪声） Flicker noise (1/f noise) 噪声 Noise 低频噪声，功率谱按 1/f 规律分布，频率越低噪声越大；来自栅氧中陷阱随机抓放载流子。 Low-frequency noise whose power density scales as 1/f — the lower the frequency, the larger the noise; caused by oxide traps randomly capturing and releasing carriers. 实际含义 What it is 电流里一种低频“抖动”，频率越低越强。主流解释是栅介质里的陷阱抓住、放掉沟道载流子，让载流子数目（以及迁移率）随机起伏。 A low-frequency jitter in the current that grows stronger at lower frequency. The main explanation is gate-dielectric traps capturing and releasing channel carriers, so carrier number (and mobility) fluctuate randomly. 表征什么 What it tells you 栅介质和界面的质量（陷阱密度），以及对低频精密电路（基准、传感器、ADC、VCO 相位噪声）的影响。 Gate-dielectric and interface quality (trap density), and its impact on low-frequency precision circuits — references, sensors, ADCs and VCO phase noise. 数值越大 / 越小意味着什么 Bigger vs. smaller 越小越好。常用归一化值 SVG·W·L（V²·µm²/Hz）比较不同器件。面积越大噪声越小（与 1/(WL) 成正比）。GF 14 nm FinFET 为 17/35，28 nm 平面为 171/106 fV²·µm²/Hz（n/p）；imec 测得 nanosheet 与同栅叠层的平面器件相当。 Smaller is better. Compare devices with area-normalized SVG·W·L (V²·µm²/Hz); noise falls as 1/(WL). GF 14 nm FinFET: 17/35 vs 28 nm planar 171/106 fV²·µm²/Hz (n/p); imec found nanosheets comparable to planar devices with the same gate stack. 打个比方 Analogy 像收音机的嗡嗡低频杂音：信号越慢（低频），杂音越显眼；它不是电路坏了，是材料里“小陷阱”在随机开关。 Like a low hum on a radio: the slower the signal, the more the hum shows. Nothing is broken — tiny traps in the material are flipping at random. 怎么测 How it is measured 低频噪声分析仪（如 Keysight E4727A/B）配参数分析仪，片上测 SID（A²/Hz），常在 10 Hz–1 kHz、低 VDS 下测，多个器件做统计；用 SID/ID² 对 (gm/ID)² 的关系判断机制。 A low-frequency noise analyzer (e.g., Keysight E4727A/B) with a parameter analyzer measures SID (A²/Hz) on-wafer, usually 10 Hz–1 kHz at low VDS, over many devices; SID/ID² versus (gm/ID)² diagnoses the mechanism. 典型数值 Typical numbers 见指南 §4 的噪声数据表。 See the noise data table in guide §4. 相关： Related: SID / SVG SID / SVG ΔN 与 Δμ 模型 ΔN vs Δμ models 陷阱密度 N_OT / N_BT Trap density N_OT / N_BT RTN RTN 1/f 转角频率 1/f corner frequency 在指南中：

 → SID / SVG（噪声功率谱密度） SID / SVG (noise power spectral density) 噪声 Noise SID 是漏电流噪声谱（A²/Hz），SVG = SID/gm² 是折算到栅极的电压噪声谱（V²/Hz）。 SID is drain-current noise spectrum (A²/Hz); SVG = SID/gm² is the gate-referred voltage noise (V²/Hz). 实际含义 What it is 把噪声按频率分解后每赫兹的功率。折算到栅极后，可以直接和输入信号比大小。 Noise power per hertz of bandwidth. Referred to the gate, it compares directly with the input signal. 表征什么 What it tells you 器件本身有多“吵”，以及它对输入端精度的影响。 How noisy the device is and how it limits input-side precision. 数值越大 / 越小意味着什么 Bigger vs. smaller 越小越好。乘以面积 W·L 得到与尺寸无关的归一化值，才能跨工艺比较；√SVG 的单位是 V/√Hz。 Smaller is better. Multiply by W·L for a size-independent value to compare across processes; √SVG is in V/√Hz. 打个比方 Analogy 像称体重时秤上的晃动：SID 是秤读数的晃，SVG 是换算成“你身上多了多少斤”的晃。 Like a jittery bathroom scale: SID is the reading jitter, SVG is that jitter converted into ‘how many pounds on you’. 怎么测 How it is measured 用低噪声放大器和 FFT/频谱分析测 SID，再除以同一偏置下的 gm²。 Measure SID with a low-noise amplifier and FFT/spectrum analysis, then divide by gm² at the same bias. 相关： Related: Flicker noise Flicker noise gm gm 在指南中：

 → ΔN 与 Δμ 模型（McWhorter 与 Hooge） ΔN vs Δμ models (McWhorter vs Hooge) 噪声 Noise 1/f 噪声的两种解释：载流子数目涨落（陷阱，McWhorter）或迁移率涨落（Hooge）。 Two explanations of 1/f noise: carrier-number fluctuation (traps, McWhorter) or mobility fluctuation (Hooge). 实际含义 What it is ΔN 模型认为陷阱抓放改变载流子数；Δμ 模型认为晶格散射让迁移率起伏；相关 ΔN–Δμ 模型把两者结合。 The ΔN model says trapping changes carrier number; the Δμ model says lattice scattering makes mobility fluctuate; the correlated ΔN–Δμ model combines them. 表征什么 What it tells you 噪声的物理来源，决定该改栅介质还是改沟道。 The physical origin of the noise, telling you whether to fix the gate dielectric or the channel. 数值越大 / 越小意味着什么 Bigger vs. smaller 诊断方法：SID/ID² 曲线形状跟着 (gm/ID)² 走 → ΔN 主导；随 1/ID 下降 → Δμ 主导。先进节点 nMOS 多数是 ΔN 主导，pMOS 常需要相关项。 Diagnosis: if SID/ID² tracks (gm/ID)², ΔN dominates; if it falls as 1/ID, Δμ dominates. In advanced nodes nMOS is mostly ΔN-dominated; pMOS often needs the correlated term. 打个比方 Analogy 像判断车流慢是因为车少（数目）还是因为每辆车走走停停（迁移率）。 Like asking whether traffic is thin because there are fewer cars (number) or because each car keeps stopping (mobility). 怎么测 How it is measured 测一组 ID 下的 SID，画 SID/ID² 与 (gm/ID)² 对比；从 √SVG–VGT 直线的截距和斜率提取陷阱密度和散射系数。 Measure SID over a range of ID, compare SID/ID² with (gm/ID)²; extract trap density and scattering coefficient from the intercept and slope of √SVG versus VGT. 相关： Related: Flicker noise Flicker noise 陷阱密度 N_OT / N_BT Trap density N_OT / N_BT 在指南中：

 → RTN（随机电报噪声） RTN (random telegraph noise) 噪声 Noise 小器件里单个陷阱抓放造成的电流两态跳变；面积越小越明显。 Two-level current jumps from a single trap in small devices; worse as area shrinks. 实际含义 What it is 大器件里成千上万个陷阱叠加成平滑的 1/f；小器件里只有几个陷阱，就看得到一个个离散的跳变。 In large devices thousands of traps add up to smooth 1/f; in small devices only a few exist, so individual discrete jumps show up. 表征什么 What it tells you 器件到器件的噪声差异和偶发的大 ΔVT，是统计问题。 Device-to-device noise spread and occasional large ΔVT — a statistical problem. 数值越大 / 越小意味着什么 Bigger vs. smaller 幅度越小、出现器件比例越低越好。20 nm 栅长下有报道 ΔVth 超过 70 mV 的尾部；它会让“同样设计”的两个器件噪声差很多。 Smaller amplitude and fewer affected devices are better. At 20 nm gate length, tails above 70 mV ΔVth have been reported; two ‘identical’ devices can differ widely in noise. 打个比方 Analogy 像大合唱里某人偶尔咳嗽：人多时听不出来，只剩三个人唱时就非常明显。 Like someone coughing in a choir: lost in a crowd, glaring in a trio. 怎么测 How it is measured 时域测电流跳变，统计幅度和时间常数；大量器件做统计分布。 Record current in the time domain, extract amplitudes and time constants, and build statistics over many devices. 相关： Related: Flicker noise Flicker noise 失配 Mismatch 在指南中：

 → 热噪声与 γ Thermal noise and γ 噪声 Noise 沟道电阻里电子热运动产生的白噪声，SID = 4kT·γ·gm；γ 越大越吵。 White noise from thermal motion in the channel resistance, SID = 4kT·γ·gm; larger γ means noisier. 实际含义 What it is 与频率无关的噪声底。长沟道理论 γ = 2/3，短沟道器件会更大。 A frequency-independent noise floor. Long-channel theory gives γ = 2/3; short-channel devices are higher. 表征什么 What it tells you 高频和宽带电路（LNA、高速 ADC）的噪声底。 The noise floor for high-frequency and wideband circuits (LNAs, fast ADCs). 数值越大 / 越小意味着什么 Bigger vs. smaller γ 越小越好；输入参考热噪声 ≈ 4kT·γ/gm，所以 gm 越大噪声越小。 Smaller γ is better; input-referred thermal noise ≈ 4kT·γ/gm, so more gm means less noise. 打个比方 Analogy 像一杯热水分子的乱动：温度在，就一直有，和频率无关。 Like molecules jiggling in warm water: as long as there is temperature, it is there, at every frequency. 怎么测 How it is measured 高频噪声参数测量（噪声源 + 调谐器），得 NFmin、Rn 等；低频下被 1/f 噪声掩盖。 High-frequency noise-parameter measurements (noise source plus tuner) give NFmin, Rn, etc.; at low frequency 1/f noise masks it. 相关： Related: 1/f 转角频率 1/f corner frequency NFmin NFmin Flicker noise Flicker noise 在指南中：

 → NFmin（最小噪声系数） NFmin (minimum noise figure) 噪声 Noise 器件在最佳源阻抗下的最小噪声系数，射频低噪放大器的关键指标，单位 dB。 The device's noise figure at optimal source impedance; key for RF LNAs, in dB. 实际含义 What it is 输入信噪比与输出信噪比之比（dB），在最优匹配下取最小值。 Ratio of input to output SNR in dB, minimized at optimal matching. 表征什么 What it tells you 器件给信号加了多少噪声。 How much noise the device adds to a signal. 数值越大 / 越小意味着什么 Bigger vs. smaller 越小越好；0 dB 表示不加噪声。受 gm、γ、栅电阻影响。 Smaller is better; 0 dB means no added noise. Driven by gm, γ and gate resistance. 打个比方 Analogy 像复印机：每印一次，画面多少会变脏一点，NFmin 就是“最少会脏多少”。 Like a photocopier: every copy gets a bit dirtier; NFmin is the least dirt it can add. 怎么测 How it is measured 片上噪声参数测试系统，多阻抗点拟合。 On-wafer noise-parameter system, fitted over several source impedances. 相关： Related: 热噪声与 γ Thermal noise and γ fmax fmax 在指南中：

 → 匹配与版图 Matching & layout 5 失配（mismatch） Mismatch 匹配与版图 Matching & layout 两个设计完全相同的器件，实际参数的随机差异；精密模拟电路的主要误差来源。 Random differences between two identically designed devices; a main error source in precision analog. 实际含义 What it is 包括随机失配（掺杂、金属晶粒、线边粗糙度等）和系统失配（应力、梯度、版图环境不同）。 Includes random mismatch (dopants, metal grains, line-edge roughness) and systematic mismatch (stress, gradients, different layout surroundings). 表征什么 What it tells you 差分对失调、电流镜精度、DAC/ADC 线性度的极限。 The limit on differential-pair offset, current-mirror accuracy and DAC/ADC linearity. 数值越大 / 越小意味着什么 Bigger vs. smaller 越小越好；随机部分随 1/√(WL) 减小，靠加面积换；系统部分不随面积下降，要靠版图对称。 Smaller is better; the random part shrinks as 1/√(WL) with area; the systematic part does not, and needs symmetric layout. 打个比方 Analogy 像双胞胎的差别：基因一样（设计相同），还是会有细微不同；如果一个住在阳面一个住在阴面（版图环境不同），差别更大。 Like twins: same genes (same design) yet subtly different; raise one on the sunny side and one on the shady side (different layout surroundings) and the gap widens. 怎么测 How it is measured 成对器件阵列测 ΔVT、Δβ/β，统计标准差；用 Kelvin 连接避免串联电阻误差。 Measure ΔVT and Δβ/β on paired-device arrays and take standard deviations; use Kelvin connections to avoid series-resistance error. 相关： Related: AVT / Aβ AVT / Aβ Pelgrom 定律 Pelgrom's law LDE LDE 共质心与交叉指状版图 Common-centroid and interdigitated layout 在指南中：

 → Pelgrom 定律 Pelgrom's law 匹配与版图 Matching & layout 失配的标准差与器件面积的平方根成反比：σ(ΔVT) = AVT/√(WL)。 Mismatch standard deviation scales inversely with the square root of area: σ(ΔVT) = AVT/√(WL). 实际含义 What it is 1989 年 Pelgrom 提出的经验模型，描述随机失配随面积和距离的变化。 An empirical model proposed by Pelgrom in 1989 for how random mismatch varies with area and distance. 表征什么 What it tells you 精度和面积之间的换算关系。 The exchange rate between precision and area. 数值越大 / 越小意味着什么 Bigger vs. smaller 面积变 4 倍，失配只降一半，所以靠加面积提精度很“贵”。 Quadrupling area only halves mismatch, so buying precision with area is expensive. 打个比方 Analogy 像抛硬币：抛得越多（面积越大），正反比例越接近一半，但要误差减半得多抛 4 倍。 Like coin tossing: more tosses (more area) bring you closer to 50/50, but halving the error takes four times as many tosses. 怎么测 How it is measured 用多种 W×L 的成对器件测 σ(ΔVT)，对 1/√(WL) 作图，斜率就是 AVT。 Measure σ(ΔVT) on pairs of many W×L, plot against 1/√(WL); the slope is AVT. 相关： Related: AVT / Aβ AVT / Aβ 失配 Mismatch 在指南中：

 → LDE（版图相关效应：WPE、LOD、OSE） LDE (layout-dependent effects: WPE, LOD, OSE) 匹配与版图 Matching & layout 器件参数随它周围的版图环境变化：离阱边多远、有源区多长、邻居间距多大。 Device parameters that change with surrounding layout: distance to well edge, diffusion length, neighbor spacing. 实际含义 What it is WPE：注入在阱边散射，VT 变；LOD/STI 应力：有源区长度改变应力，迁移率变；OSE：有源区间距影响应力。 WPE: implant scattering at the well edge shifts VT; LOD/STI stress: diffusion length changes stress and mobility; OSE: diffusion spacing affects stress. 表征什么 What it tells you 系统失配和模型误差的主要来源。 A main source of systematic mismatch and model error. 数值越大 / 越小意味着什么 Bigger vs. smaller 效应越小、越可预测越好。WPE 报道 VT 偏移可达几到几十 mV；要求匹配器件的“邻居环境”完全一致。 Smaller and more predictable is better. WPE has been reported to shift VT by several to tens of mV; matched devices need identical surroundings. 打个比方 Analogy 像房子的价格不只看户型，还看楼层、朝向和邻居。 Like a home's price depending not just on floor plan but on floor, orientation and neighbors. 怎么测 How it is measured 专用测试结构：同一器件放在离阱边/有源区端不同距离处，测 VT 和 ID 变化；PDK 中以 LDE 参数进入模型。 Dedicated test structures place the same device at varied distances to well edges or diffusion ends and measure VT and ID shifts; PDKs model them as LDE parameters. 相关： Related: 失配 Mismatch 共质心与交叉指状版图 Common-centroid and interdigitated layout 在指南中：

 → 长沟道替代方案 Long-channel alternatives 3 叠栅 / 串联器件（stacked gates） Stacked gates / series devices 长沟道替代方案 Long-channel alternatives 把多个最小栅长器件串起来，当作一个长沟道器件用。 Several minimum-length devices in series, used as one long-channel device. 实际含义 What it is 先进节点只允许固定栅长和栅距，设计者把 N 个器件的栅连在一起、源漏串联，等效于 L 变成约 N 倍。 When only fixed gate length and pitch are allowed, designers tie N gates together with source/drain in series, emulating roughly N times the length. 表征什么 What it tells you 在没有真长沟道器件时提高 ro 和匹配的办法。 A way to raise ro and matching without a true long-channel device. 数值越大 / 越小意味着什么 Bigger vs. smaller 串得越多，gds 越小、匹配越好，但内部节点电容、面积和寄生增加，版图后仿真结果常和版图前不一致。目前没有找到与单个长 L 器件的公开定量对比。 More in series gives lower gds and better matching, but internal-node capacitance, area and parasitics grow, and post-layout often disagrees with pre-layout.  → Cascode 与 gain boosting Cascode and gain boosting 长沟道替代方案 Long-channel alternatives 在器件上再叠一个器件屏蔽漏压变化，输出电阻乘上约 gm·ro 倍；gain boosting 再用一个辅助放大器，把输出电阻再乘上该放大器的增益。 Stack another device to shield drain-voltage changes, multiplying output resistance by about gm·ro; gain boosting adds an auxiliary amplifier that multiplies it again by that amplifier's gain. 实际含义 What it is 电路级手段：上面的器件把下面器件的漏压“钉住”，于是下面器件的 gds 影响变小。 A circuit technique: the upper device pins the lower device's drain voltage, so the lower device's gds matters less. 表征什么 What it tells you 用电路换回器件本征增益的不足。 Recovering gain the devices no longer provide. 数值越大 / 越小意味着什么 Bigger vs. smaller 增益可以提高一个数量级以上，代价是要多占电压裕量和极点。 Gain can rise by an order of magnitude or more, at the cost of headroom and extra poles. 打个比方 Analogy 像在门外再加一道门：外面再吵，里面也安静了。 Like adding a second door: however loud outside, the room stays quiet. 怎么测 How it is measured 在电路测试结构上测输出电阻和增益；器件层面看每个器件的 gm/gds 和 VDS,sat。 Measure output resistance and gain on circuit test structures; at device level check each device's gm/gds and VDS,sat. 相关： Related: gm/gds gm/gds 电压裕量 Voltage headroom 叠栅 / 串联器件 Stacked gates / series devices 在指南中：

 → 速度与功耗：Drive 与 Cdyn Speed & power: drive and Cdyn 18 一句话： 速度看 τ ∝ C_load·V/Ieff ，功耗看 P = Cdyn·V²·f 。两条链共享一部分电容，并通过 V–F 曲线连在一起。下图的方框可以点，点了跳到对应词条。 In one line: speed follows τ ∝ C_load·V/Ieff ; power follows P = Cdyn·V²·f . The two chains share part of the capacitance and meet at the V–F curve. Boxes in the diagram link to their entries. ← 左右滑动看完整关系图 → ← Swipe sideways to see the whole diagram → 四个问题的直接回答 Four questions, answered directly Q1 “Drive 越大越好、Cdyn 越小越好，延迟就会降低”对吗？ Is it right that more drive and less Cdyn lower delay? 方向对，三点要补上。 比 Drive 要控制条件： 同一 Ioff、同一面积（栅距、鳍/片数）下比。否则降 VT 或加宽都能“买”到电流。 速度看的是 I/C 比，不是单独的 I 或 C。 靠加宽得来的电流会带来同比例的自身电容；只有导线和扇出负载占大头时，加宽才明显变快。所以工艺开发里常看的 “I-drive 对 C” 图，本质上在看 CV/I 这条斜率。 延迟里的 C 和 Cdyn 不是同一个数。 延迟看的是单条路径、单次翻转的负载电容 C_load；Cdyn 是整颗芯片按翻转概率加权的电容，还和所跑程序有关。降寄生电容两边都受益，但幅度不同。 The direction is right; three qualifications. Compare drive under controlled conditions: at the same Ioff and the same footprint (gate pitch, fin or sheet count). Otherwise lower VT or more width simply buys current. Speed is about the I/C ratio, not I or C alone. Current bought with width brings proportional self-capacitance; widening pays only when wire and fan-out load dominate. The familiar “I-drive versus C” plot is really reading the CV/I slope. The C in delay is not Cdyn. Delay uses the load capacitance of one path and one transition, C_load; Cdyn is the whole chip's capacitance weighted by switching probability, and it depends on the workload. Cutting parasitics helps both, by different amounts. Q2 Cdyn 和频率（effective frequency）是直接相连的吗？ Is Cdyn directly tied to (effective) frequency? 定义上不相连，实际上通过三条路连在一起。 Cdyn = (P − P_漏电)/(V²·f_eff) 已经把频率除掉了，理想情况下它不随频率变化。 共享电容（直接路径）： 如果降掉的电容在关键路径上（比如工艺上的低 k、空气侧墙），同电压下延迟直接变小、频率升高，而功耗基本不变（C 降、f 升相互抵消）。 功耗预算（间接路径）： 功耗受限的产品里 P 固定。Cdyn 降低后可以抬电压换频率，但要付 V² 的代价，所以频率收益只有 Cdyn 降幅的一部分： Δf/f ≈ −(ΔCdyn/Cdyn) / (1 + 2/s) ，其中 s = d ln f / d ln V 是 V–F 曲线的对数斜率。s≈1 时约为 1/3，s≈2 时约为 1/2（忽略漏电；漏电随电压上升会让收益更小）。【推断】 测量效应： Cdyn 要用 f_eff 计算。内存受限的程序在高频下有更多周期在等待，每周期的 Cdyn 反而下降；短路电流和毛刺也会让测得的 Cdyn 随电压、频率漂移。 公开例子：3 nm GAA 路径探索 PDK 上，空气侧墙使环振在等速度下有功功耗降 30%，在等功耗下频率只升 9%（Lee 等，IEEE Access 2022）。同一个改进，用功耗报和用频率报，数字差三倍左右。 Not by definition, but in practice through three routes. Cdyn = (P − P_leak)/(V²·f_eff) already divides out frequency, so ideally it does not change with f. Shared capacitance (direct route): if the capacitance removed sits on the critical path (process-level low-k, air spacers), delay drops at the same voltage and frequency rises while power stays roughly flat (less C, more f). Power budget (indirect route): in a power-limited product P is fixed. Lower Cdyn lets you raise voltage for frequency, but you pay V², so the frequency gain is a fraction of the Cdyn cut: Δf/f ≈ −(ΔCdyn/Cdyn) / (1 + 2/s) , where s = d ln f / d ln V is the log slope of the V–F curve. About 1/3 for s≈1, about 1/2 for s≈2 (ignoring leakage; leakage rising with voltage shrinks the gain further). [Inference] Measurement effects: compute Cdyn with f_eff. Memory-bound programs stall more cycles at high frequency, so Cdyn per cycle falls; short-circuit current and glitches also make measured Cdyn drift with V and f. A public example: on a 3 nm GAA path-finding PDK, an air spacer cut ring-oscillator active power by 30% at iso-speed but raised frequency by only 9% at iso-power (Lee et al., IEEE Access 2022). The same improvement reads about three times larger when quoted as power. Q3 Cdyn 越小越好、降电阻电容能提升 AC 性能，对吗？ Is smaller Cdyn always better, and does cutting R and C improve AC performance? 对一半：Cdyn 里只有 C，没有 R。 降 C（不伤 Drive）： 既提速又省电，是双赢。 降 R （接触电阻、源漏电阻、导线电阻、IR 压降）：提升 Drive 和速度，但不降 Cdyn。 “越小越好”有前提： 本征沟道电容 Cinv 是换来电流的“好电容”，减它会同时减电流；要减的是寄生部分（交叠/边缘、栅–接触、导线）。 R 和 C 常常互换： 加厚侧墙 C 降 R 升；接触做小 C 降 R 升。判断标准是 Ieff/C_load 或环振的“延迟对 Cdyn”是否净改善。 Half right: Cdyn contains C only, not R. Cutting C (without hurting drive): faster and lower power — a double win. Cutting R (contact, source/drain, wire resistance, IR drop): more drive and speed, but no change in Cdyn. “Smaller is better” has a condition: the intrinsic channel capacitance Cinv is the “good” capacitance that buys current; cutting it cuts current. Cut the parasitic parts (overlap/fringe, gate-to-contact, wires). R and C often trade: thicker spacers cut C but raise R; smaller contacts cut C but raise R. The test is a net gain in Ieff/C_load, or in ring-oscillator delay versus Cdyn. Q4 Cdyn 是不是不光包含器件，后段所有部分都在里面？ Does Cdyn cover more than the device — all of the back end too? 是的。产品层的 Cdyn 是全芯片口径： 凡是每个周期被充放电的电容都在里面，再按各自的翻转率加权——器件本征栅电容、交叠/边缘、栅–接触和栅–外延（MOL）、结电容、所有金属层的导线（含线间耦合）、时钟网络、SRAM 位线等。 不计入的：去耦电容、MIM 电容、封装寄生——它们稳态不翻转（但会影响供电噪声）。测出来的 Cdyn 还会混进短路电流和毛刺。 注意口径：工艺层用环振测的“每级 Cdyn”只含器件、MOL 和局部导线，不含时钟网络和长线。拿工艺的 Cdyn 改进去推算产品功耗时，要按各部分占比折算。 Yes. Product-level Cdyn is a whole-chip quantity: every capacitance charged each cycle counts, weighted by its toggle rate — intrinsic gate capacitance, overlap and fringe, gate-to-contact and gate-to-epi (MOL), junctions, wires on every metal layer (including coupling), the clock network, SRAM bit lines and more. Not counted: decoupling capacitors, MIM capacitors and package parasitics — they do not toggle in steady state (though they affect supply noise). Measured Cdyn also picks up short-circuit current and glitches. Mind the scope: the process-level “Cdyn per stage” from ring oscillators covers only device, MOL and local wire, not the clock network or long wires. To project a process Cdyn gain onto product power, weight it by each part's share. Processes must be compared at the same off-state leakage Ioff; otherwise lowering VT buys current dishonestly. 表征什么 What it tells you 晶体管给负载电容充放电的能力，是速度公式 τ ∝ C·V/I 里的分母。 The transistor's ability to charge and discharge load capacitance — the denominator of τ ∝ C·V/I. 数值越大 / 越小意味着什么 Bigger vs. smaller 在同 Ioff、同面积（同栅距）下越大越好。但靠加宽（多鳍、多片、更宽片）得来的电流会带来同比例的自身电容，只有负载主要来自导线和扇出时才划算；靠迁移率、应力、降低源漏电阻得来的电流才是“白赚”。 Larger is better at the same Ioff and footprint (gate pitch). Current bought with width (more fins, more or wider sheets) brings proportional self-capacitance and only pays when wires and fan-out dominate the load; current from mobility, strain or lower source/drain resistance comes for free. 打个比方 Analogy 像水泵的出水量：泵越猛，水桶（电容）灌得越快。但换更大的泵，泵自己的管道也更粗，要先灌满。 Like a pump's flow rate: a stronger pump fills the bucket (capacitance) faster. During a transition the transistor never sits at the single Idsat bias point. 表征什么 What it tells you 真实开关过程中的驱动能力；对中等栅压和线性区特性（DIBL、源漏电阻、迁移率退化）敏感。 Drive under real switching conditions; sensitive to mid-gate-voltage and linear-region behavior (DIBL, source/drain resistance, mobility degradation). 数值越大 / 越小意味着什么 Bigger vs. smaller 越大越好。Ieff/Idsat 的比值也有信息：DIBL 大或亚阈值摆幅差的器件 IL 掉得多，Ieff 会比 Idsat 看起来更差。 Larger is better. Total power = dynamic + short-circuit + leakage. Short-circuit and glitch power are not capacitance, but they land in measured Cdyn. 表征什么 What it tells you 功耗随电压平方涨、随频率线性涨。所以降电压最省电；提频率最费电，因为提频率通常也要提电压。 Power grows with V² and linearly with f. Lowering voltage saves the most; raising frequency costs the most, because it usually needs more voltage too. 数值越大 / 越小意味着什么 Bigger vs. smaller 越低越好。沿 V–F 曲线升频时电压也要升；如果频率和电压近似成正比，功耗大约按 f³ 上涨。 Lower is better. Climbing the V–F curve raises voltage too; if frequency is roughly proportional to voltage, power grows roughly like f³. 打个比方 Analogy 像反复给气球打气再放掉：每次打进去的气量 ∝ C·V，打气的压力 ∝ V，所以每次耗能 ∝ C·V²；每秒打 f 次。 Like inflating and releasing a balloon over and over: each fill holds air ∝ C·V at a pressure ∝ V, so each cycle costs ∝ C·V², f times a second. 怎么测 How it is measured 在若干 (V, f) 点测总电流；停钟测漏电并扣除；剩余功耗对 V²·f 作图，斜率就是 Cdyn。短路功耗可用改变输入边沿速率的环振估计。 Measure total current at several (V, f) points; stop the clocks to measure and subtract leakage; plot the remaining power against V²·f — the slope is Cdyn. Short-circuit power can be estimated with ring oscillators that vary input slew. 相关： Related: Cdyn Cdyn V–F 曲线 V–F curve and Vmin 活动因子 α Activity factor α 在指南中：

 → 有效频率 f_eff Effective frequency f_eff 速度与功耗：Drive 与 Cdyn Speed & power: drive and Cdyn 一段时间内核心实际跑的平均频率：基准频率 × (ΔAPERF/ΔMPERF)，只计活动（C0）时间。 The average frequency a core actually ran over an interval: reference frequency × (ΔAPERF/ΔMPERF), counting active (C0) time only. 实际含义 What it is 现代 CPU 的频率随负载、温度和功耗上限实时变化（睿频、降频、睡眠态）。MPERF 在 C0 态按基准频率计数，APERF 按实际频率计数；两者增量之比乘以基准频率，就是这段时间的有效频率。 Modern CPU clocks shift constantly with load, temperature and power limits (turbo, throttling, sleep states). MPERF counts at the reference frequency in C0, APERF at the actual frequency; the ratio of their increments times the reference frequency is the interval's effective frequency. 表征什么 What it tells you 把测到的功耗换算成 Cdyn 时要除的那个 f；也是“产品实际跑多快”的度量。 The f to divide by when turning measured power into Cdyn — and a measure of how fast the product actually ran. 数值越大 / 越小意味着什么 Bigger vs. smaller 越高说明越多时间跑在高频。算 Cdyn 时要用 f_eff：用标称频率而实际在降频，Cdyn 会被算小；把睡眠时间也算进去，会被算得更小。 Higher means more time at high clocks. Use f_eff when computing Cdyn: dividing by the nominal frequency while the part throttles understates Cdyn, and folding in sleep time understates it further. 打个比方 Analogy 像车的平均车速：路牌写的是限速，实际要看里程 ÷ 行驶时间（停车时间不算）。 Like a car's average speed: the sign shows the limit, but the truth is distance ÷ driving time (parked time excluded). 怎么测 How it is measured 读处理器的 APERF/MPERF 计数器（Linux 的 turbostat、cpupower 等工具会显示），并与电源电流测量在同一时间窗内对齐。 Read the APERF/MPERF counters (shown by Linux turbostat, cpupower and similar tools) and align them with the supply-current measurement window. 相关： Related: Cdyn Cdyn 动态功耗 P = Cdyn·V²·f Dynamic power P = Cdyn·V²·f V–F 曲线 V–F curve and Vmin 在指南中：

 → V–F 曲线（电压–频率）与 Vmin V–F curve and Vmin 速度与功耗：Drive 与 Cdyn Speed & power: drive and Cdyn 芯片在每个电压下能稳定跑到的最高频率；它是 Drive 链和 Cdyn 链的连接点。 The highest stable frequency at each voltage; the hinge between the drive chain and the Cdyn chain. 实际含义 What it is 电压越高，Ieff 越大、门延迟越小，能跑的频率越高；Vmin 是保证功能正确的最低电压。DVFS 就是沿这条曲线上下移动工作点。 Higher voltage gives more Ieff, shorter gate delay and higher achievable frequency; Vmin is the lowest functional voltage. DVFS moves the operating point along this curve. 表征什么 What it tells you 晶体管的 Drive/C 决定曲线的位置（同电压下多快）；Cdyn 决定曲线上每一点要付多少功耗。 Drive/C sets where the curve sits (how fast at a given voltage); Cdyn sets the power cost at each point on it. 数值越大 / 越小意味着什么 Bigger vs. smaller 曲线越靠左上越好（低电压就能跑高频）。对数斜率 s = d ln f / d ln V 决定省下的 Cdyn 能换多少频率：s 越大，同样的功耗余量换到的频率越多。 The further up and left, the better (high frequency at low voltage). The log slope s = d ln f / d ln V decides how much frequency a Cdyn saving buys: larger s turns the same power headroom into more frequency. 打个比方 Analogy 像骑自行车的踩踏力与车速：用力（V）越大越快，但体力消耗（功耗）按力的平方涨。 Like pedal force versus speed on a bike: push harder (V) and you go faster, but effort (power) climbs with the square of the force. 怎么测 How it is measured Shmoo 测试：在 (V, f) 网格上跑测试向量，记录通过/失败边界；产品上用片上监测电路（环振、关键路径复制电路）跟踪。 Shmoo testing: run test patterns on a (V, f) grid and record the pass/fail boundary; products track it with on-die monitors (ring oscillators, critical-path replicas). 相关： Related: 门延迟 CV/I Gate delay CV/I 动态功耗 P = Cdyn·V²·f Dynamic power P = Cdyn·V²·f 等功耗 / 等频率比较 Iso-power vs iso-frequency comparisons Cdyn Cdyn 在指南中：

 → 等功耗 / 等频率比较（iso-power、iso-frequency） Iso-power vs iso-frequency comparisons 速度与功耗：Drive 与 Cdyn Speed & power: drive and Cdyn 工艺代际收益的两种报法：同功耗下快多少，或同频率下省多少电；后者的百分比通常大得多。 Two ways to quote a node's gain: how much faster at the same power, or how much less power at the same frequency; the second percentage is usually much larger. 实际含义 What it is 同一组晶体管和电容改进，可以兑现成频率，也可以兑现成功耗。功耗随 V² 变化：同频率下降电压能省很多电；同功耗下提频率要付 V² 的代价，所以频率收益的百分比小于功耗收益。 The same transistor and capacitance gains can be cashed in as frequency or as power. Since power scales with V², lowering V at iso-frequency saves a lot, while raising frequency at iso-power pays the V² toll, so the frequency gain in percent is smaller. 表征什么 What it tells you 把 Drive 和 Cdyn 的改进折算成产品语言；也是判断一项改动值不值的口径。 It translates drive and Cdyn improvements into product terms — and is the yardstick for whether a change is worth it. 数值越大 / 越小意味着什么 Bigger vs. smaller 两个数都越大越好，但不要拿一个工艺的 iso-power 数去比另一个工艺的 iso-frequency 数，还要看是在哪个电压点报的。 Larger is better for both, but never compare one node's iso-power number with another's iso-frequency number — and check which voltage it was quoted at. 打个比方 Analogy 像换了一辆更轻的车：可以油耗不变跑得快一点，也可以速度不变省很多油；省油的百分比看起来总是更大。 Like a lighter car: same fuel, a bit faster; or same speed, a lot less fuel — the fuel saving always looks bigger. 怎么测 How it is measured 在新旧工艺上实现同一设计或电路块，各自扫 V–F 和功耗，画频率–功耗曲线，在同一功耗或同一频率处读差值。 Implement the same design or block on both nodes, sweep V–F and power, plot frequency versus power, and read the difference at the same power or the same frequency. 典型数值 Typical numbers 【硅片·研究】3 nm GAA 路径探索 PDK 上，空气侧墙（k 7→3.3）使 9 级 FO1 环振在等速度下有功功耗降 30%，等功耗下频率升 9%（Lee 等，IEEE Access 2022）。【厂商】据 Tom's Hardware 报道，Intel 18A 对比 Intel 3：1.1 V 等频率功耗降 36%，0.75 V 下速度高 18%。 [Silicon · research] On a 3 nm GAA path-finding PDK, an air spacer (k 7→3.3) cut a 9-stage FO1 ring oscillator's active power by 30% at iso-speed but raised frequency by only 9% at iso-power (Lee et al., IEEE Access 2022).  → 环形振荡器（RO） Ring oscillator (RO) 速度与功耗：Drive 与 Cdyn Speed & power: drive and Cdyn 奇数级反相器首尾相接自激振荡；同时测频率和电流，就能得到工艺的门延迟和每级 Cdyn。 An odd chain of inverters looped into self-oscillation; measuring frequency and current together yields gate delay and Cdyn per stage. 实际含义 What it is N 级环振的周期是 2N 个门延迟：τ = 1/(2N·f)。振荡时的电源电流 IDDA 减去停振电流 IDDQ，就是充放电电流，于是每级电容 C = (IDDA − IDDQ)/(N·VDD·f)。 An N-stage ring's period is 2N gate delays: τ = 1/(2N·f). Oscillating supply current IDDA minus the stopped current IDDQ is the switching current, so per-stage capacitance is C = (IDDA − IDDQ)/(N·VDD·f). 表征什么 What it tells you 工艺 AC 性能的标尺：在同一结构上同时看到速度（τ）、电容（C）以及两者的取舍。 The yardstick for a process's AC performance: speed (τ), capacitance (C) and their trade-off on one structure. 数值越大 / 越小意味着什么 Bigger vs. smaller τ 越小越快，C 越小越省。常画“延迟对每级 Cdyn”或“延迟对功耗”的图，越靠左下越好。只降 τ 却让 C 上升（如加宽器件），未必是好改动。 Smaller τ is faster, smaller C is thriftier; plots of delay versus Cdyn per stage, or delay versus power, are better toward the lower left. A τ cut bought with more C (e.g., wider devices) is not necessarily a win. 打个比方 Analogy 像一圈人传话：一圈传完的时间告诉你每人反应多快，大家耗的力气告诉你每人要喊多大声。 Like a whisper passed around a circle: the round time tells you each person's reaction speed; the total effort tells you how loudly each had to shout. 怎么测 How it is measured 片上环振带分频输出测频率；分别测振荡与停振（关使能）时的电源电流。用不同扇出、不同金属负载、不同堆叠的环振组，把 C 拆成栅、扩散、导线等分量（Bhushan 等，IEEE TSM 2006）。 On-chip ROs with divided outputs for frequency; measure supply current oscillating and stopped (enable off).  → 本征栅电容（Cinv / 沟道电容） Intrinsic gate capacitance (Cinv / channel capacitance) 速度与功耗：Drive 与 Cdyn Speed & power: drive and Cdyn 栅极对沟道反型电荷的那部分电容；它是换来驱动电流的“好电容”。 The part of gate capacitance that couples to the channel's inversion charge — the “good” capacitance that buys drive current. 实际含义 What it is Cinv ≈ ε / EOT(反型) × 栅长 × 有效宽度。沟道电荷 Q = Cinv·(VGS − VT)，电流 ≈ 电荷 × 速度，所以没有它就没有电流。 Cinv ≈ ε / EOT(inv) × gate length × effective width. Channel charge Q = Cinv·(VGS − VT), and current ≈ charge × velocity, so no Cinv means no current. 表征什么 What it tells you 栅对沟道的控制力度；也是器件自身那部分 Cdyn 里唯一有回报的部分。 How firmly the gate controls the channel — and the only part of the device's own Cdyn that pays a return. 数值越大 / 越小意味着什么 Bigger vs. smaller 不是越小越好：减小它（如加厚 EOT）会同时减小驱动。真正要减的是寄生部分。衡量工艺看的是 I/C，而不是单独的 C。 Not smaller-is-better: cutting it (e.g., thicker EOT) cuts drive with it. The parasitic part is what to cut. Judge a process by I/C, not C alone. 打个比方 Analogy 像水泵的叶轮：叶轮越大泵出的水越多，但启动也越费劲；把叶轮拿掉就没有泵了。 Like a pump's impeller: bigger means more flow but more effort to spin up; remove it and there is no pump. 怎么测 How it is measured 大面积电容结构做 C–V（split C–V 分出栅–沟道部分）；用多个栅长外推，扣除短沟道器件的寄生部分。 C–V on large-area structures (split C–V separates the gate-to-channel part); extrapolate across several gate lengths to remove short-channel parasitics. 相关： Related: 交叠与边缘电容 Overlap and fringe capacitance Drive / 驱动电流 Drive current Cgg / Cgd Cgg / Cgd 在指南中：

 → 交叠与边缘电容（Cov、Cof、Cif）与 Miller 效应 Overlap and fringe capacitance (Cov, Cof, Cif) and the Miller effect 速度与功耗：Drive 与 Cdyn Speed & power: drive and Cdyn 栅与源漏之间不产生电流的寄生电容；栅–漏那一份在翻转时约按 2 倍计入。 Gate-to-source/drain parasitics that carry no current; the gate–drain share counts roughly double during switching. 实际含义 What it is Cov：栅与源漏延伸区的交叠；Cof：栅侧壁经侧墙到源漏的外边缘场；Cif：栅底部到源漏的内边缘场。翻转时栅和漏反向摆动，Cgd 两端电压变化 2·VDD，等效约 2 倍（Miller 效应）。 Cov: gate overlap with source/drain extensions; Cof: outer fringe from the gate sidewall through the spacer to source/drain; Cif: inner fringe from the gate bottom to source/drain. Gate and drain swing in opposite directions, so Cgd sees a 2·VDD change and counts about double (Miller effect). 表征什么 What it tells you FEOL 结构里“白交的电费”；也加在漏端的自负载上。 The FEOL's wasted charge; it also adds to the self-load at the drain. 数值越大 / 越小意味着什么 Bigger vs. smaller 越小越好，但有取舍：减小交叠（甚至 underlap）会增加源漏电阻、降低驱动；加厚侧墙降电容但增加电阻。要看 Ieff/C 的净效果。 Smaller is better, with trade-offs: less overlap (or underlap) raises source/drain resistance and cuts drive; thicker spacers cut C but add R. Each gate-pitch shrink enlarges this parallel-plate capacitance. 表征什么 What it tells you MOL 结构设计的好坏；也是先进节点“面积缩了却没变快”的常见原因。 How good the MOL structure is — and a common reason a shrink fails to get faster. 数值越大 / 越小意味着什么 Bigger vs. smaller 越小越好。主要旋钮：侧墙介电常数（低 k、空气侧墙）、接触的高度和宽度、自对准接触。代价通常是接触电阻和可靠性。 Smaller is better. Knobs: spacer dielectric constant (low-k, air spacer), contact height and width, self-aligned contacts. The usual costs are contact resistance and reliability. 打个比方 Analogy 像两栋贴得太近的楼：楼越高、贴得越紧，彼此影响越大；中间留空气（空气侧墙）比灌混凝土隔得更好。 Like two buildings built too close: the taller and tighter, the more they interfere; an air gap between them isolates better than concrete. 怎么测 How it is measured 专用梳状栅–接触电容结构做 C–V；用环振对比不同侧墙方案；校准版图寄生提取。 Dedicated comb gate-to-contact capacitor structures for C–V; ring oscillators comparing spacer options; calibrated layout parasitic extraction. 典型数值 Typical numbers 【硅片·研究】IBM 把空气侧墙与自对准接触、有源区上栅接触（COAG）集成，实测 Ceff 降 15%（VLSI 2020）。3 nm GAA 路径探索 PDK 研究中，MOL 与 BEOL 的 RC 占电路性能退化的 60% 以上（Lee 等，IEEE Access 2022）。 [Silicon · research] IBM integrated an air spacer with self-aligned contacts and contact-over-active-gate (COAG), measuring a 15% Ceff reduction (VLSI 2020).  → 结电容 / 扩散电容（Cj） Junction / diffusion capacitance (Cj) 速度与功耗：Drive 与 Cdyn Speed & power: drive and Cdyn 源漏与衬底（或阱）之间 PN 结的耗尽层电容；漏端每次翻转都要一起充放电。 Depletion capacitance of the source/drain-to-substrate (or well) junction; it charges with every drain transition. 实际含义 What it is 平面器件的源漏扩散区面积大，Cj 是自负载的重要部分；FinFET 和 nanosheet 的源漏外延长在窄鳍或隔离层上，结面积小得多，BDI 再把底部切断。 In planar devices large source/drain diffusions made Cj a big part of self-load; FinFET and nanosheet S/D epi sits on narrow fins or isolation with far less junction area, and BDI cuts the bottom further. 表征什么 What it tells you 漏端自负载的一部分；它随反偏电压增大而减小。 Part of the drain self-load; it shrinks as reverse bias grows. 数值越大 / 越小意味着什么 Bigger vs. smaller 越小越好。在 0.13 µm 处理器上，扩散电容是栅电容（约 34%）和互连（50% 以上）之外剩下的那一小份；在 FinFET/GAA 中占比更低。 Smaller is better. On a 0.13 µm processor diffusion was the small remainder after gate capacitance (~34%) and interconnect (>50%); its share is lower still in FinFET/GAA. 打个比方 Analogy 像水管接头处鼓起的小水囊：每次压力变化都要先把它撑满。 Like a small bulge at a pipe joint that must fill every time pressure changes. 怎么测 How it is measured 大面积二极管结构的 C–V；环振中改变 NFET 堆叠数来拆出扩散电容（Bhushan 等）。 C–V on large-area diode structures; ring oscillators with varied NFET stack height separate diffusion capacitance (Bhushan et al.). 相关： Related: BDI BDI 负载电容 C_load / Ceff 与自负载 Load capacitance 交叠与边缘电容 Overlap and fringe capacitance 在指南中：
模拟器件看"偏置点上的小信号比值"，而不是 Ion/Ioff
 → In the guide: 
Analog devices are judged by "small-signal ratios at a bias point", not Ion/Ioff
 → 互连电容（BEOL 导线电容） Interconnect (BEOL wire) capacitance 速度与功耗：Drive 与 Cdyn Speed & power: drive and Cdyn 金属线对上下层和相邻线的电容；在整颗芯片的 Cdyn 里常常是最大的一块。 Metal lines' capacitance to the layers above and below and to neighbors; often the largest piece of a chip's Cdyn. 实际含义 What it is 由对上下层的电容和线间耦合电容组成。耦合电容的有效值取决于邻线怎么翻转：邻线不动约 1 倍，同向翻转接近 0，反向翻转约 2 倍（Miller 因子）。 Capacitance to layers above and below plus line-to-line coupling. Effective coupling depends on the neighbors: quiet ≈ 1×, switching the same way ≈ 0, switching the opposite way ≈ 2× (Miller factor). 表征什么 What it tells you 布线密度、介质材料和布线质量。 Routing density, dielectric material and routing quality. 数值越大 / 越小意味着什么 Bigger vs. smaller 越小越好，同时降低延迟和 Cdyn。旋钮：低 k / 超低 k 介质、气隙、加大线距、缩短线长（更好的布局或 3D 堆叠）。代价是机械强度、可靠性和面积。 Smaller is better, cutting both delay and Cdyn. Knobs: low-k and ultra-low-k dielectrics, air gaps, wider spacing, shorter wires (better placement or 3D stacking). Costs: mechanical strength, reliability and area. 打个比方 Analogy 像城市道路：路网越密，车流（信号）越互相干扰；隔离带（低 k、气隙）让相邻车道互不影响。 Like a city's roads: the denser the grid, the more traffic (signals) interferes; medians (low-k, air gaps) keep adjacent lanes apart. 怎么测 How it is measured 梳状–蛇形线结构测线间电容；带金属负载的环振；BEOL 统计模型和寄生提取（PEX）与硅片对标。 Comb–serpentine structures for line-to-line capacitance; ring oscillators with metal loads; BEOL statistical models and PEX correlated to silicon. 典型数值 Typical numbers 【硅片·研究】0.13 µm 处理器中互连占动态功耗 50% 以上，约 90% 的互连功耗来自约 10% 的连线；按功耗优化线距的布线平均省 14% 动态功耗（Magen 等，SLIP 2004）。【厂商】据报道 Intel 18A 的正面金属 RC 比 Intel 3 好约 12%。 [Silicon · research] In a 0.13 µm processor interconnect took >50% of dynamic power, with ~90% of it in ~10% of the nets; power-aware wire spacing saved 14% of dynamic power on average (Magen et al., SLIP 2004). [Vendor] Intel 18A's front-side metal RC is reported ~12% better than Intel 3. 相关： Related: 互连电阻与 RC 延迟 Interconnect resistance and RC delay 时钟网络 Clock network 栅–接触 / 栅–外延电容 Gate-to-contact and gate-to-epi capacitance Cdyn Cdyn 在指南中：
模拟器件看"偏置点上的小信号比值"，而不是 Ion/Ioff
 → In the guide: 
Analog devices are judged by "small-signal ratios at a bias point", not Ion/Ioff
 → 时钟网络（clock tree） Clock network (clock tree) 速度与功耗：Drive 与 Cdyn Speed & power: drive and Cdyn 把时钟送到每个触发器的网络；每周期必翻转（α = 1），是 Cdyn 的大户。 The network that delivers the clock to every flip-flop; it switches every cycle (α = 1) and is a major Cdyn consumer. 实际含义 What it is 由全局时钟网格或时钟树、局部缓冲器和触发器的时钟输入组成。和数据线不同，它的活动因子固定为 1，而且线长、缓冲器多。 A global grid or tree, local buffers and flip-flop clock pins. Unlike data nets, its activity factor is fixed at 1, with long wires and many buffers. 表征什么 What it tells you 设计侧的“底噪” Cdyn：哪怕没做有用的计算，时钟也在耗电。 Design-side baseline Cdyn: the clock burns power even when no useful work happens. 数值越大 / 越小意味着什么 Bigger vs. smaller 越小越好。时钟门控把空闲模块的时钟关掉，是最有效的降 Cdyn 手段之一。 Smaller is better. Clock gating stops the clock to idle blocks — one of the most effective Cdyn reductions. 打个比方 Analogy 像全楼的广播：不管有没有人听，每层都在响；关掉没人的楼层就省电了。 Like a building-wide PA system: every floor plays whether or not anyone listens; switch off the empty floors and you save power. 怎么测 How it is measured 空闲负载（数据活动很少）下测得的 Cdyn 近似时钟加常开逻辑；设计中由时钟树综合报告给出时钟电容。 Cdyn measured on an idle workload (little data activity) approximates the clock plus always-on logic; in design, clock-tree synthesis reports the clock capacitance. 典型数值 Typical numbers 【硅片·研究】0.13 µm 处理器中时钟网约占动态功耗 40%（局部约 29%、全局约 13%），而时钟网只占约 1% 的网络、4% 的布线长度（Magen 等，SLIP 2004）。 [Silicon · research] In a 0.13 µm processor clock nets took ~40% of dynamic power (local ~29%, global ~13%) while being ~1% of nets and ~4% of routing length (Magen et al., SLIP 2004). 相关： Related: 活动因子 α Activity factor α 互连电容 Interconnect Cdyn Cdyn 在指南中：
模拟器件看"偏置点上的小信号比值"，而不是 Ion/Ioff
 → In the guide: 
Analog devices are judged by "small-signal ratios at a bias point", not Ion/Ioff
 → 互连电阻与 RC 延迟（含电阻屏蔽） Interconnect resistance and RC delay (incl. resistive shielding) 速度与功耗：Drive 与 Cdyn Speed & power: drive and Cdyn 导线电阻让信号沿线变慢；它不属于 Cdyn，但和电容一起决定线延迟。 Wire resistance slows signals along the line; it is not part of Cdyn, but with capacitance it sets wire delay. 实际含义 What it is 长线延迟 ≈ 0.4·R_wire·C_wire（分布式 RC）+ 驱动电阻 × 总电容。电阻还会“屏蔽”远端电容：驱动器看到的有效电容小于导线总电容，但总延迟仍随电阻增加。供电网络的电阻造成 IR 压降，降低晶体管实际拿到的电压和驱动。 Long-wire delay ≈ 0.4·R_wire·C_wire (distributed RC) + driver resistance × total capacitance. Resistance also shields far-end capacitance: the driver sees less than the total, yet total delay still grows with resistance. Power-grid resistance causes IR drop, reducing the voltage and drive the transistor actually gets. 表征什么 What it tells you 金属线越细越长电阻越大；先进节点里电阻上升得比电容快。 Thinner, longer wires mean more resistance; at advanced nodes resistance rises faster than capacitance. 数值越大 / 越小意味着什么 Bigger vs. smaller 越小越好，但降电阻不会降 Cdyn。所以“降 RC”提升 AC 性能，“降 Cdyn”要靠降 C。背面供电（BSPDN）减小 IR 压降、腾出正面布线，两方面同时帮忙。 Smaller is better, but lower R does not lower Cdyn. Cutting RC helps AC performance; cutting Cdyn is about C. Backside power (BSPDN) cuts IR drop and frees front-side routing, helping on both counts. 打个比方 Analogy 像细长的水管：管子越细越长，水越慢流到另一头；桶（电容）没变，但灌满要更久。 Like a long, thin hose: the thinner and longer it is, the slower water reaches the far end; the bucket (capacitance) is unchanged, but filling takes longer. 怎么测 How it is measured Kelvin 四端法测线电阻和通孔链电阻；长线环振或延迟链测线延迟；片上电压监测电路测 IR 压降。 Four-terminal Kelvin measurement of line and via-chain resistance; long-wire ring oscillators or delay chains for wire delay; on-die voltage monitors for IR drop. 典型数值 Typical numbers 【常识】分布式 RC 线的 50% 延迟约 0.38·R·C（Elmore 近似给 0.5·R·C）。【厂商】据报道 Intel 18A 的 PowerVia 背面供电使最坏情况电压跌落比 Intel 3 降低至多 10 倍。 [Textbook] A distributed RC line's 50% delay is ≈ 0.38·R·C (Elmore gives 0.5·R·C). [Vendor] Intel 18A's PowerVia backside power is reported to cut worst-case voltage droop by up to 10× versus Intel 3. 相关： Related: 互连电容 Interconnect BSPDN BSPDN 门延迟 CV/I Gate delay CV/I Kelvin 连接 Kelvin 在指南中：

records.text: 3D IC 的 TSV KOZ 与 GAA Analog 器件 · TSV Keep-Out Zones & GAA Analog｜TIMEMEMO RESEARCH 跳至正文 Skip to report TIMEMEMO RESEARCH 半导体研究 Semiconductor research 全部内容 All entries 中文 EN 器件与先进封装 DEVICES & ADVANCED PACKAGING / 2026.10.07 3D IC 的 TSV KOZ 与 GAA Analog 器件 TSV keep-out zones & GAA analog devices KOZ 不是一个固定的禁区半径。它由热机械应力、衬底噪声耦合、TSV 对走线的耦合和 Cu pumping 四种机制分别决定，前段器件和后段金属的规则不同；analog 的判据比 digital 严一个量级，KOZ 通常是 digital 的 3 倍以上。 A keep-out zone is not one fixed radius. Thermo-mechanical stress, substrate noise coupling, TSV-to-wire coupling and Cu pumping each set their own limits, with different rules for front-end devices and back-end metal. Analog criteria are ten times tighter than digital, so analog KOZs are usually at least three times larger. 范围：TSV KOZ · GAA ANALOG · 量测方法 SCOPE: TSV KOZ · GAA ANALOG · METROLOGY 33 项来源 · 基于公开文献 33 SOURCES · PUBLIC LITERATURE 报告目录 01 KOZ 由什么决定 02 TSV 剖面上的影响区 03 公开数据里的 KOZ 量级 04 不同 3D 结构下的差别 05 GAA 下 analog 器件要关注的特性 06 量测方法 07 建议的做法 08 公开资料没有覆盖的点 09 Sources CONTENTS 01 What sets the KOZ 02 Zones in a TSV cross-section 03 KOZ sizes in published data 04 How 3D structures differ 05 Analog device behavior in GAA 06 Measurement methods 07 Recommended approach 08 Gaps in public data 09 Sources KOZ 由什么决定 KOZ 的本意是 TSV 周围不放有源器件的区域，针对的是前段；后段金属并不整体禁用，只是 TSV 正上方和紧邻处有单独的 via 与走线规则。KOZ 的大小也不是工艺常数，而是由机制、器件类型和允许的漂移量共同决定。 机制 物理来源 影响对象 作用范围 常用对策 热机械应力 Cu 与 Si 的 CTE 相差约 7 倍（16.7 对 2.3 ppm/°C），退火后冷却留下残余应力 前段：迁移率、Id、gm；在匹配对上表现为系统失配 单根 TSV 近似按 1/r² 衰减，数 µm 到十几 µm；阵列叠加后更远 缩小 TSV 直径；阵列 pitch/直径大于 5；器件相对 TSV 方位对称 衬底噪声耦合 TSV、liner、Si 构成 MOS 电容，TSV 上的信号经衬底调制器件的 body 和 drain 前段：analog 的噪声和电流调制 衰减比应力慢；planar 器件按 2% 判据约 28 µm 就近接地的 substrate contact（28 µm 降到约 8 µm）；guard ring（100 MHz 下约 −17 dB）；厚 liner（100 MHz 下约 −20 dB） TSV 对走线的耦合 TSV 与邻近金属线之间的电容 后段：敏感走线的噪声和延时 主要在 10 µm 内，20 µm 外可忽略 布线层单独设 KOZ；接地的 guard ring 走线 Cu pumping 高温下 Cu 沿轴向挤出，TSV 顶面呈穹顶状，顶起上方各层 后段：V0 应力空洞、M1 dishing、介质开裂和分层 TSV 正上方及顶角附近 TSV 正上方若干层不放 via；缩小直径 来源： imec IEDM 2010 报道 、 Guo 等 IEDM 2013 、 Lu 等 TDMR 2012 、 Rack 等 ECTC 2015 、 Cho 等 CPMT 2011 、 Peng 等 DAC 2014 、 GlobalFoundries 专利 US10199315 。 Analog 的 KOZ 为什么更大 判据严一个量级。 imec 对 digital 用 5% 的 Id 变化，对 analog 用 0.5%。按 1/r² 衰减，判据收紧 10 倍，KOZ 半径约为原来的 3 倍，面积约为 10 倍。 长沟道器件更敏感。 短沟道器件受接入电阻和短沟道效应限制，电流对迁移率变化不敏感；analog 常用的长 L 器件正好相反。 匹配看的是梯度而不是绝对值。 TSV 周围径向是拉应力、切向是压应力，大小相近、符号相反。同一对器件相对 TSV 的方位不同，电流会一个增大、一个减小。 KOZ 不是定值的另外两个原因 阵列叠加。 pitch/直径小于 5 时相邻 TSV 的应力场相互作用。imec 在 TSV 矩阵旁得到的 analog KOZ 为 20–200 µm，取决于矩阵里 TSV 的数量。 随寿命和个体变化。 NIST 用同步辐射 X 射线测得：1000 次热循环后，Cu TSV 内的主应力和剪应力约为初始的 5 倍；相邻两根 TSV 的静水应力也因微结构不同而相差约 50%（99±30 对 151±37 MPa）。两篇都建议 KOZ 规则把这些变化算进去。来源： Okoro 等 ECTC 2014 、 Okoro 等 TED 2014 。 TSV 剖面上的影响区 前段的应力 KOZ 按判据分两档，analog 一档更宽，digital 器件可以放进 analog 的禁区。后段只在 TSV 正上方和紧邻的走线处受限。噪声耦合走衬底，靠就近接地的 substrate contact 截断。 公开数据里的 KOZ 量级 公开数据里 analog 的 KOZ 从约 6 µm（FinFET 配 3 µm TSV）到 200 µm（planar 配 5 µm TSV 矩阵），跨两个量级。差别主要来自 TSV 直径、沟道长度、阵列规模和判据。 研究 器件 TSV（直径 × 深度） 判据 KOZ 数据性质 Rack 等 ECTC 2015 65 nm planar nMOS、32 nm nFinFET 5 × 50 µm Id 变化 2%，应力加耦合 planar 约 28 µm；就近接地后约 8 µm S 参数实测加 TCAD Guo 等 IEDM 2013 10 nm 节点 bulk FinFET，L = 20 nm，PMOS 3 µm，深宽比 1:17 Id 5%；Id 0.5% 1.8 µm；5.6 µm（距 TSV 中心） 5 µm TSV 硅片数据校准后用 TCAD 外推 Lu 等 TDMR 2012 体硅，n 型、[100] 沟道 5 × 200 µm；50 × 200 µm 迁移率 5% 约 7 µm；约 60 µm 三维 FEA imec IEDM 2010 planar HKMG，5 × 10 µm² 的 DAC 器件 5.2 × 40 µm Idsat 0.5%（analog）；digital 单根 20 µm，矩阵 20–200 µm；digital 6–20 µm DAC 测试电路实测加 FEM 和 micro-Raman 另有一篇 14 nm FinFET 的 TSV 可靠性研究 （只读到摘要）：在 5 µm KOZ 处，薄栅氧和厚栅氧的 NFET、PFET 的 Idsat 都未见可测影响，FEOL、BEOL 和 ESD 可靠性也无显著变化。 判据收紧时 KOZ 怎么变 Guo 等给出一个简化关系：单根 TSV 的 KOZ 半径等于 K/δId 的平方根，其中 K 是由 TSV 工艺和器件应力响应决定的品质因子。他们在 5 µm TSV、L = 900 nm 的长沟道 FinFET 上得到 K 约为 110（n 型）和 130（p 型）%·µm²。下表是用这两个 K 值算出的半径，距离指 TSV 中心到器件中心；5% 和 0.5% 是论文用的判据，1% 和 0.1% 是补充的示例。 允许的 Id 变化 n 型 KOZ 半径（µm） p 型 KOZ 半径（µm） 5%（digital） 4.7 5.1 1% 10.5 11.4 0.5%（analog） 14.8 16.1 0.1%（精密匹配） 33.2 36.1 这组数只对孤立的单根 TSV 成立，阵列旁会更大。同一模型下 KOZ 面积与 TSV 直径的平方成正比，5 µm 缩到 3 µm 面积约减小到三分之一。 GAA 器件的情况 针对 nanosheet 的公开结果目前是 TCAD，没有找到硅片数据。 Jeong 等 IEEE Access 2021 （只读到摘要）对比了 sub-5 nm 的 NSFET 与 FinFET，结论有三条： TSV 应力引起的 Ion 变化，NSFET 比 FinFET 大，主要来自沟道长度方向的应力分量。 器件放在 KOZ 之外时，应力影响可忽略。 噪声耦合按 analog 判据（耦合电流小于 Ion 的 0.5%）衡量时，常规结构不达标；作者建议在 S/D 下方加 bottom oxide 并用不掺杂的 punch-through stopper。 不同 3D 结构下的差别 TSV 从微米级缩到纳米级后，局部应力 KOZ 随直径平方缩小，但减薄、背面金属和失去衬底带来的全局效应变成主要问题。所以在 GAA 加背面供电的工艺上，只看 TSV 周围的禁区是不够的。 结构 典型尺寸 对器件的影响 来源 Via-middle Cu TSV 直径 3–5 µm，深约 40–50 µm 经历 420 °C 退火和多道 350–400 °C 的 BEOL 工序，残余应力和迁移率变化最大；Cu pumping 使 M1 变薄，电阻升高约 35% Guo 等 ECTC 2015 背面 via-last TSV 同上量级 只经历一次到 300 °C 的升降温，残余应力和 KOZ 都更小，pumping 不明显；可用约 3 µm 厚的聚合物 liner，耦合再降约 20 dB 同上； Rack 等 ECTC strain analysis of released Ge gate-all-around nano-wires ，IMC19 2018 What sets the KOZ A keep-out zone is the area around a TSV where no active devices are placed, so it applies to the front end. Back-end metal is not banned wholesale; only the area directly above the TSV and its immediate neighborhood carry separate via and routing rules. The size of a KOZ is not a process constant either: it depends on the mechanism, the device type and how much drift the circuit can tolerate. Why the analog KOZ is larger The criterion is ten times tighter. imec uses a 5% Id change for digital and 0.5% for analog. With 1/r² decay, a 10× tighter criterion gives a radius about 3× larger and an area about 10× larger. Long-channel devices are more sensitive. In short-channel devices, access resistance and short-channel effects make current less sensitive to mobility; the long-L devices common in analog behave the opposite way. Matching depends on the gradient, not the absolute value. Around a TSV the radial stress is tensile and the tangential stress is compressive, similar in magnitude and opposite in sign. If the two devices of a pair sit at different orientations to the TSV, one current goes up while the other goes down. Two more reasons the KOZ is not a fixed number Array superposition. Below a pitch/diameter ratio of 5, stress fields of neighboring TSVs interact. Next to TSV arrays, imec found analog KOZs of 20–200 µm depending on how many TSVs the array held. Change over lifetime and from via to via. NIST synchrotron X-ray measurements show principal and shear stress in Cu TSVs about 5× higher after 1,000 thermal cycles, and hydrostatic stress differing by about 50% between two neighboring TSVs (99±30 vs 151±37 MPa) because of microstructure. Both papers recommend building these variations into KOZ rules. Sources: Okoro et al. ECTC 2014 , Okoro et al. TED 2014 . Zones in a TSV cross-section The front-end stress KOZ comes in two tiers set by the criterion; the analog tier is wider, and digital devices may sit inside the analog zone. The back end is restricted only directly above the TSV and on nearby routes. Noise couples through the substrate and is cut off by a nearby grounded substrate contact. KOZ sizes in published data Published analog KOZs range from about 6 µm (FinFET with a 3 µm TSV) to 200 µm (planar devices next to a 5 µm TSV array), two orders of magnitude.
