records.text: Amy Project R2 | MindSpark Box Lab S Sky Portal ☰ 中文 EN 原版页面 Original Page 打印 / PDF Print / PDF 素材池导航 摘要 00 执行摘要 01 为什么做 02 三盒系统 03 学习路线 04 导师地图 05 反馈系统 06 安全合作 07 90 天路线图 08 打样计划 09 对外讲法 10 来源与下一步 Source Navigation Summary 00 Executive Summary 01 Why This 02 Three Boxes 03 Learning Path 04 Mentor Map 05 Feedback System 06 Safety Partners 07 90-Day Roadmap 08 Prototype Plan 09 Public Narrative 10 Sources & Next R2 草稿 · 双语报告页 Amy Project 行为激活 设计实验 把逻辑、心理学和高质感触觉艺术，组织成一个学生主导的支持性活动礼盒项目：先做三个原型，再用安全、匿名、低风险的反馈验证它是否真的让孩子更容易开始行动、表达和连接。 版本：R2 展示稿 定位：非临床支持性活动设计 更新时间：2026-06-08 核心判断 1 先做小：一个孩子愿意打开、愿意完成的一盒。 2 再做准：用匿名反馈判断哪个活动、哪个环境更有效。 3 最后做大：学校、医院 donation 或 nonprofit 都要建立在安全试点之后。 4 底线清楚：不是治疗，不收敏感医疗数据，不绕过家长和专业人员。 R2 draft · bilingual report page Amy Project Behavioral Activation Design A student-led supportive activity-kit project that combines logic, psychology, and high-quality tactile art. The first goal is to build three prototypes, then use safe, anonymous, low-risk feedback to see whether the boxes help teens start small actions, express themselves, and connect. Version: R2 presentation draft Positioning: non-clinical supportive design Updated: 2026-06-08 Core thesis 1 Start small: one box a teen actually wants to open and finish. 2 Then get precise: use anonymous feedback to learn which activity and setting work best. 3 Then scale: school, hospital donation, or nonprofit paths should follow a safe pilot. 4 Keep the boundary: not therapy, no sensitive medical data, no bypassing parents or professionals. 00 摘要 01 为什么 02 三盒 03 学习 04 导师 05 反馈 06 合作 07 路线 08 打样 09 讲法 10 来源 00 执行摘要 先把低落里的“第一步”设计出来。 Amy Project R2 不是把旧页重写成商业计划，而是把想法升级成一个可展示、可试点、可被家长和导师理解的项目框架。核心产品是三款活动礼盒；核心研究问题是不同活动和社交环境怎样影响青少年的开始行动、表达和连接。 3 Boxes 独立完成、亲子协作、社区拼接，分别测试三种支持环境。 学习线 心理学、逻辑、行为改变、设计和反馈问卷。 产品线 从手作原型到高质感礼盒，再到小规模 pilot。 合作线 先家庭和学校，再考虑医院 donation 和 nonprofit。 Logic 结构清楚 把手作步骤做成低错误率算法，让孩子不用猜下一步。 Psychology 门槛很低 把行为激活变成一个 5-20 分钟能完成的小行动。 Art 表达安全 用颜色、触感、形状和故事表达，而不是强迫讲话。 一句话：先做一个孩子真的愿意打开的盒子，再用安全反馈判断它是否值得扩大。 01 为什么做 很多孩子不是不想变好，是第一步太重。 低落状态里的困难常常不是“不懂道理”，而是缺少足够小、足够安全、足够可完成的行动入口。Amy 的优势是从孩子视角理解这种入口应该长什么样。 痛点 1 传统材料太像作业 很多心理健康 worksheet 对孩子来说像任务和审查，打开之前已经有压力。 痛点 2 表达不总能靠语言 孩子可能愿意做、愿意画、愿意拼，但不一定愿意马上解释自己的感受。 行为激活 先做小行动，让行动带回一点能量和完成感。 触觉艺术 用丝带、木质、磁吸、纸艺等材料降低进入门槛。 逻辑结构 每一步清楚、可验证、可完成，减少焦虑和放弃。 项目的价值不是宣称“治好抑郁”，而是设计一个更容易开始、更容易完成、更容易被理解的支持性活动入口。 02 三盒系统 同一个目标，三种社交环境。 三款礼盒不是随机产品，而是三个变量：一个人做、两个人做、很多人各自完成后拼接。这样才能看出“环境”本身对开始行动和情绪支持的影响。 01 独立掌控礼盒 真丝丝带玫瑰、植物花艺、低压力折叠。目标：安全感、掌控感、完成感。 02 家庭之桥礼盒 磁吸结构、几何拼图、双人协作和低压力对话卡。目标：共同专注和自然连接。 03 协作网格礼盒 每个人独立完成一个模块，再加入集体墙。目标：低压力归属感和社区连接。 20 x 20 x 20 规则 R2 设计约束 20 分钟 一个阶段可以在 20 分钟内完成，不拖成大工程。 20 个零件 核心零件尽量少，避免打开后就被复杂度压倒。 20 秒第一步 第一步必须一眼看懂，先开始，再慢慢深入。 规则不是为了限制创意，而是为了让低能量状态下的孩子也有机会开始。 03 学习路线 课程不是装饰，是每张活动卡背后的设计依据。 R2 把夏天学习拆成四条线：心理学大图谱、逻辑结构、行为改变、设计反馈。每周至少把一个概念转化成一张 activity card。 Week 1 心理学入门 Yale Intro Psychology，建立行为、记忆、情绪和社交的基础词汇。 Week 2 逻辑推理 Duke Think Again 和 Brilliant Logic，把说明书写成清楚步骤。 Week 3 行为改变 Wesleyan Behavioral Change，学习 action loop、动机和 behavioral activation。 Week 4 认知偏差 Blind spots、attention bias、attribution bias，做 assumption check 卡片。 Ongoing 设计迭代 每学一个概念，转化成一个盒子任务、说明页或问卷问题。 报名判断：Yale Science of Well-Being Yale Online 页面 显示这门课可通过 Coursera 免费学习、YouTube 看视频或付费拿 Coursera certificate。Amy 如果已满 13 岁，可以在家长同意和监督下按 Coursera 规则学习；如果未满 13 岁，不应自己注册 Coursera，可以先用家长账号/YouTube 方式学习。 报名判断：Harvard PSYC S-1609 Harvard DCE course page 显示这是 4-credit Harvard Summer School 课程。Harvard Secondary School Program 2026 要求学生至少 16 岁并将在 2026、2027 或 2028 年高中毕业后入大学。Amy 现在升 8 年级，年纪/年级不够，不能现在报名；可把它作为 Wyzant tutor syllabus target。 学习目标不是拿一堆证书，而是让每个盒子的每一步都有理由。 04 导师地图 Wyzant 导师要找三类，不是一类。 R2 里的导师不是“替 Amy 做项目”，而是把高级概念拆成适合 8 年级理解、可以转化成设计的课程。 1 心理学 / 神经科学导师 教 neuroplasticity、学习科学、青少年社交连接和情绪支持。 边界：教育辅导，不做诊断或治疗。 2 逻辑 / 系统导师 把手工步骤转成 deductive logic、checklist 和 error-proof algorithm。 输出：清楚说明书和结构化任务卡。 3 统计 / 行为经济导师 教 present bias、choice architecture 和匿名 QR 反馈问卷设计。 只收产品反馈，不收临床数据。 给导师的标准说明：这是 student-led supportive activity-kit design，不是 therapy practice，也不是 medical study。 05 反馈系统 测设计体验，不测医疗结果。 R2 把“问卷调查系统”改成安全的产品反馈系统。它帮助判断盒子有没有被打开、说明是否清楚、完成后孩子是否更愿意继续，而不是判断病情。 问题 可问 不要问 用途 开始门槛 第一步是否容易看懂？ 你是否有抑郁诊断？ 改说明书 即时感受 完成后是否更平静 / 更清楚？ 病情有没有改善？ 改任务难度 环境匹配 更喜欢独自、双人还是集体？ 家庭冲突细节是什么？ 选择下一盒 继续意愿 愿不愿意做第二张卡？ 治疗效果几分？ 判断产品吸引力 1-2 min 问卷必须极短。 匿名 不收姓名、诊断、病史。 可选 孩子可以不填。 家长 / 学校 未成年人反馈需要批准。 06 安全合作 先让可信成年人看懂，再让项目走出去。 R2 的合作顺序是：家庭小试点、学校 counselor / teacher review、合规 donation、再考虑 nonprofit。不要一开始直接进入医院互动或公开 Amy 的个人经历。 学校路线 先让 counselor 或 trusted teacher 看项目定位。 可做 advisory activity、student showcase 或 wellness club。 优点是反馈快、风险低、可以保护隐私。 医院路线 先找 Child Life / donation office，不直接联系病人。 只送全新、可清洁、符合 wish list 的材料。 任何现场活动都需要医院 staff 审核。 隐私 不公开个人经历，除非 Amy 明确愿意且知道后果。 安全 材料无尖锐、无污染、无医疗承诺。 边界 不治疗、不诊断、不做临床研究。 07 90 天路线图 三天能开始，三个月要有可展示 pilot。 R2 把项目拆成可以执行的节奏：先整理、再打样、再试用、再总结。每一阶段都有交付物。 0-3 天 目标 确定 R2 页面、三盒定义、第一批课程和导师搜索词。 交付 项目页、Wyzant 消息、材料清单 v1。 1-2 周 目标 做出每盒一个纸面 / 材料 prototype。 交付 3 个 box mockup，3 张 activity card，1 份反馈表。 3-6 周 目标 让 3-5 个可信试用者体验，记录匿名产品反馈。 交付 问题清单、改版方向、照片记录和版本日志。 7-12 周 目标 做 10-20 个 sample boxes，准备 school / mentor review。 交付 展示页、1 页 summary、下一步合作邮件。 08 打样计划 先做高质感小批量，不急着做公司。 在中国打样的优势是材料和手工供应链丰富，但第一批不要追求复杂包装。最重要的是安全、清楚、可重复和可反馈。 10-20 第一批 sample boxes。数量够看出问题，又不会把预算压到太重。 材料 丝带、纸艺、磁吸木件、无尖锐工具、独立包装。 说明 一张 start card、一张 step card、一张 reflection card。 质量 每盒检查缺件、尖锐边缘、说明是否能独立看懂。 Box 01 低成本优先 纸艺和丝带适合快速测试说明清晰度。 Box 02 结构风险最高 磁吸和双人协作要重点测试安全与耐用。 Box 03 展示效果最好 模块墙适合学校展示和社区 pilot。 09 对外讲法 讲成一个清楚的学生项目，不讲成医疗承诺。 R2 的对外叙事要成熟，但不能夸大。最好的说法是：Amy 用自己的兴趣和学习，设计一套支持青少年情绪健康的活动礼盒，并用安全反馈改进。 30 秒 pitch 中文 Amy Project 是一个学生主导的支持性活动礼盒项目，把逻辑、心理学和高质感手作结合起来，帮助青少年从一个很小、很具体、可完成的行动开始。它不是治疗，也不收集医疗数据；第一阶段只做产品体验和安全反馈。 不要这样说 风险表达 不要 治疗青少年抑郁症。 不要 临床试验、医疗研究、疗效证明。 不要 让孩子提供诊断、病史或私人危机细节。 10 来源与下一步 资料够用，下一步是做出来。 R2 不是把所有资料都堆进来，而是保留行动需要的来源：课程、心理健康边界、行为激活、医院 donation、非营利要求。 Yale Online · The Science of Well-Being Yale 公开课入口，页面列出 Coursera 免费学习、YouTube 视频和可选付费证书。 Coursera · Terms of Use Coursera 使用条款说明 13 岁以下不能使用服务；Amy 未满 13 岁时应走家长监督 / YouTube 路线。 Coursera · Introduction to Psychology Paul Bloom 的心理学入门课，覆盖 perception、memory、decision-making、social behavior 等。 Duke / Coursera · Think Again Duke logic and critical-thinking sequence，适合练 informal logic 和 argument analysis。 Brilliant · Logic 交互式逻辑练习，可作为 daily puzzle habit，不等同大学证书。 Brilliant · Computer Science Brilliant 的 CS pathway 覆盖 algorithms、data structures 和 logic-oriented problem solving。 Open Yale Courses · PSYC 110 免费 lecture 版本，适合先试听，看 Amy 是否喜欢这个老师和课程节奏。 Coursera · Overcoming Cognitive Bias Madecraft 课程，适合快速学习常见 cognitive biases 和 everyday decision tools。 Yale / Coursera · Everyday Parenting Alan Kazdin 的行为改变工具课，可借鉴 reinforcement、phrasing 和 step design。 Harvard Online · Psychology of Blind Spots Mahzarin Banaji 课程，聚焦 hidden bias 和 intuitive decision-making。 Wesleyan / Coursera · Creating Behavioral Change 覆盖 motivational interviewing、behavioral activation 和 SMART goals；页面提示不能替代临床训练。 Harvard DCE · PSYC S-1609 Neuroscience of Learning course page；这是 4-credit Harvard Summer School 课程，现在适合作为 Wyzant syllabus target，不是 8 年级可直接报名的课。 Harvard DCE · PHIL S-12 Deductive Logic course page；可借鉴 argument structure、symbolic logic 和 formal deduction。 Harvard DCE · ECON S-1915 Neuroscience and Economic Decision-Making course page；2026 listing shows on-campus format and prerequisites. Harvard SSP · Eligibility Harvard Secondary School Program 2026 要求 2026/2027/2028 进入大学且 2026-06-20 前满 16 岁；Amy 现在升 8 年级，不符合。 Harvard EdCast · Crisis of Connection 关于 adolescent social connection 的 research discussion / interview，不是课程报名页面。 Wyzant · Find a Tutor Wyzant 搜索 / 请求导师说明；未成年人默认应由家长参与。 NIMH · Depression 严肃理解 depression 的基础资料，提醒项目不要替代专业治疗。 Kids Mental Health Foundation · Behavioral Activation 支持“小而有价值的活动”这个方向，但具体内容仍需专业审核。 OHSU Doernbecher · Wish List Portland 本地儿童医院 donation guideline：通常要求全新、未使用物品。 Oregon DOJ · Starting a Charity 如果未来走 charity / nonprofit 路线，这里是 Oregon charitable registration 的官方入口。 IRS · Responsible Parties and EIN EIN 需要 responsible party；涉及未成年人时不要自己乱填，先让父母或专业人士确认。 下一步：三盒 prototype、三张 activity card、一个匿名反馈表、一个 Wyzant 导师 shortlist。 00 Summary 01 Why 02 Boxes 03 Learning 04 Mentors 05 Feedback 06 Partners 07 Roadmap 08 Prototype 09 Narrative 10 Sources 00 Executive summary Design the first step out of feeling stuck. Amy Project R2 does not turn the original page into a business plan. It upgrades the idea into a report-style project framework that parents, mentors, and school partners can understand. The product is three activity boxes; the research-safe question is how activity type and social setting affect teens' willingness to start, express, and connect. 3 Boxes Solo, parent/teen, and community-grid settings test three different support environments. Learning track Psychology, logic, behavior change, design, and feedback surveys. Product track From craft prototypes to premium boxes and small-scale pilots. Partnership track Start with family and school, then consider hospital donation and nonprofit routes. Logic Clear structure Craft steps become low-error algorithms so teens do not have to guess the next step. Psychology Low barrier Behavioral activation becomes a small action that can be finished in 5-20 minutes. Art Safe expression Color, texture, shape, and story allow expression without forcing speech. One line: build a box teens actually want to open, then use safe feedback to decide whether it deserves to scale. 01 Why this Many teens do not lack insight. The first step is just too heavy. When someone feels low, the problem is often not a lack of advice. It is the absence of a small, safe, finishable entry point. Amy's advantage is understanding what that entry point might feel like from a kid's perspective. Pain point 1 Materials can feel like homework Many mental-health worksheets feel like assignments or evaluation before a teen even starts. Pain point 2 Expression is not always verbal A teen may be willing to make, draw, or assemble before being ready to explain feelings. Behavioral activation Start with a small action so action can bring back some energy and completion. Tactile art Use ribbon, wood, magnets, paper craft, and texture to lower the barrier. Logical structure Every step should be clear, verifiable, and finishable to reduce anxiety and quitting. The value is not claiming to cure depression. The value is designing a more startable, finishable, understandable support activity. 02 Three-box system One goal, three social settings. The boxes are not random products. They test three variables: alone, two-person collaboration, and individual modules joined into a group wall. 01 Solo Mastery Box Silk ribbon roses, botanical craft, and low-pressure folding. Goal: safety, control, completion. 02 Family Bridge Box Magnetic structures, geometric puzzles, two-person collaboration, and low-pressure conversation cards. Goal: shared focus and easier connection. 03 Collaborative Grid Box Each person completes one module, then adds it to a collective wall. Goal: low-pressure belonging and community connection. 20 x 20 x 20 rule R2 design constraint 20 minutes One stage can be completed within 20 minutes. 20 pieces Keep core pieces limited so complexity does not overwhelm the start. 20-second first step The first step must be understandable immediately. The rule does not limit creativity. It makes starting possible when energy is low. 03 Learning path Courses are not decoration. They justify the activity cards. R2 turns the summer into four learning tracks: psychology overview, logical structure, behavior change, and design feedback. Every week, at least one concept should become an activity card. Week 1 Psychology foundation Yale Intro Psychology builds vocabulary for behavior, memory, emotion, and social connection. Week 2 Logic reasoning Duke Think Again and Brilliant Logic help turn instructions into clear steps. Week 3 Behavior change Wesleyan Behavioral Change teaches action loops, motivation, and behavioral activation. Week 4 Cognitive bias Blind spots, attention bias, and attribution bias become assumption-check cards. Ongoing Design iteration Each concept becomes a box task, instruction page, or survey question. Eligibility: Yale Science of Well-Being The Yale Online page lists free Coursera access, YouTube videos, and an optional paid Coursera certificate. If Amy is 13 or older, she can study it with parent consent and supervision under Coursera rules. If she is under 13, she should not create her own Coursera account; use a parent-supervised account or the YouTube route. Eligibility: Harvard PSYC S-1609 The Harvard DCE course page lists this as a 4-credit Harvard Summer School course. Harvard Secondary School Program 2026 eligibility requires students to be at least 16 and entering college in 2026, 2027, or 2028. As a rising 8th grader, Amy is not eligible now; use it as a Wyzant tutor syllabus target or a future high-school option. The goal is not collecting certificates. The goal is giving every box step a reason. 04 Mentor map Use Wyzant for three mentor types, not one. Mentors do not build the project for Amy. They translate advanced ideas into middle-school-friendly lessons and design decisions. 1 Psychology / neuroscience mentor Teach neuroplasticity, learning science, adolescent social connection, and emotional support. Boundary: educational coaching, not diagnosis or treatment. 2 Logic / systems mentor Turn craft steps into deductive logic, checklists, and error-proof algorithms. Output: clear instructions and structured task cards. 3 Statistics / behavioral economics mentor Teach present bias, choice architecture, and anonymous QR feedback design. Collect product feedback only, not clinical data. Standard tutor language: this is student-led supportive activity-kit design, not therapy practice or a medical study. 05 Feedback system Measure design experience, not medical outcomes. R2 reframes the survey as a safe product-feedback system. It helps determine whether the box is opened, whether instructions are clear, and whether the teen is willing to continue. Question Ask Do not ask Use Start barrier Was the first step easy to understand? Do you have a depression diagnosis? Improve instructions Immediate feeling Do you feel calmer or clearer? Did your condition improve? Adjust difficulty Setting fit Do you prefer solo, pair, or group? What are your family conflict details? Choose next box Continuation Would you do a second card? How effective was treatment? Judge product appeal 1-2 min The survey must be very short. Anonymous No names, diagnoses, or medical history. Optional A teen can skip it. Parent / school Minor feedback needs approval. 06 Safety partners Make trusted adults understand it before taking it outside. R2's sequence is family micro-pilot, school counselor / teacher review, compliant donation, then maybe nonprofit. Do not start with direct hospital interaction or public disclosure of Amy's personal experience. School route Ask a counselor or trusted teacher to review positioning. Possible forms: advisory activity, student showcase, wellness club. Fast feedback and lower risk while protecting privacy. Hospital route Start with Child Life / donation office, not patients directly. Donate only new, cleanable, wish-list-compatible materials. Any on-site activity requires hospital staff review. Privacy Do not publicize personal experience unless Amy clearly wants that and understands the consequences. Safety Materials must avoid sharp edges, contamination, and medical promises. Boundary No treatment, diagnosis, or clinical research claims. 07 90-day roadmap Start in three days. Show a pilot in three months. R2 breaks the project into a practical rhythm: organize, prototype, test, summarize. Each phase has a deliverable. 0-3 days Goal Finalize R2 page, three-box definitions, first courses, and tutor search terms. Deliverable Project page, Wyzant message, materials list v1. 1-2 weeks Goal Build one paper / material prototype for each box. Deliverable 3 box mockups, 3 activity cards, 1 feedback form. 3-6 weeks Goal Let 3-5 trusted users try them and record anonymous product feedback. Deliverable Issue list, revision direction, photo record, and version log. 7-12 weeks Goal Make 10-20 sample boxes and prepare for school / mentor review. Deliverable Showcase page, 1-page summary, next-step partner email. 08 Prototype plan Make a high-quality small batch before building an organization. Manufacturing prototypes in China can help with materials and craft supply chains, but the first batch should not overfocus on packaging complexity. Safety, clarity, repeatability, and feedback matter more. 10-20 first sample boxes. Enough to see problems without making budget or logistics too heavy. Materials Ribbon, paper craft, magnetic wood pieces, no sharp tools, individual packaging. Instructions One start card, one step card, one reflection card. Quality Check missing pieces, sharp edges, and whether instructions make sense alone. Box 01 Lowest cost first Paper craft and ribbon are good for quickly testing instruction clarity. Box 02 Highest structure risk Magnetic parts and two-person collaboration need more safety and durability testing. Box 03 Best showcase effect The module wall is strong for school showcase and community pilots. 09 Public narrative Present it as a clear student project, not a medical promise. The R2 narrative should be mature without overclaiming: Amy is using her interests and learning to design supportive activity boxes for teen well-being, then improving them through safe feedback. 30-second pitch English Amy Project is a student-led supportive activity-kit project combining logic, psychology, and high-quality craft. It helps teens begin with a very small, concrete, finishable action. It is not treatment and does not collect medical data; the first stage focuses only on product experience and safe feedback. Do not say this Risk language Do not Treat teen depression. Do not Clinical trial, medical research, proven effect. Do not Ask minors for diagnosis, medical history, or private crisis details. 10 Sources & next steps The source stack is enough. Now build. R2 keeps only the sources needed for action: courses, mental-health boundaries, behavioral activation, hospital donation, and nonprofit requirements. Yale Online · The Science of Well-Being Yale public-course entry point; the page lists free Coursera access, YouTube videos, and an optional paid certificate. Coursera · Terms of Use Coursera's terms prohibit use by anyone under 13; if Amy is under 13, use a parent-supervised or YouTube route. Coursera · Introduction to Psychology Paul Bloom's psychology introduction covering perception, memory, decision-making, social behavior, and more. Duke / Coursera · Think Again Duke's logic and critical-thinking sequence, useful for informal logic and argument analysis. Brilliant · Logic Interactive logic practice that can become a daily puzzle habit; not the same as a university certificate. Brilliant · Computer Science Brilliant's CS pathway covers algorithms, data structures, and logic-oriented problem solving. Open Yale Courses · PSYC 110 Free lecture version, good for previewing whether Amy likes the teacher and course rhythm. Coursera · Overcoming Cognitive Bias Madecraft course for common cognitive biases and everyday decision tools. Yale / Coursera · Everyday Parenting Alan Kazdin's behavior-change tools course; useful for reinforcement, phrasing, and step design. Harvard Online · Psychology of Blind Spots Mahzarin Banaji's course focused on hidden bias and intuitive decision-making. Wesleyan / Coursera · Creating Behavioral Change Covers motivational interviewing, behavioral activation, and SMART goals; the page notes it does not replace clinical training. Harvard DCE · PSYC S-1609 Neuroscience of Learning course page; this is a 4-credit Harvard Summer School course, so use it now as a Wyzant syllabus target, not direct 8th-grade enrollment. Harvard DCE · PHIL S-12 Deductive Logic course page; useful for argument structure, symbolic logic, and formal deduction. Harvard DCE · ECON S-1915 Neuroscience and Economic Decision-Making course page; the 2026 listing shows on-campus format and prerequisites. Harvard SSP · Eligibility For 2026, SSP requires entering college in 2026/2027/2028 and being at least 16 by June 20, 2026; Amy is not eligible as a rising 8th grader. Harvard EdCast · Crisis of Connection Research discussion / interview source for adolescent social connection, not a course enrollment page. Wyzant · Find a Tutor Wyzant support page for searching/requesting tutors; parent involvement is the right default for a minor. NIMH · Depression Foundational material for understanding depression; it helps keep the project from replacing professional treatment. Kids Mental Health Foundation · Behavioral Activation Supports small, valuable activities as a direction; specific kit content still needs professional review. OHSU Doernbecher · Wish List Portland local children's hospital donation guideline; usually requires new, unused items. Oregon DOJ · Starting a Charity If the future path is charity / nonprofit, this is the official Oregon charitable registration entry point. IRS · Responsible Parties and EIN An EIN requires a responsible party; when minors are involved, confirm with parents or professionals first. Next: three box prototypes, three activity cards, one anonymous feedback form, and one Wyzant mentor shortlist. Amy Summer Project | MindSpark Boxes A Amy Summer Project Idea Boxes Learning Course Menu 中文蓝图 Partners Roadmap Sources 中文 EN Private draft · Summer before 8th grade Amy’s MindSpark Box Lab 把三个很爱的东西， logic 、 psychology 、 art / design ，
          做成可以帮助孩子从低落里动起来的小盒子。 从想法到行动 从自己有用到帮助别人 从一盒样品到一个 youth-led project 定位先写清楚：这不是治疗，也不替代医生、therapist 或药物。它是一个由孩子视角设计的支持性活动盒，核心是用小而具体的任务、创作和连接，给孩子一点点可完成、可表达、可分享的力量。 Prototype bench L Logic Kit 谜题、推理、mini experiment。给大脑一个可以赢的小挑战。 P Psychology Kit 情绪卡、行为激活、why people do things。把感受变成可以观察的东西。 A Art Kit 故事、颜色、sketch、box design。让表达不一定要靠讲话。 3 兴趣方向合成一个项目 3 第一批 experimental boxes 90 天内做出可测试 pilot What this is 把今天的想法先固定下来。 这页不是最终答案，是 project memory。先把散开的语音想法变成同一个地方，之后每次有新想法都往这里加，再慢慢变成作品、课程计划、合作邮件和项目申请材料。 一句话版本 Amy wants to build creative activity boxes that use logic, psychology and art to help kids feel a little more capable, connected and understood. 为什么这个项目值得做 Amy 自己经历过低落和恢复，所以不是从外面“研究别人”，而是从真实体验出发。 很多大人设计给孩子的心理健康材料太像说明书；孩子做给孩子，可能更真、更容易被打开。 逻辑、心理学、美术三个方向不是分散爱好，可以组合成一个能展示、能测试、能扩大的 summer project。 1 先帮助自己 用这个项目整理：什么活动真的让我动起来、变平静、变有成就感。 2 再帮助别人 把有效的方法做成别人也能打开、理解、完成的小盒子。 3 最后变成组织 如果 pilot 有效果，再考虑 school club、hospital partnership 或 nonprofit。 First product map 三种 experimental boxes。 名字先用 draft。每盒都应该小、干净、安全、容易完成，避免任何会被医院拒收的材料。所有临床相关措辞都让专业人员审过再使用。 Box 01 · 一个人也能做 Solo Mastery 给低能量状态里的孩子一个小胜利。不是“振作起来”，而是一个 5-15 分钟能完成的具体动作。 logic puzzles tiny wins behavior activation 放什么 推理卡、进度贴纸、低门槛手工 帮什么 打破“什么都不想做”的循环 测试指标 孩子是否愿意完成第一个任务 Box 02 · 不一定要硬聊 Connection Lab 帮助孩子和父母、朋友、counselor 或 group 有一点点更容易开始的连接。 question cards shared task low pressure 放什么 问题卡、合作小游戏、感谢卡 帮什么 从沉默到一个可以说出口的点 测试指标 是否让一次对话更容易开始 Box 03 · 表达不只靠说话 Story & Art 让孩子用颜色、角色、故事和图像表达自己，不要求一开始就讲清楚。 sketchbook story prompts identity design 放什么 spiral-free journal、画笔、故事模板 帮什么 把乱的感觉变成能看的作品 测试指标 作品完成后心情是否更可描述 第一批盒子的设计原则 每一盒只解决一个小问题：开始行动、开始表达、开始连接。 每个任务都要有完成感，不要像作业，不要需要很强的解释能力。 材料必须干净、全新、无尖锐风险、无医疗承诺，符合医院 donation guideline。 不直接收集孩子隐私；反馈只收匿名、简单、可选的信息。 要避免的坑 不要写“治疗 depression”或“治愈焦虑”。 不要把 Amy 的个人经历公开化，除非 Amy 明确愿意并知道后果。 不要直接进入医院和病人互动，先走 Child Life / counselor / parent approval。 不要一开始就做太复杂的 subscription business；先证明一个盒子真的有人愿意打开。 Learning stack 这个夏天要学什么。 课程优先选权威、可远程、可按自己的速度学的。付费 tutor 可以作为补充，但第一步先用高质量公开课程建立框架。 Psychology questions Amy wants to explore People：人为什么做他们做的事？为什么有人喜欢可爱风格，有人喜欢运动，有人喜欢安静？ Mind reading：别人说出来的话和心里想的一样吗？微表情、身体语言能不能帮助理解？ Kids：小孩的 sadness、depression、happiness 是怎么发生的？什么活动能让人从低落里出来一点？ Design：怎样把心理学做成孩子愿意玩的东西，而不是大人写的 worksheet？ Suggested course path Yale / Coursera: The Science of Well-Being for Teens 或成人版，理解 happiness habits。 Yale / Coursera 或 Open Yale: Introduction to Psychology，建立 psychology 大图谱。 选 1 门 live teen class 或 tutor：专攻 child psychology、emotion、microexpression 或 product design。 每周把学到的一个概念变成一个盒子里的 activity card。 Logic track 目标不是刷题，而是设计“能让人有成就感”的小挑战。可以从谜题、pattern、game theory、decision-making 开始。 Art / design track 学习 packaging、color psychology、illustration、story prompts。盒子本身要像一个 invitation，不像一个病历表。 STEM box model Mark Rober / CrunchLabs 的价值是“把复杂知识变成孩子愿意打开的盒子”。可以学习它的 engagement，不必照抄它的内容。 Summer launch menu Official courses + Wyzant mentor tracks. 先用 Coursera / Brilliant 立刻开始，再用 Wyzant 找 tutor 把 Harvard-level topics 拆成适合 8 年级的 syllabus。重点不是“神秘读心”，而是注意偏差、行为奖励、盲点判断、逻辑结构和动机设计。 Official University Platforms Amy can start now These are the broad, on-demand foundations. They are useful for learning and portfolio evidence, but the project should describe them accurately as online courses or guided platforms, not as direct enrollment in the universities. Yale Coursera Paul Bloom psych foundation Introduction to Psychology Search: “Introduction to Psychology Yale.” Broad overview of behavior, memory, development, emotion, social psychology, clinical psychology, and happiness. Project use: gives Amy the vocabulary to explain why logic, habit, feeling, and social connection belong in the same box project. Duke Coursera Think Again informal logic Think Again: How to Reason and Argue Search: “Think Again Duke.” This is the Coursera / Duke logic and critical-thinking sequence: claims, reasons, assumptions, validity, and fallacies. Project use: helps convert “craft instructions” into clear if/then steps and helps Amy spot when a workbook prompt is confusing or logically overloaded. Brilliant Logic CS pathways interactive Logic & Computational Thinking Pathways Search inside Brilliant for “Logic” and “Computer Science.” Use visual puzzles, algorithms, conditionals, and structured problem solving as daily practice. Project use: trains the “20 x 20 x 20” kit rule: 20 minutes, 20 pieces or fewer, first step understandable in 20 seconds. Coursera Madecraft 4 hours bias toolkit Overcoming Cognitive Bias 学 confirmation bias、hindsight bias、attribution bias、availability bias、inattentional blindness、anchoring 和 blind spot bias。它适合快速建立“脑子会怎样自动走偏”的 vocabulary。 Box use: 给 Logic Kit 做“what did I miss?” 小卡片，让孩子练习把注意力从单一负面线索移开，去找事实、例外和下一步。 Guardrail: 不能说 depression “本质上就是” inattentional blindness。更准确：低落状态可能伴随注意偏差和负面过滤，但 depression 是多因素问题。 Yale Coursera Alan Kazdin behavior shaping Everyday Parenting: The ABCs of Child Rearing 表面是 parenting，核心是行为改变工具：antecedents、positive reinforcement、tone、phrasing、practice、shaping，以及什么时候需要专业帮助。 Box use: 设计 instruction booklet，让第一个动作非常小、非常清楚，并且完成后马上有可见 reward，不靠大人说教。 Guardrail: 这不是让 Amy “治疗别人”或当 ABA practitioner；它是学习如何把说明、反馈和环境设计得更友善。 Harvard Online Mahzarin Banaji leaders / teams hidden bias Make Better Decisions: The Psychology of Blind Spots 这门课研究 hidden bias 和 intuitive decision-making：我们怎样在不自觉中形成判断，怎样误读他人，怎样让 decision process 减少盲点。 Box use: 给 Connection Lab 做 parent/teen “assumption check” 卡片：我以为你在想什么？证据是什么？还有没有另一个解释？ Guardrail: 它更偏成人 leadership training，可能贵；对 Amy 来说可以让 tutor 提炼核心概念，不一定要马上上完整课。 Wesleyan Coursera Alexis May motivation loops Creating Behavioral Change 覆盖 classical / operant conditioning、motivational interviewing、CBT 基础、behavioral activation、SMART goals 和 relapse prevention。它最贴近“怎样从卡住到开始动”。 Box use: 给 Solo Mastery 做 20 x 20 x 20 craft constraints：20 分钟内、20 个以内零件、20 秒内看懂第一步，让行动门槛低到可以开始。 Guardrail: Coursera 页面明确说这门课不会训练你给别人实施心理干预；项目只能做 supportive design，不能做 therapy claim。 Best starting order Wesleyan Creating Behavioral Change：先学 action loop 和 behavioral activation。 Yale Everyday Parenting：再学 reward、phrasing、step design。 Overcoming Cognitive Bias：补齐 attention / judgment vocabulary。 Harvard Blind Spots：作为 advanced framework，让 tutor 帮忙拆概念。 Wyzant message draft I want to study cognitive bias, blind spots, behavioral modification, motivation, and behavioral activation in a research-safe way. My goal is not to practice therapy. I want to design supportive craft/activity kits for teens that encourage tiny actions, reflection, and connection. Can you help me turn ideas from Harvard's Psychology of Blind Spots, Yale's Everyday Parenting, Wesleyan's Creating Behavioral Change, and cognitive-bias frameworks into age-appropriate activity-card experiments? Wyzant mentor tracks using Harvard course names as syllabus targets Harvard Secondary School Program courses are college-level and have age / grade eligibility rules. For 8th grade, use these course names as a search and tutoring map, with a parent managing the Wyzant account and sitting close to the process. Track 1 Neuroscience Clinical psychology social connection Mind & Social Environment Specialist Wyzant search terms: “Neuroscience,” “Clinical Psychology,” “Adolescent Psychology,” “Social Psychology.” Harvard target topics: PSYC S-1609 Neuroscience of Learning and youth social-connection frameworks. Safe message: “Hi, I am an 8th grader building a student-led supportive art/activity kit project around teen well-being. I am not practicing therapy or conducting clinical research. Can you teach me neuroplasticity, learning science, and adolescent social connection in a way I can turn into safe reflection/activity cards?” Track 2 Symbolic logic Formal logic systems design Logic & Systems Specialist Wyzant search terms: “Symbolic Logic,” “Formal Logic,” “Mathematical Logic,” “Philosophy.” Harvard target topic: PHIL S-12 Deductive Logic. Safe message: “Hi, I want help turning real-world craft instructions, like ribbon folding or box assembly, into clear logical algorithms and error-proof checklists for activity kits. Can you teach me deductive logic and structured proof-style thinking at a middle-school-friendly pace?” Track 3 Behavioral economics Statistics survey design Choice & Data Specialist Wyzant search terms: “Behavioral Economics,” “Statistics,” “Survey Design,” “Neuroeconomics.” Harvard target topic: ECON S-1915 Neuroscience and Economic Decision-Making. Safe message: “Hi, I want to learn cognitive biases like present bias and design a simple anonymous QR-code feedback form for a summer activity-kit prototype. I am not collecting clinical data; I only need product feedback such as clarity, energy, and willingness to continue.” Tutor filter: pick someone who can teach advanced ideas to a middle-school student, will stay within educational coaching, and is comfortable with parent involvement. Do not ask a tutor to diagnose, treat, supervise therapy, or run a medical study. Mandarin project blueprint 行为激活设计实验。 这是给中文沟通、制造打样、导师协作和国际展示使用的专业版表述。项目可以借鉴心理学、逻辑学和行为选择理论，但必须写清楚：这是非临床、学生主导的支持性活动礼盒设计探索，不是治疗方案、医疗研究或临床试验。 项目名称 行为激活设计实验 The Behavioral Activation Design Experiment supportive activity kits logic structure tactile art anonymous feedback 核心使命 将行为激活的基本思想——通过小而清楚、有结构、有完成感的活动，帮助人从低能量和反复消极思绪中迈出一步——转化为高质感、可打样、可反馈的个人手作支持礼盒。 安全边界：页面和对外材料不应声称“治疗青少年抑郁症”。更准确的说法是：支持青少年情绪健康、提升行动感、表达感和连接感。 心理学框架 参考行为激活、青少年社会连接、学习科学和注意偏差。核心问题是：什么样的小活动更容易让孩子开始行动、继续完成，并愿意表达自己的感受？ 逻辑学框架 参考 Harvard PHIL S-12 一类的演绎逻辑和结构化推理，把手作步骤设计成清楚、可验证、低错误率的算法。 选择与设计框架 参考 behavioral economics、choice architecture 和 cognitive bias，研究材料、顺序、反馈和社交环境如何影响孩子是否愿意继续。 20 x 20 x 20 规则：20 分钟内能完成一个阶段；20 个以内核心零件；20 秒内看懂第一步。目标不是强迫进入“心流”，而是降低开始门槛，让完成感自然出现。 礼盒 1 · 安全地带 独立掌控礼盒 以真丝丝带玫瑰、植物花艺和精细折叠为主，适合孩子在安静、熟悉、可控的空间里独立完成。 设计目标 安全感、掌控感、完成感 适用情境 低能量、想独处、需要安静任务 反馈问题 第一步是否容易开始？完成后是否更平静？ 礼盒 2 · 家庭之桥 互动指尖解压礼盒 以磁吸木质结构、几何拼图或链环结构为主，设计成低压力双人协作模型。 设计目标 共同专注、低压力对话、关系修复 适用情境 亲子沟通卡住，但仍愿意一起做事 反馈问题 合作是否降低尴尬？对话卡是否自然？ 礼盒 3 · 社交网络破局 协作网格礼盒 以模块化 3D 几何马赛克或纸艺瓷砖为主，每个人独立完成一块，再在学校、club 或经批准的社区活动中拼成集体作品。 设计目标 独立贡献、社区连接、可见归属感 适用情境 想参与集体，但不想被迫社交 反馈问题 是否更愿意带作品加入集体墙？ 反馈系统：设计验证，不是临床试验 每个礼盒附一张高质感反馈卡，用二维码进入 1-2 分钟匿名问卷。 测量自我报告的即时感受变化，例如更清楚、更平静、更愿意继续，而不是生物指标或医疗结果。 记录哪种环境更匹配：独立完成、亲子协作、社区拼接。 不收姓名、诊断、病史或敏感健康信息；未成年人反馈需要 parent / school / partner approval。 给 Wyzant 导师的中文版本 我正在做一个面向青少年情绪健康的学生主导支持性活动礼盒项目，不是临床治疗或医疗研究。我希望学习哈佛水平的神经科学、逻辑学和行为选择理论，把它们转化成安全、适龄、可执行的手作说明书、对话卡和匿名反馈问卷。您能否帮助我把高级概念拆成适合 8 年级学生理解和设计的课程计划？ Partner map 先从安全、可信的合作开始。 医院是最终方向之一，但第一个 pilot 更适合从家庭、school counselor、老师或小型 youth group 开始。医院 donation 需要严格遵守物品、隐私、感染控制和访问规则。 School route 找 counselor / Ben 先聊项目定位。 可做成 wellness club、student showcase 或 advisory activity。 优点：反馈快，风险低，Amy 不需要一开始公开太多私人经历。 Hospital route 先联系 Child Life / donation office，不直接联系病人。 只送全新、可清洁、符合 wish list 的活动材料。 如果未来要带活动，需要医院 staff 审核和现场安排。 Nonprofit route 短期可以先做 family project 或 fiscal sponsor，不急着注册。 如果注册 nonprofit，Oregon Secretary of State、Oregon DOJ、IRS EIN / 501(c)(3) 都要处理。 未成年人和银行、税务、签字责任相关问题，需要父母或专业人士确认。 最聪明的起点：先做 3 个 prototype，找 3-5 个可信的人试用，拿到反馈，再决定是走 school、hospital donation，还是 nonprofit。 From scattered idea to real project 三天、三个月、一年。 Amy 说想 quick，因为快回中国了。这里把节奏切成能立刻开始的动作。 今晚 把想法整理到这个页面。 定 project working name。 列出三盒 prototype。 接下来 3 天 注册 Coursera，试听 Yale Intro Psych 和 Duke Think Again。 和 parent 一起建 Wyzant 搜索清单，发 3 条安全版 tutor message。 列第一批材料清单和预算。 夏天 3 个月 每两周做一轮盒子版本。 每周学一个 psychology concept。 完成 10-20 个 sample boxes。 8 年级 学校展示或小型 club。 收集匿名 feedback。 建立小 team，而不是一个人扛全部。 高中前 申请 summer program。 决定是否注册 nonprofit。 把项目做成 portfolio 和真实 impact story。 Current references 可以马上看的资源。 这些不是最终背书，只是第一轮可靠入口。课程、捐赠和非营利要求会变化，行动前再查一次。 Yale Online · The Science of Well-Being Yale 公开课入口，适合从 happiness habits 和心理学实验开始。 Coursera · Introduction to Psychology Paul Bloom 的心理学入门课，覆盖 perception、memory、decision-making、social behavior 等。 Duke / Coursera · Think Again Coursera 上的 Duke logic and critical-thinking sequence，适合练 informal logic 和 argument analysis。 Brilliant · Logic 交互式逻辑练习，可作为 daily puzzle habit，不等同大学证书。 Brilliant · Computer Science Brilliant 的 CS pathway 覆盖 algorithms、data structures 和 logic-oriented problem solving。 Open Yale Courses · PSYC 110 免费 lecture 版本，适合先试听，看 Amy 是否喜欢这个老师和课程节奏。 Coursera · Overcoming Cognitive Bias Madecraft 课程，适合快速学习常见 cognitive biases 和 everyday decision tools。 Yale / Coursera · Everyday Parenting Alan Kazdin 的行为改变工具课，可借鉴 reinforcement、phrasing 和 step design。 Harvard Online · Psychology of Blind Spots Mahzarin Banaji 课程，聚焦 hidden bias 和 intuitive decision-making。 Wesleyan / Coursera · Creating Behavioral Change 覆盖 motivational interviewing、behavioral activation 和 SMART goals；页面提示不能替代临床训练。 Harvard DCE · PSYC S-1609 Neuroscience of Learning course page；适合作为 Wyzant tutor syllabus target，不是 8 年级 on-demand 课。 Harvard DCE · PHIL S-12 Deductive Logic course page；可借鉴 argument structure、symbolic logic 和 formal deduction。 Harvard DCE · ECON S-1915 Neuroscience and Economic Decision-Making course page；2026 listing shows on-campus format and prerequisites. Harvard SSP · Eligibility Harvard Secondary School Program eligibility page；use to avoid assuming middle-school direct enrollment. Harvard EdCast · Crisis of Connection Research discussion / interview source for adolescent social connection, not a course enrollment page. Wyzant · Find a Tutor Wyzant support page for searching/requesting tutors; parent involvement is the right default for a minor. NIMH · Depression 严肃理解 depression 的基础资料，提醒项目不要替代专业治疗。 Kids Mental Health Foundation · Behavioral Activation 支持“小而有价值的活动”这个方向，但具体内容仍需专业审核。 OHSU Doernbecher · Wish List Portland 本地儿童医院 donation guideline：通常要求全新、未使用物品。 Oregon DOJ · Starting a Charity 如果未来走 charity / nonprofit 路线，这里是 Oregon charitable registration 的官方入口。 IRS · Responsible Parties and EIN EIN 需要 responsible party；涉及未成年人时不要自己乱填，先让父母或专业人士确认。 Drafted from the June 2026 Amy Project conversation. Private local page. Public sharing requires Amy and parent approval.

records.text: AI实现方案与数据安全 | AI Implementation & Data Security ← 返回主页 Back 中文 EN 🔒 DATA SECURITY · 2026.04 AI实现方案 AI Implementation 与数据安全 & Data Security NVIDIA NIM vs 智谱GLM-5.1 vs DeepSeek 私有化部署对比 · 半导体CVD工艺AI化的安全基石 NVIDIA NIM vs Zhipu GLM-5.1 vs DeepSeek private deployment comparison · Security foundation for AI-powered CVD optimization 01 数据安全：半导体AI化的首要挑战 Data Security: #1 Challenge for Semiconductor AI 🔴 CVD工艺数据涉及最高级别商业机密 🔴 CVD Process Data Involves Highest-Level Trade Secrets FDC时序数据 （设备参数）→ 暴露工艺配方和设备性能 FDC time-series data (equipment params) → Exposes recipes and equipment performance 量测数据 （厚度/均匀性/particle）→ 核心良率IP Metrology data (thickness/uniformity/particle) → Core yield IP 缺陷模式 → 可推断竞争对手工艺路线和技术水平 Defect patterns → Can infer competitor process routes and tech level 上下游数据共享 （靶材/特气/零部件）→ 跨企业数据合规难题 Supply chain data sharing (targets/gas/parts) → Cross-enterprise compliance challenge ⚠️ 云端API=数据出境 Cloud API = Data leaves 0 数据外泄容忍度 Data leak tolerance 3+ 涉及企业方 Parties involved 02 AI部署方案全景对比 AI Deployment Solutions Comparison 维度 Dimension 🏆 智谱GLM-5.1本地 GLM-5.1 Local NVIDIA NIM DeepSeek 本地 Local OpenAI API 数据位置 Data Location ✓ 完全本地 Fully local ✓ 本地/私有云 Local/private ✓ 完全本地 Fully local ✗ 美国云端 US cloud 安全等级 Security ★★★★★ ★★★★★ ★★★★★ ★★★☆☆ GPU要求 GPU 国产/进口均可 Domestic/import OK 仅NVIDIA NVIDIA only 国产/进口均可 Domestic/import OK 无需 None 最低硬件 Min Hardware 1× 昇腾310P或RTX4090 Ascend310P or RTX4090 1×A100 80G 1×RTX 4090 (24G) N/A 部署费用 Deploy Cost ¥3-50万 ¥20-80万 ¥5-20万 按量 Per-use 年许可 License 企业版按需 Enterprise on-demand ~$4500/GPU/ 年 yr 开源免费 Open source 按token Per-token 禁运风险 Ban Risk 无 None 高 High 无 None 高 High 中文能力 Chinese ★★★★★ ★★★☆☆ ★★★★★ ★★★★☆ 技术支持 Support 智谱原厂 Zhipu direct NVIDIA 社区为主 Community OpenAI 数据来源：NVIDIA官网(2025.06)、智谱BigModel.cn定价页(2026.04)、DeepSeek API(2026.04)。调研时间：2026.04.30 Sources: NVIDIA.com (Jun 2025), Zhipu BigModel.cn pricing (Apr 2026), DeepSeek API (Apr 2026). Researched: 2026.04.30 03 推荐方案 Recommended Solution 🏆 首选：智谱GLM-5.1 本地私有化部署 Top Pick: Zhipu GLM-5.1 Local Private Deployment 数据零外泄 ：所有计算在企业内网完成，数据不出边界 Zero data leakage : All computation within enterprise intranet, data never leaves 支持国产GPU （华为昇腾910B/310P）→ 不受美国出口管制影响 Domestic GPU support (Huawei Ascend 910B/310P) → Not affected by US export controls GLM-5-7B量化版 → 1×消费级GPU即可运行 → Phase 0仅¥3-5万 启动 GLM-5-7B quantized → 1×consumer GPU → Phase 0 only ¥30-50K to start 智谱85%收入来自本地化部署（2025H1财报）→ 成熟的私有化交付能力 Zhipu 85% revenue from local deployment (2025H1) → Mature private deployment capability GLM-5 MoE架构(744B/40B激活) → 性能接近GPT-4级，中文能力强 GLM-5 MoE (744B/40B active) → Near GPT-4 level performance, strong Chinese 无禁运断供风险，国产自主可控 No ban/disruption risk, domestically controllable 💰 预算估算（2026.04） Budget Estimate (2026.04) Phase 0 ：1×RTX4090 + GLM-5-7B → ¥3-5万 Phase 0 : 1×RTX4090 + GLM-5-7B → ¥30-50K Phase 1 ：1×昇腾910B + GLM-5-40B → ¥15-30万 Phase 1 : 1×Ascend910B + GLM-5-40B → ¥150-300K Phase 2 ：+许可+部署服务 → +¥10-20万 Phase 2 : +License+deployment → +¥100-200K 🔄 备选：DeepSeek本地 Alt: DeepSeek Local 完全开源免费，零许可成本 Fully open source, zero license cost R1-32B量化后1×RTX4090可运行 R1-32B quantized runs on 1×RTX4090 适合"先用起来"快速验证 Good for "start now" quick validation 局限：推理能力略低于GLM-5，技术支持不成熟 Limit: Reasoning slightly below GLM-5, less mature support ⚡ NVIDIA NIM NVIDIA NIM 企业级安全、稳定性最佳 Best enterprise security & stability 但需NVIDIA GPU，存在禁运风险 Requires NVIDIA GPU, ban risk exists 年许可费较高（~$4500/GPU/年） Higher annual license (~$4500/GPU/yr) 适合预算充足+GPU不受限场景 For well-funded + GPU-unrestricted scenarios 04 数据安全架构 Data Security Architecture 📡 传感器/FDC Sensors/FDC → 🔐 边缘网关(加密) Edge Gateway → 💾 本地数据湖 Local Data Lake → 🧠 本地AI(GLM-5) Local AI(GLM-5) → 📊 结果Dashboard Dashboard ↕ 联邦学习/安全多方计算（数据不出本地） Federated Learning / SMPC (data stays local) ↕ 🔬 靶材供应商 Target Vendor 💨 特气供应商 Gas Vendor 🔧 零部件供应商 Parts Vendor 05 联邦学习：解决上下游数据共享难题 Federated Learning: Solving Cross-Enterprise Data Sharing 什么是联邦学习？ What is Federated Learning? 各方 数据不出本地 ，只交换模型梯度（数学参数）。在不泄露工艺细节的前提下实现联合优化。类似于多位专家各自研究后分享"结论"而非"原始数据"。 Each party's data stays local , only model gradients (math parameters) are exchanged. Joint optimization without exposing process details. Like experts sharing "conclusions" rather than "raw data". 联邦学习方案详情 Federated Learning Details 项目 Item 详情 Details 技术框架 Framework FATE （微众银行开源） (WeBank open-source) / SecretFlow Ant Group SecretFlow 成熟度 Maturity 2025-2026已有工业级方案，金融/医疗行业已大规模应用 Industrial-grade since 2025-2026, widely deployed in finance/healthcare 部署成本 Cost ¥10-30万 （联邦学习平台+安全网关） (federated learning platform + security gateway) 适用场景 Use Case 靶材-CVD联合优化、特气-缺陷关联分析、跨fab良率benchmark Target-CVD joint optimization, gas-defect correlation, cross-fab yield benchmark 安全保障 Security 差分隐私+同态加密+安全聚合，三方审计 Differential privacy + homomorphic encryption + secure aggregation, third-party audit 06 安全合规建议 Security & Compliance Recommendations 数据分级 ：将CVD工艺数据按敏感度分级（公开→内部→机密→绝密），AI系统仅访问必需层级 Data Classification : Classify CVD data by sensitivity (public→internal→confidential→top-secret), AI only accesses necessary levels 访问控制 ：RBAC角色权限+完整审计日志，所有AI操作可追溯 Access Control : RBAC + full audit logs, all AI operations traceable 数据脱敏 ：模型训练前对设备序列号、配方参数脱敏处理 Data Anonymization : Anonymize device serial numbers and recipe params before training 合规框架 ：遵循《数据安全法》《个人信息保护法》，半导体数据纳入关键信息基础设施管理 Compliance : Follow Data Security Law & PIPL, semiconductor data managed as critical information infrastructure 供应商协议 ：NDA + 数据安全协议 + 审计权利 + 违约赔偿条款 Vendor Agreements : NDA + data security protocol + audit rights + breach compensation clauses 定期安全审计 ：每季度对AI系统进行安全评估，包括数据流追踪和权限审查 Regular Audits : Quarterly security assessment of AI systems, including data flow tracing and permission review · AI实现方案与数据安全 · 数据调研时间：2026.04.30 · AI Implementation & Data Security · Data researched: 2026.04.30 参考：NVIDIA NIM官网(2025.06)、智谱BigModel.cn(2026.04)、DeepSeek API(2026.04)、OFweek智谱分析(2026.03)、七牛云GLM-5部署指南(2026.02) Refs: NVIDIA NIM (Jun 2025), Zhipu BigModel.cn (Apr 2026), DeepSeek API (Apr 2026), OFweek Zhipu analysis (Mar 2026), Qiniu GLM-5 deploy guide (Feb 2026) ← 返回CVD优化主页 Back to CVD Optimization

About the Project · Domic Home Passport D Domic HOME PASSPORT Receipt workspace About this project AI test report ↗ EN 中文 Project brief · 12 Sep 2026 PRODUCT BRIEF / PARTNER HANDOFF Turn receipts into your home's history. Domic Home Passport · First iteration, research, and next steps Try the prototype → Live AI reading is now connected through OpenRouter, using Gemini
          3.1 Flash Lite by default. Image and PDF reading have been tested,
          including a PDF in the deployed website. Review and confirmation are
          still required; records stay in this browser. Shared accounts, a
          shared property database and production integration remain next steps. Live AI results & screenshots ↗ Updated intake & tests 01 Project history 02 Current scope 03 Output format 04 Models and costs 05 User flow 06 System and APIs 07 GitHub references 08 Next steps 09 Handoff materials 01 / CONTEXT Domic Home Passport: from receipts to property history The confirmed product name is Domic Home Passport . This is the receipt module
              of the original Home Passport project. The partner is Daniel Zhu . The aim is to build a lasting record
              of repairs, improvements, equipment, and warranties, with service
              documents from ProLynk. Milestone Recovered context How it informs this iteration May 2026 A digital property passport accepting ProLynk documents,
                      emails, and manually uploaded PDFs, organized in a
                      property timeline. Keep property association and service history at the
                      center of the product. June 2026 Gemini 2.5 Flash, model tests, human confirmation, and a
                      proposed Next.js / Supabase / R2 stack. Keep the model replaceable, with an independent output
                      contract and clearly defined backend interfaces. Original Receipt Scanner Upload → edit → preview → save. Records were stored only
                      in browser localStorage. The new prototype clearly identifies local storage and
                      retains original files. A real database comes next. The historical tests eventually produced readable results for 13 PDFs : 12 were read
              directly as PDFs; one used its text layer after a 503 error. Most
              were blank templates, and only three had relatively complete
              amounts. This does not establish accuracy on real receipts. The
              new format removes zero values for unknown amounts, automatic USD
              defaults, and unsupported claims about increased property value. Sources: ProLynk / Domic history · Daniel's workbench · Historical model tests · Original prototype . A standalone live Domic Home Passport interface and Daniel's
              current production APIs have not yet been located. 02 / FIRST ITERATION A working prototype for this iteration Available now Planned next Drag in or select a PDF, JPG, PNG, or WebP; access the
                      camera through a mobile browser; up to 6 MB for cloud AI
                      or 15 MB for local/manual intake. HEIC conversion, PDF page-count and
                      encryption checks, and splitting files containing multiple
                      documents. Cloud AI for images and PDFs, with a pilot access code;
                      local English OCR and manual alternatives; review summary,
                      recovery for unreadable/unrelated input, and separate
                      company and worker fields. Broader accuracy and latency evaluation, per-user quotas,
                      and production usage and billing controls. Fixed fields, missing-value prompts, drafts, editing,
                      confirmation, and a record list. Sign-in, access control across properties, collaborative
                      review, and a full audit trail. Duplicate detection for the same file in this browser;
                      local storage of originals and fields; JSON export,
                      original-file download, and confirmed deletion. A cloud database, private storage for originals,
                      synchronization across devices, and batch imports. Sample demonstrations and your own documents are handled
              separately: your uploaded file is never replaced with sample
                results . The selected cloud reader sends the original image or PDF to
              the AI service and returns a draft in the fixed field format.
              Unknown values remain blank. Local OCR still reads English images;
              manual entry remains available. PDF preview depends on the browser
              and is separate from cloud extraction. Local prototype limits Files and records are
              stored in this browser. Clearing site data, using private
              browsing, or browser storage eviction may cause data loss. JSON
              exports do not include the original binary files; download those
              separately. The cloud extraction service is connected, but shared
              customer accounts and the Domic Home Passport property database
              are not. Save confirmations refer to local storage. The prototype treats each file as one logical document and one
              property activity. Split combined invoices before adding them.
              The current property selector uses prototype identities and
              properties; a property name can also be entered manually.
              Production needs authenticated property access permissions. UPDATED / RECEIPT INTAKE Review the work and who did it For Pros and homeowners: the service company and actual worker are
              separate fields. Record repairs, replacements, installations,
              improvements, maintenance and inspections. Missing names stay
              unknown; customers and invoice preparers are not automatically
              workers. Same-name people or companies are never automatically
              merged. Input / outcome What happens Readable home-service receipt Open a summary → edit details → confirm and save. Missing or partly readable details Keep recovered fields, leave unknowns blank; confirm an
                      incomplete record if needed. No usable receipt text Explain uncertainty; retake, replace or enter manually. No
                      invented success. Clearly unrelated service text Explain the relevance problem and offer replacement; no
                      automatic history entry. Uncertain relevance Uploader verifies whether it belongs to this property
                      before manual review. Failure / timeout / cancel 45-second OCR deadline, cancel/retry; late results do not
                      overwrite a new document. Six synthetic image files were actually processed in browser
              tests. Clear company/individual receipts, missing fields,
              unreadable blur, a restaurant receipt and a landscape photo are
              included. This is a bounded experiment, not an accuracy guarantee.
              Those earlier tests used local OCR. The subsequent live Gemini image/PDF tests and deployed
              website screenshots are recorded separately. Broad accuracy,
              Arabic document understanding and physical-phone testing remain open. Full interaction and identity rules · Actual experiments and fixes 03 / DATA CONTRACT Nine core groups of information A useful record answers: which property, when, who, where in the home, what work, how
                much, and what status . Other fields are optional. Information Output field When missing Service company / actual worker provider.organization_name / person_name Separate fields; null if absent. Property change type service.change_type Repair, replacement, installation, improvement,
                      maintenance, inspection or unknown. Property property.id May be empty in a draft. The user supplies it before
                      confirmation; the model must not invent it. Service date service.date null; the invoice date is stored separately. Work summary service.summary The user completes it before confirmation, describing
                      actual or planned work. Home system / location service.category / location unknown / null. Provider display name (legacy compatible) provider.name null. Service address property.service_address null; do not substitute the provider's address. Total + currency amount.total / currency null; never default to zero or USD. Document type document.type unknown; distinguish receipts, invoices, quotes, and
                      warranty documents. Payment + work status amount.payment_status / service.completion_status unknown; payment and completion are separate. Keep equipment and warranty details optional Additional details include the invoice date, document number,
              provider phone and address, line items, equipment brand, model and
              serial number, original warranty wording, permit number, and user
              notes. Future extensions can cover service date ranges, tax and
              discounts, maintenance intervals, refunds, and material purchases. Three rules for interpreting a document Service date ≠ invoice date. Service address ≠ provider
              address. Paid ≠ completed. Quotes can be retained as property
              documents, but must not count as incurred expenses or completed
              work. A stable structure, with null for unknown values {
  "schema_version": "1.1",
  "property": { "id": "user-confirmed-property", "service_address": null },
  "document": { "type": "invoice", "number": null, "issue_date": "2026-08-22" },
  "service": {
    "date": null, "category": "hvac", "summary": "Annual air-conditioning service.",
    "location": null, "completion_status": "unknown"
  },
  "provider": { "name": "Northline Heating · Fictional", "phone": null, "address": null },
  "amount": { "total": 189, "currency": "USD", "payment_status": "unknown" }
} This is an excerpt of the core fields, not a complete export. Full
              records also contain items, details, source, evidence, review, and
              timestamps generated by the application. Download the complete JSON Schema , full example with missing fields and field and missing-value specification . Only the property and work summary are required to confirm a
              record. Other values can remain unknown and be marked as
              incomplete. Initial AI output becomes a draft. Errors, unreadable
              files, and ordinary missing fields need distinct handling; the
              next iteration will add missing-value reasons such as not
              provided, illegible, and ambiguous. Amounts are JSON numbers in
              this prototype and should be converted to fixed-point values for
              production database storage. 04 / MODEL DECISION Current pilot: Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite The deployed pilot uses Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite through
              OpenRouter , following small-sample comparisons with 2.5
              and 3.5 Flash Lite. See the actual measured
              costs, timings and remaining errors . The table below records
              earlier planning estimates, not measured bills. An independent
              adapter allows the model to change without rewriting the review flow. Model Per 1M input / output tokens Budget per 10,000 documents* Role 2.5 Flash-Lite $0.10 / $0.40 $4.90 Lowest-cost baseline 2.5 Flash $0.30 / $2.50 $22.50 Comparison with the original choice 3 Flash Preview $0.50 / $3.00 $30.50 Difficult-sample comparison; Preview 3.1 Flash-Lite $0.25 / $1.50 $15.25 Newer low-cost candidate 3.5 Flash-Lite $0.30 / $2.50 $22.50 Quality comparison candidate *Official standard real-time API prices in USD, checked on 9
              September 2026. Assumes 2,500 input tokens and 600 billed output
              tokens per document, one successful attempt, and no additional
              thinking, retry, tax, or storage costs. This is a budget estimate;
              no live model calls were made in this round. Source: Google pricing . The model referred to as “3.0 Flash” corresponds here to the exact
              ID gemini-3-flash-preview . It is still officially marked
              Preview. Recheck the model page and lifecycle information before production deployment. The Lite candidates support the
              relevant multimodal and structured-output capabilities, but
              documented capabilities do not establish real extraction accuracy. A free user feature still needs an API budget For real receipts, use the paid API terms associated with a
              billing account. Free-tier quotas should not be treated as a
              long-term capacity or data-processing guarantee. Google's free and
              paid services have different data-use terms, with regional
              exceptions; review the terms for the service region before
              production use. Google API terms . Measure actual waiting time per page before making a speed
              promise. Track p50/p95 latency, the rate of manual corrections,
              fabricated critical fields, retries, and total cost per confirmed
              record. Batch processing may suit background imports of historical
              documents; its discounts and turnaround window should not be used
              to promise an instant online experience. Batch API . Full model research, cost calculations, and alternatives to
                Gemini → 05 / END-TO-END FLOW Success means the user has confirmed and the record is saved Add a file → Check and preview → Extract a draft → Review / edit → Confirm and save → Property records Situation What the user should see Unsupported format / file too large Explain accepted formats and limits while preserving
                      existing work. Ask for HEIC conversion where needed. Access code missing / AI service unavailable Explain the access or service problem, retain the original,
                      and offer retry or manual entry. Failed requests do not
                      become successful empty records. Unknown date / address / amount Show missing values and completion prompts. Allow an
                      incomplete record to be reviewed and saved. Slow extraction / 429 / 503 / timeout The AI reader shows the reading stage, supports cancellation,
                      and provides explicit error recovery. No automatic retry or
                      empty-result saving is performed. The same file is added again Open the existing record when the local file hash matches.
                      Cross-device and similar-document duplicate detection are
                      planned next. Save failed Keep the form without showing success. Allow a retry or
                      draft export. Edit / leave / delete Warn before leaving with unsaved changes. Edits update the
                      existing record. Deletion requires confirmation and
                      removes the associated original file. The prototype includes three cases: a complete receipt, an invoice
              with a missing date, and a quote issued before work begins. They
              show complete information, missing information, and work that must
              not be marked completed. Verification covers field rules,
              prototype flows, persistence, and failure recovery. Live model
              evaluation and the deployed PDF flow are now documented in the AI pilot report . Physical-phone camera
              acceptance testing remains to be completed. 06 / IMPLEMENTATION Separate extraction, confirmation, and storage Production could follow the original Next.js + Supabase + private R2 proposal or
              integrate with Daniel's existing system. The current prototype is
              a static TimeMemo subpage with a deployed cloud extraction service,
              separate frontend modules and a model-independent output structure.
              The pilot access code gates AI requests; it is not customer sign-in.
              The diagram below describes the intended production architecture;
              storage currently remains in this browser. Web / mobile → Upload and authentication → Model adapter → Schema validation → Human review → Database + original files Production data objects include properties, documents, activities,
              activity_documents, extraction_jobs, extractions, and
              review_revisions. Originals remain private with short-lived
              authorized access. When several activities link to the same
              document, store the total once on the document; do not count it
              again for every activity. Use separate API operations for upload, extraction-job creation,
              status checks, draft saving, confirmation, history, and deletion.
              Confirmation requests should include a version and an idempotency
              key. The server checks property permissions and saves in a
              transaction to prevent duplicate records on retry, concurrent
              overwrites, or success responses without a saved record. Each receipt can be handled by one multimodal extraction service,
              a clear schema, deterministic validation, and human review.
              Multiple agents were used in this iteration for historical
              research, model research, and code review; they are not required
              for every receipt. Full architecture, draft APIs, state tables, and implementation
                plan → · Draft extraction prompt → 07 / REFERENCE PROJECTS Learn from existing tools; build the property-specific logic Resource Useful ideas Adoption limits bookkeeping-skills MIT The receipt-processing skill, consistent output, and
                      exception and review documentation. Use its organization as a reference. The commercial
                      Receiptor service is not a free OCR engine, and property
                      fields still need customization. invoice2data MIT PDF / OCR processing and template extraction for known
                      formats. Potentially useful for recurring providers with consistent
                      formats. The first version does not build a large template
                      library. Docling Core code: MIT Complex PDFs, document layout, tables, and OCR. A future preprocessing option. Check each model license
                      separately. Instructor MIT Structured output, validation, and retries in Python. An option for a Python backend. TypeScript can use native
                      JSON and schema validation. receipt-parser No license found Upload → Gemini → two-column human review → save. The
                      closest reference for the user flow. Only the public description of its flow was referenced. No
                      code was copied in this iteration. This prototype was implemented independently. None of these
              repositories is a runtime dependency, and no bookkeeping skill was
              installed. Before adopting code, pin its version, retain the
              relevant license, and validate dependencies. The research retains
              checked commits and sources: reference research notes . 08 / NEXT ITERATION What to agree with your partner next week System and APIs: the existing backend
                repository, property IDs, authentication, and Daniel's accepted
                field format. Service scope: the primary audience is UK customers
                who use English. English is the default interface, with a
                Chinese option for review and collaboration. Prioritise UK
                service documents, pound amounts and local date formats in the
                next evaluation; the current parser does not yet handle every
                UK format. Currency must still come from the document or user
                confirmation. Agree whether to include material purchases,
                warranties, inspections, and refunds. Sample evaluation: around 100 authorized or
                synthetic documents covering photos, PDFs, multiple pages,
                missing values, blur, and quotes, with human-labeled answers.
                Include real document variety rather than relying on blank
                templates. Models and quotas: compare the Lite models on
                the same samples. Choose the default model and free user
                allowance based on manual correction rates, latency, and total
                cost. Production flow: extend the deployed extraction
                service with private file storage, property permissions, and
                transactional saving, then run a small pilot with real users. Later decisions include a mobile app, email intake, automatic
              ProLynk imports, sharing, property handover reports, and
              maintenance reminders. These can reuse the same document and
              activity structure. The first iteration focuses on the flow from
              adding a document through confirmation. 09 / HANDOFF PACK Materials to share and build on Test samples & review guide Eight downloadable inputs, current results, and screenshot status Interactive prototype Add a document → review → save → export GitHub project directory Prototype source, specifications, samples, research, and
                  tests Download the source package Contains only this project, ready to import into a partner's
                  repository JSON Schema The export contract for this iteration Field specification Core fields, missing values, enums, and extension
                  limits Developer handoff Draft APIs, data objects, error handling, and open
                  decisions Full model research Official sources, pricing assumptions, and evaluation
                  plan Project history Original purpose, sample results, and known gaps The public GitHub directory is available for partners to view and
              download. Contributing code requires repository collaborator
              access. No invitations or messages were sent in this iteration.
              Cloud AI extraction is deployed. Shared accounts, property
              permissions and database-backed storage described here remain
              proposals to implement and validate. Domic Home Passport Project record · 12 Sep 2026 Back to the receipt workspace ↗

records.text: Domic Home Passport · Test report & handoff Domic HOME PASSPORT Receipt workspace Management EN 中文 10 SEPTEMBER 2026 / ROUND 02 One document. A reviewed record. A home’s history. Ten new UK fixtures, real English interface screenshots, saved-data verification and a management scaffold for reviewing with Daniel. Four interaction cases · step-by-step PDF Download 10 receipts · PDF + PNG Chinese illustrated report · PDF Actual saved table · CSV Review workflow verified; recognition remains experimental. The Mac is now accessible and actual browser actions succeeded. These are genuine UI screenshots, captured against the local development build. Nine home documents were saved after human review; one restaurant receipt was not saved. Gemini, automatic PDF extraction and shared customer accounts are not connected. 10 New fictional documents 9 / 9 Reviewed records persisted 216 Form values match 54 / 54 Automated tests passed 01 Output 02 Review flow 03 Ten cases 04 Bad photos 05 Management 06 Handoff 01 / OUTPUT CONTRACT · SCHEMA 1.2 The confirmation table and saved format The user sees a labelled summary table, with the original alongside the editable form. Property and work summary are required for confirmation. All other unknown facts may stay blank. The examples below explain the contract; the downloadable JSON is the exact UI-read saved record. Visible field JSON Example Rule Uploaded by account.id / display_name Alice Morgan Provided by the application; demo identity is not sign-in. Property property.uid / id round2-uk-01 / 22 Fictional Orchard Close User chooses a property; name is required, stable ID is never guessed. Work summary service.summary Replace leaking kitchen mixer tap cartridge… Required for confirmation; describes the actual work. Type / system / area service.change_type / category / location repair / plumbing / kitchen Unknown enums use unknown; missing location uses null. Service date service.date 2026-09-10 Never replaced by issue or upload date. Company & worker provider.organization_name / person_name Brambleford Plumbing Test Ltd / Toby Wren Separate fields; customer/preparer is not the worker. Service address property.service_address 22 Fictional Orchard Close, Exampleford, ZZ1 2BB Separate from the company address; editable. Document total / currency amount.total / currency 264 / GBP Missing is null; explicit zero stays zero; balance is not automatically total. Payment / completion amount.payment_status / service.completion_status paid / completed Independent; an estimate is planned, not completed spending. Document details document.type / number / issue_date invoice / null / 2026-09-10 Number and issue date may be unknown. Optional information items[] / details.* / provider.phone,address / notes Equipment, warranty, VAT line, notes Filled values appear in final confirmation and full JSON. Original & review source / evidence[] / review / timestamps uk-01.png / confirmed Original stored separately; hash and edited paths are retained. Missing text, dates and amounts are null; unknown enums use unknown. An explicit zero is distinct from missing. CSV has 20 flat columns; full JSON also includes line items, warranty, evidence and edit metadata. Original image/PDF bytes are stored separately and linked to the record. View one saved JSON All nine saved records JSON Schema 02 / REVIEW BEFORE SAVE What happens after upload 1. Add document Choose uploader context and a property, then upload one PDF or image. 2. Inspect result A readable image opens a review summary. Partial or unrelated content gets a specific recovery message. PDF stays manual. 3. Edit details Review every field against the original. Missing data stays unknown. All business fields can be edited. 4. Confirm and save The final table includes optional details you filled. Tick the review checkbox, then save. Saved records remain editable. Actual final confirmation; the checkbox is initially unchecked The summary includes uploader, property, work, company, actual worker, dates, location, amount and statuses. It does not save simply because OCR finished. 03 / TEN REAL UPLOAD FLOWS Inputs, observed results and every captured step All receipts are visibly fictional, created for this test. The first nine concern homes; the tenth is a negative restaurant case. Four browser cases use PDFs, six use PNGs. The embedded PDF panel was blank in this in-app browser; an Open original link is available above the panel. PDF preview compatibility remains open. Click a screenshot to see it at full size. The separate engine experiment used all ten PNGs. 01 · Partial image extraction Paid plumbing invoice: company and attending technician OCR recovered Toby Wren, service date and GBP264. Company, full address and work description were added after human review. Customer Harriet Moss was not used as the worker. PDF · PNG · Browser input: uk-01.png Show all captured UI steps · 6 01 / Choose file and context 02 / Result shown after upload 03 / Review and edit fields 04 / Final summary; save disabled until checked 05 / Checked; ready to save 06 / Saved record appears in history 02 · PDF manual entry Individual joiner receipt with no company The PDF opened in manual mode. Elliot Vale, door repair and GBP185 were entered. No company is stated; it remains blank. PDF · PNG · Browser input: uk-02.pdf Show all captured UI steps · 5 01 / PDF manual mode 02 / Review and edit fields 03 / Final summary; save disabled until checked 04 / Checked; ready to save 05 / Saved record appears in history PDF manual mode, recaptured in a clean local browser origin; no record saved The PDF preview is blank in this browser. The original-file link is now above it. 03 · Needs relevance review Electrical job slip missing date, price and worker Relevance required human review. Company, socket work and property were entered. Missing date, worker, amount and currency remain unknown. PDF · PNG · Browser input: uk-03.png Show all captured UI steps · 5 01 / Result shown after upload 02 / Review and edit fields 03 / Final summary; save disabled until checked 04 / Checked; ready to save 05 / Saved record appears in history 04 · PDF manual entry Roofing quotation for future work, no payment Manual estimate. Planned work and unknown service date/actual worker were retained. The operator initially omitted the quote amount, then edited it to GBP1,440 via management and reconfirmed the same record. Count stayed nine. A quotation is not paid spending. PDF · PNG · Browser input: uk-04.pdf Show all captured UI steps · 7 01 / Result shown after upload 02 / Review and edit fields 03 / Final summary; save disabled until checked 04 / Checked; ready to save 05 / Saved record appears in history Management: reopen the saved quote Reconfirm GBP1,440 on the same record 05 · Partial image extraction Annual boiler service thermal receipt with UK date OCR recovered Nia Fenwick and GBP96, but only the first address line. Company, work, full address and boiler model were reviewed manually. Generic Date was manually interpreted using the fixture notes, not automatically proven to be a service date. PDF · PNG · Browser input: uk-05.png Show all captured UI steps · 5 01 / Result shown after upload 02 / Review and edit fields 03 / Final summary; save disabled until checked 04 / Checked; ready to save 05 / Saved record appears in history 06 · Partial image extraction Window replacement VAT invoice with different balance OCR recovered Leo Arden and GBP1,620, not the GBP1,120 balance. Review added company, work, address, net GBP1,350 and VAT GBP270 line items. Payment status is partial. PDF · PNG · Browser input: uk-06.png Show all captured UI steps · 5 01 / Result shown after upload 02 / Review and edit fields 03 / Final summary; save disabled until checked 04 / Checked; ready to save 05 / Saved record appears in history 07 · PDF manual entry Decorator invoice: work completed but unpaid Manual PDF. Service date 9 September and issue date 10 September remain separate. Work is completed and unpaid. The operator reviewed GBP420 in this case; the parser does not generally assume Amount due is the invoice total. PDF · PNG · Browser input: uk-07.pdf Show all captured UI steps · 5 01 / Result shown after upload 02 / Review and edit fields 03 / Final summary; save disabled until checked 04 / Checked; ready to save 05 / Saved record appears in history 08 · Needs relevance review Gardening receipt separating worker, customer and preparer Human relevance review preceded entry of gardening work, GBP75 and actual worker Mila Brook. Customer Lydia Kent and preparer Owen Reed were not treated as workers. PDF · PNG · Browser input: uk-08.png Show all captured UI steps · 5 01 / Result shown after upload 02 / Review and edit fields 03 / Final summary; save disabled until checked 04 / Checked; ready to save 05 / Saved record appears in history 09 · PDF manual entry Appliance repair with long wrapped property address and work lines Manual PDF tested the full long address and multi-sentence work summary; UI-read saved values are complete. The separate PNG OCR returned £1 80 00, so its parser conservatively left total unknown. PDF · PNG · Browser input: uk-09.pdf Show all captured UI steps · 5 01 / Result shown after upload 02 / Review and edit fields 03 / Final summary; save disabled until checked 04 / Checked; ready to save 05 / Saved record appears in history 10 · Unrelated service; not saved Unrelated restaurant receipt for rejection Restaurant spending was marked unrelated. Count stayed nine. Choose another file opens an unsaved-work warning; cancel preserves the result and replace returns to upload. PDF · PNG · Browser input: uk-10.png Show all captured UI steps · 3 01 / Unrelated-service result 02 / Keep or replace current work 03 / Back to upload 04 / PHOTOS & RECOVERY Poor images must not silently become records Two extra AI-generated phone-style images supplement the ten source documents. They simulate a camera image; they were not taken with a physical phone. Severe blur and a landscape are additional older negative fixtures. All four remained unsaved. Phone-style image Soft phone-style image Severe blur Landscape Phone-style plumbing image: partial details Soft boiler photo: incomplete address Severe blur: no usable receipt text Landscape: no usable receipt text Retry first protects unsaved work Retry still cannot read; count stays nine 05 / MANAGEMENT SCAFFOLD People → properties → history → original Open the management console. Saved in this browser shows only local records. Example portfolio shows twelve fictional records across nine properties, separate from uploads, so Daniel can explore repeat jobs on a home without entering anything. The public site cannot see records saved during localhost testing. Open management console Actual nine-record management table Uploaders: two homeowners and one Pro test identity Properties filtered for Alice History belonging to the explicitly linked home Open record and its attached original Fictional portfolio: two jobs on the same home Search actual worker Toby Wren Actual CSV preview; select all as a download fallback This is the navigation and data-relationship scaffold. It is not a live administrator backend and cannot collect all customers yet. Next phase needs authenticated accounts, property permissions, shared database and private file storage. No production access control is simulated by the uploader selector. Mobile layout and language checks 390 × 844 responsive viewport in the in-app browser, not a physical phone or Safari test. English mobile navigation Scrollable confirmation Checkbox and save controls reachable Chinese interface switch 06 / EVIDENCE & NEXT ITERATION What passed, what still needs work Layer Evidence and conclusion Browser workflow 9 confirmed records saved and reopened; 216 final form values match. 80 blanks remain null; 14 unknown enums remain unknown. All nine file SHA256 values match the uploaded fixtures. Original previews were opened; stored-blob byte equality is covered by a separate controlled storage test, not a second independent browser byte download. Recognition quality All ten PNGs: 5 partial, 4 uncertain, 1 unrelated; zero fully extracted. For 72 primary fields across nine home documents: 15 correct nonempty, 9 correctly blank, 47 missing stated facts and 1 incomplete address. Company names and full work summaries often need human entry. Automated checks 54 repository tests passed, plus 11 context/persistence checks and a management loading-failure probe. These include controlled failure tests, not observations of a live service outage. Export The actual UI CSV preview was read and made available above. Select all works. Browser file-download completion was not verified; the report provides a static CSV and full saved JSON. Not yet measured Gemini model accuracy/cost/latency; automated PDFs and multi-document files; physical-phone capture; Chrome/Safari compatibility; real multi-user authorization, cloud backups and production load. Bugs addressed in this iteration Explicit UK dates and £ totals; reject conflicting totals, OCR garbage and impossible dates. Keep customers, preparers and proposed workers out of actual-worker fields. Changing a property name clears and refreshes its old association. Slow original loads cannot replace another record’s attachment; data-load failures clear previous results and disable export. Filled optional details and line items appear in final confirmation. Mobile navigation no longer overlaps. New uploads clear old success notices; CSV contents are visible and selectable. Recommended next build with Daniel Keep this schema and confirmation flow. Add server-side structured extraction behind a provider adapter, benchmark candidate Gemini Flash models on these fixtures plus consented real UK documents, and record field accuracy, latency and cost. Add authenticated users, property memberships and private original storage before any real customer pilot. Decide Pro/owner approval rights, quote/invoice deduplication, payment/VAT fields and the minimum acceptable completion rate together. Current runtime: Tesseract.js 7.0.0 . Fixtures: ReportLab + Poppler; supplemental photos: ImageGen. Existing research and architecture references: Project brief .
