title.zh: 三阱隔离：底部与侧边都要闭合
title.en: Triple-well isolation: close both bottom and sides

records.text:
三阱隔离：底部与侧边都要闭合
Triple-well isolation: close both bottom and sides
深部N型区域、侧向边界与PN结隔离
Deep N-type region, lateral boundaries and PN-junction isolation
Deep N-well 与 N-well
器件 Device 掺杂 Doping Triple well 衬底噪声 Substrate noise Latch-up
结构图与核心判断
Structure and core conclusion
局部P阱与P型衬底分开，既要有深部N型区域，也要有完整侧向隔离与正确偏置。横截面标注局部P阱、N型隔离区域（深N阱）、N型侧向连接、N⁺深N阱接触及P型衬底；俯视图中N型围合区域由深N阱加侧向N阱组成，围住局部P阱并设N⁺接触。
Separating a local P-well from the P substrate requires a deep N-type region, complete lateral isolation and correct bias. The cross-section labels local P-well, deep N-well isolation, lateral N-type connections, N⁺ deep-well contacts and P substrate. In top view, deep N-well plus lateral N-well encloses the local P-well and includes N⁺ contacts.
流程位置与检查
Stage and checks
在结构及版图定义阶段，将隔离目标落实为可制造、可接触的阱区。圈定局部P阱 → 检查深部隔离 → 检查侧向闭合 → 核对包围及间距 → 提取阱区网络。控制底部与侧向连续性、掩膜包围关系、阱间距和接触可达性。
During structure/layout definition, realize isolation as manufacturable, contactable wells. Define local P-well → check deep isolation → check lateral closure → verify enclosure/spacing → extract well network. Control bottom/lateral continuity, mask enclosure, well spacing and contact accessibility.
权衡与失效
Trade-offs and failures
放大隔离区域可能增加布局余量，也增加面积及相关结寄生，不能靠扩大DNW图形替代规则检查。常见失效：包围不足、非预期阱区连通、把截面闭合误当成整个平面均已闭合。
Larger isolation regions may add layout margin but also area and junction parasitics. Enlarging DNW shapes does not replace rule checks. Common failures include inadequate enclosure, unintended well connectivity and assuming a closed cross-section proves closure across the entire plane.
量测、影响与边界
Metrology, effects and boundaries
版图用DRC与LVS核对几何及网络；硅后以隔离测试结构检查结漏电，异常后复核边界与工艺实现。这影响局部体区能否按设计偏置，以及后续噪声耦合路径。本页以深N阱配合侧向N阱围合为例，实际掩膜组合、包围方向和连接关系以所用PDK为准。
Use DRC/LVS to check layout geometry and networks. After fabrication, use isolation test structures for junction leakage and review boundaries/process realization after anomalies. This affects intended local-body bias and later noise-coupling paths. Deep N-well plus lateral N-well is an example; actual masks, enclosure directions and connections follow the applicable PDK.

title.zh: 成阱工艺：靠掺杂形成阱区
title.en: Well formation: wells are formed by doping

records.text:
成阱工艺：靠掺杂形成阱区
Well formation: wells are formed by doping
掩膜、注入能量、剂量与热预算
Masks, implantation energy, dose and thermal budget
Deep N-well 与 N-well
器件 Device 掺杂 Doping Triple well 衬底噪声 Substrate noise Latch-up
核心判断与代表流程
Core conclusion and representative flow
阱是硅中的掺杂区域；深部掺杂需要匹配的注入与热处理，不能理解为刻蚀后填出的深坑。代表流程：在P型硅衬底定义阱掩膜 → 代表性离子注入（仅进入开口区）→ 去除适用掩膜并清洗 → 按流程热处理 → 检查监控结构。N阱为N型掺杂区、用于PMOS体；P阱为P型掺杂区、用于NMOS体。
Wells are doped regions in silicon. Deep doping requires matched implantation and thermal treatment; it is not an etched pit that is later filled. Representative flow: define well masks on P-type silicon → representative implantation through openings only → remove applicable masks and clean → specified thermal treatment → inspect monitor structures. N-wells are N-doped PMOS bodies; P-wells are P-doped NMOS bodies.
流程位置与关键控制
Process position and controls
属于前道阱形成模块，建立后续器件所需的掺杂与隔离基础。控制能量/离子种类、剂量、入射角与掩膜阻挡能力、累计热预算。
This front-end well-formation module establishes doping and isolation for subsequent devices. Control energy/species, dose, incidence angle, mask stopping capability and cumulative thermal budget.
权衡与常见失效
Trade-offs and failures
实现更深分布时，仍需控制注入损伤、沟道效应与横向分布；热处理兼顾激活、损伤修复和掺杂再分布。常见失效是剂量或能量偏移、掩膜阻挡不足、沟道效应尾部异常、热处理后分布偏离目标。
Deeper profiles still require control of implantation damage, channeling and lateral distribution. Thermal treatment balances activation, damage repair and redistribution. Failures include dose/energy shifts, insufficient masking, channeling tails and post-thermal profiles off target.
量测反馈、影响与边界
Feedback, effects and boundaries
结合设备记录、SIMS深度剖面、对应监控结构电阻及片内/片间均匀性，确认偏差后再复测或排查工序。影响阱连接、结特性及后续器件电学表现。可采用多次、多能量注入；N阱、P阱、深N阱与隔离模块顺序随平台变化，不能概括成单次注入配方。
Combine equipment records, SIMS depth profiles, monitor-structure resistance and within-/between-wafer uniformity. Confirm deviations before remeasurement or process troubleshooting. Well formation affects connectivity, junction properties and device electrical performance. Multiple implants and energies may be used; N-well, P-well, deep N-well and isolation sequencing varies by platform and is not a universal single-implant recipe.

title.zh: 掺杂剖面：剂量不等于有效浓度
title.en: Doping profiles: dose is not effective concentration

records.text:
掺杂剖面：剂量不等于有效浓度
Doping profiles: dose is not effective concentration
总掺杂、有效载流子、结位置与阱电阻
Total doping, effective carriers, junction position and well resistance
Deep N-well 与 N-well
器件 Device 掺杂 Doping Triple well 衬底噪声 Substrate noise Latch-up
三类量测相互校验
Cross-check three measurement types
化学剖面（SIMS）检查元素浓度（总掺杂）随深度（从表面向下）的分布，不等于有效载流子。原图蓝线标“N元素（如P、As）”，紫线标“P元素（如B）”。电学分布/电阻由四探针电阻量测或SCM获取，反映有效净掺杂与电学结果；结构标N阱（PMOS体底）、P阱（NMOS体底）、P型衬底。
Chemical profiling (SIMS) measures elemental concentration (total doping) versus depth from the surface; it is not effective carrier concentration. The original labels the blue curve “N element (e.g. P, As)” and purple curve “P element (e.g. B).” Four-point resistance or SCM provides electrical distribution/resistance, reflecting net effective doping and electrical results. The structure labels N-well (PMOS body), P-well (NMOS body) and P substrate.
结特性I–V显示结漏电/击穿，横轴反向偏压、纵轴电流；C–V显示结电容，横轴偏压、纵轴电容。两图均对比局部P阱—Deep N-well与N阱/Deep N-well—P型衬底。
Junction I–V shows leakage/breakdown, plotting current against reverse bias; C–V plots junction capacitance against bias. Both compare local P-well–deep N-well and N-well/deep N-well–P-substrate junctions.
核心判断与分析流程
Core conclusion and analysis flow
注入剂量是工艺输入，最终阱特性还取决于深度分布、补偿、激活与热历程。在工艺开发、监控与异常分析阶段，将掺杂分布对应到电学结果：定义目标剖面 → 获取化学深度分布 → 获取电学分布或电阻 → 对照结与器件特性 → 追溯注入及热历程。
Implant dose is a process input; final well properties also depend on depth distribution, compensation, activation and thermal history. During development, monitoring and failure analysis: define target profile → acquire chemical depth profile → acquire electrical distribution/resistance → compare junction/device properties → trace implantation and thermal history.
控制、权衡与失效
Controls, trade-offs and failures
控制掺杂峰与尾部、有效净掺杂、结位置、阱电阻及跨片均匀性。降低阱电阻的掺杂调整也改变耗尽区、结电容与电场分布，不能只追求单一电阻指标。常见失效包括剖面位置偏移、非预期补偿、电阻异常、结漏电或击穿不达标。
Control peaks/tails, effective net doping, junction location, well resistance and across-wafer uniformity. Doping changes that reduce resistance also alter depletion, junction capacitance and fields; do not optimize resistance alone. Failures include shifted profiles, unintended compensation, abnormal resistance and failed leakage/breakdown specifications.
反馈与边界
Feedback and boundaries
SIMS结合适用的SCM、校准后的电阻量测及结I–V/C–V，区分掺杂分布与电学结果。影响体区电位稳定性、隔离结特性与模型校准。SIMS总浓度不直接等于有效净掺杂；单张普通截面SEM不能代替掺杂或载流子分布量测。
Combine SIMS with applicable SCM, calibrated resistance and junction I–V/C–V to distinguish doping profiles from electrical outcomes. This affects body-potential stability, isolation-junction properties and model calibration. SIMS total concentration does not directly equal effective net doping; a conventional cross-sectional SEM image cannot replace dopant/carrier profiling.
原图“N元素/P元素”是按N型/P型掺杂用途标记的文字，并非化学元素符号的严谨写法；此处保留原意，避免将N理解为氮、P理解为磷。
The original “N element/P element” labels refer to N-/P-type doping roles rather than rigorous elemental notation; do not read N as nitrogen or P as phosphorus in those labels.

title.zh: 偏置接触：阱电位必须接对
title.en: Bias contacts: connect well potentials correctly

records.text:
偏置接触：阱电位必须接对
Bias contacts: connect well potentials correctly
N阱、局部P阱、深N阱与衬底节点
N-well, local P-well, deep N-well and substrate nodes
Deep N-well 与 N-well
器件 Device 掺杂 Doping Triple well 衬底噪声 Substrate noise Latch-up
结构与PN结网络
Structure and PN-junction network
N阱与Deep N-well节点通过N⁺接触连接；局部P阱与P型衬底节点分别通过P⁺接触连接。图示硅表面下为连续硅材料。示意等效网络包括N阱/Deep N-well—P型衬底PN结，以及局部P阱—Deep N-well PN结，均有电容。
N-well and deep N-well nodes connect through N⁺ contacts; local P-well and P-substrate nodes each connect through P⁺ contacts. Silicon beneath the surface is continuous material. The schematic equivalent network includes capacitive N-well/deep-N-well–P-substrate and local-P-well–deep-N-well PN junctions.
核心判断与连接流程
Core conclusion and connection flow
形成隔离结构后，仍需为各阱提供合适接触与偏置，并核对所有相关PN结的工作范围。电路—版图整合阶段将体区、深N阱及衬底接到指定偏置网络：列出阱/衬底节点 → 指定允许偏置 → 配置tap与金属 → 检查启动和关断状态 → 验证连接及工作范围。
After forming isolation, provide appropriate contacts/bias to each well and check every relevant PN-junction operating range. During circuit/layout integration, connect bodies, deep N-wells and substrate to specified bias networks: list nodes → assign allowed bias → configure taps and metal → check startup/shutdown → verify connectivity and operating ranges.
控制、权衡与失效
Controls, trade-offs and failures
控制节点电位关系、接触与阱路径阻抗、tap分布、供电时序和瞬态电压。增加接触可减小局部阱电位波动但占面积；允许独立引出体端不代表可以任意施加体偏置。失效包括阱悬空、接错电源域、局部压降过大、瞬态造成非预期PN结正向导通。
Control node potentials, contact/well-path impedance, tap distribution, power sequencing and transient voltages. More contacts reduce local potential variation but consume area; an independently accessible body does not permit arbitrary body bias. Failures include floating wells, wrong power domains, excessive local drop and transient unintended forward-biased PN junctions.
量测、影响与边界
Measurements, effects and boundaries
用LVS、ERC及偏置仿真检查连接；硅后验证体端漏电和供电瞬态，异常后复核接触与偏置网络。影响体效应、噪声耦合与可靠性。偏置值按PDK和器件模型确定；某些平台同一DNW内的N阱经DNW连通，不能仅凭版图分开就认为电位独立。
Use LVS, ERC and bias simulations to check connectivity; verify body leakage and supply transients after fabrication, revisiting contacts/bias networks if abnormal. This affects body effect, noise coupling and reliability. Bias values follow the PDK/device model. In some platforms, N-wells inside one DNW connect through it; separate layout shapes do not prove independent potentials.
PN结等效网络按原图示意保留，仅表达节点之间存在PN结及结电容，不应当作可直接仿真的完整等效电路。
The original PN-junction network is retained as a conceptual illustration of junctions and capacitance between nodes, not a complete simulation-ready equivalent circuit.

title.zh: 噪声与寄生：隔离效果要按频段看
title.en: Noise and parasitics: evaluate isolation by frequency band

records.text:
噪声与寄生：隔离效果要按频段看
Noise and parasitics: evaluate isolation by frequency band
衬底导电、结电容、阱阻抗与供电耦合
Substrate conduction, junction capacitance, well impedance and supply coupling
Deep N-well 与 N-well
器件 Device 掺杂 Doping Triple well 衬底噪声 Substrate noise Latch-up
核心判断与耦合图
Core conclusion and coupling diagram
深N阱可改变衬底噪声传播路径，但隔离效果仍受结寄生、偏置网络和工作频段影响。图中数字/开关电路为干扰源，模拟/高精度电路为敏感节点；P型衬底为连续硅体。红色实线路径表示衬底电阻Rsub的导电耦合；蓝色虚线表示PN结电容耦合，包含DNW—P型衬底与局部P阱—DNW的Cⱼ。DNW偏置经Zbias及N⁺接触连接，局部P阱具有P⁺接触。
Deep N-well changes substrate-noise propagation, but junction parasitics, bias networks and operating frequency still determine isolation. The diagram shows a digital/switching interferer and an analog/high-precision sensitive node in continuous P-type silicon. Red solid arrows denote conduction through substrate resistance Rsub; blue dashed arrows denote capacitive coupling through DNW–substrate and local-P-well–DNW junction capacitances Cⱼ. DNW bias connects through Zbias and an N⁺ contact; local P-well has a P⁺ contact.
流程与关键控制
Flow and controls
在混合信号设计与验证阶段比较目标干扰源到敏感节点的耦合。确定干扰源与敏感节点 → 建立衬底/阱寄生网络 → 加入偏置与互连 → 扫描频率和工作状态 → 用测试结构校准。控制干扰频谱、阱结电容、偏置路径阻抗、接触/护环与布局。
During mixed-signal design and verification, compare coupling from the target interferer to sensitive nodes. Identify both → build substrate/well parasitic network → add bias/interconnect → sweep frequency/operating state → calibrate using test structures. Control interference spectrum, well-junction capacitance, bias-path impedance and contact/guard-ring layout.
权衡与失效
Trade-offs and failures
改变隔离区域和接地安排会同时改变导电与电容耦合；隔离放噪声源侧还是敏感侧，需要结合电路验证。常见失效：局部体电位波动、模拟杂散或噪声增大、DNW偏置电源耦入干扰。
Changing isolation and grounding alters both conductive and capacitive coupling. Whether to isolate the source or the sensitive side requires circuit verification. Failures include local body-potential fluctuations, increased analog spurs/noise and interference coupled through the DNW bias supply.
量测、影响与边界
Measurements, effects and boundaries
向规定节点注入已知小信号扰动，量测耦合传递或敏感节点噪声，与模型对照定位主路径。影响混合信号精度、噪声裕量及版图安排。DNW只处理部分耦合路径，不能替代供电、金属布线与封装回流分析；不承诺固定dB收益，也不预设包住模拟电路总是最好。
Inject a known small-signal perturbation at specified nodes, measure transfer or sensitive-node noise and compare with models to locate dominant paths. This affects mixed-signal accuracy, noise margin and layout. DNW handles only some paths, not supply, metal-routing or package-return analysis. It promises no fixed dB benefit and enclosing the analog block is not assumed always best.

title.zh: 闩锁与可靠性：深N阱不能包办
title.en: Latch-up and reliability: deep N-well is not sufficient

records.text:
闩锁与可靠性：深N阱不能包办
Latch-up and reliability: deep N-well is not sufficient
寄生反馈、载流子注入、护环与接触
Parasitic feedback, carrier injection, guard rings and contacts
Deep N-well 与 N-well
器件 Device 掺杂 Doping Triple well 衬底噪声 Substrate noise Latch-up
结构与三种失效机理
Structure and three failure mechanisms
图示异常电流注入、P阱内NMOS与寄生NPN、N阱内PMOS与寄生PNP、阱电阻、衬底电阻和寄生正反馈路径。NPN集电极为N阱，PNP集电极为P衬底。P阱、N阱、Deep N-well及衬底接触偏置按PDK，护环按规则连接；寄生路径随结构变化，DNW不能完全切断。
The diagram shows abnormal current injection, NMOS/parasitic NPN in P-well, PMOS/parasitic PNP in N-well, well/substrate resistance and parasitic positive feedback. The NPN collector is N-well and PNP collector P-substrate. Bias P-well, N-well, DNW and substrate contacts per PDK, and connect guard rings per rules. Parasitic paths vary with structure and DNW does not fully interrupt them.
闩锁由寄生器件正反馈触发，可能产生持续异常电流与局部发热。ESD是静电放电导致的大电流注入，可能触发闩锁或损伤器件。结击穿由PN结反向偏置过高引起，是不同失效机理。
Latch-up is triggered by parasitic positive feedback and can produce sustained abnormal current and local heating. ESD injects large current from electrostatic discharge and can trigger latch-up or damage. Junction breakdown results from excessive reverse PN bias and is a different mechanism.
核心判断与验证流程
Core conclusion and verification flow
闩锁与寄生器件、电阻路径和触发条件有关；采用深N阱后仍需执行适用的接触、间距、护环及可靠性要求。在版图签核与硅后鉴定阶段：识别可能注入源 → 检查接触/护环/间距 → 分析偏置及寄生路径 → 按规范施加应力并监测 → 异常隔离及根因分析。
Latch-up depends on parasitic devices, resistive paths and triggering. Deep N-well does not remove applicable contact, spacing, guard-ring and reliability requirements. At layout signoff/post-silicon qualification: identify injection sources → check contacts/rings/spacing → analyze bias/parasitic paths → apply specified stress and monitor → isolate anomalies and analyze root causes.
控制、权衡与量测
Controls, trade-offs and measurements
控制注入位置与条件、阱/衬底路径电阻、护环及tap分布、供电和温度。增加接触、间距或护环占面积，有效性仍取决于其他连接及实际载流子收集路径。常见失效为持续异常电流、局部发热、应力后漏电增加或功能失效。
Control injection location/conditions, well/substrate-path resistance, guard-ring/tap distribution, supply and temperature. Extra contacts, spacing or rings consume area and work only in conjunction with other connections and actual carrier-collection paths. Failures include sustained abnormal current, heating, post-stress leakage or functional failure.
按规定鉴定条件监测应力期间与之后的供电电流、漏电和功能，结合失效分析定位寄生路径；不能仅凭电流突增认定闩锁。影响可靠性放行及异常条件下功能保持。DNW不是“免闩锁”证明，闩锁、ESD和结击穿需分别验证。
Monitor supply current, leakage and function during/after stress under specified qualification conditions; use failure analysis to locate paths. A current spike alone does not establish latch-up. This affects reliability release and function under abnormal conditions. DNW does not certify latch-up immunity; verify latch-up, ESD and junction breakdown separately.

title.zh: 工艺选择：按需求与平台能力选
title.en: Process selection: match requirements and platform capability

records.text:
工艺选择：按需求与平台能力选
Process selection: match requirements and platform capability
器件体区、局部隔离、允许偏置与实现代价
Device bodies, local isolation, allowed bias and implementation cost
Deep N-well 与 N-well
器件 Device 掺杂 Doping Triple well 衬底噪声 Substrate noise Latch-up
三类任务与验证链
Three tasks and the verification chain
常规PMOS体区：采用平台支持的标准N阱，配置正确体接触。局部P阱隔离或受控体偏置：评估深N阱/三阱选项，核对侧向闭合和偏置范围。噪声敏感混合信号模块：联合评估隔离位置、接触护环、供电和布线，再比较完整电路表现。
Conventional PMOS body: use a supported standard N-well and correct body contacts. Local P-well isolation/controlled body bias: assess DNW/triple-well options and check lateral closure and bias range. Noise-sensitive mixed-signal blocks: jointly assess isolation location, contacts/guard rings, supply and routing, then compare complete-circuit performance.
验证链：PDK器件与规则 → 器件/寄生模型 → 隔离/偏置/护环版图方案 → 器件/耦合/可靠性测试。标准N阱、三阱评估和联合隔离设计都需要规则、模型与硅后验证。
Verification chain: PDK devices/rules → device/parasitic models → isolation/bias/guard-ring layout → device/coupling/reliability tests. Standard N-well, triple-well and combined isolation all require rules, models and post-silicon verification.
核心判断与决策流程
Core conclusion and decision flow
N阱与深N阱职责有交集也有差异，先看器件和隔离目标，再看PDK允许实现。在平台及架构选型阶段：明确器件与体区 → 列出隔离及偏置需求 → 核对PDK器件和规则 → 评估寄生/面积/平台代价 → 完成仿真与测试验证。约束为模型及器件支持、允许偏置、目标隔离指标、面积与平台成本。
N-well and deep N-well roles overlap but differ. Start with device/isolation goals, then permitted PDK implementations. During platform/architecture selection: define devices/bodies → list isolation/bias needs → check PDK devices/rules → evaluate parasitics/area/platform cost → simulate and test. Constraints include model/device support, permitted bias, isolation targets, area and platform cost.
风险、反馈与边界
Risks, feedback and boundaries

Local P-well isolation/controlled body bias: assess DNW/triple-well options and check lateral closure and bias range. title.zh: 一张图看懂TSV vs TGV
title.en: TSV versus TGV at a glance

records.text:
一张图看懂TSV vs TGV
TSV versus TGV at a glance
从材料、制孔到金属化与工艺选择
From materials and hole formation to metallization and process selection
TSV 与 TGV
2.5D 3D 中介层 Interposer RDL 金属化 Metallization 可靠性 Reliability
01 结构定位
01 Structural location
先看通孔在哪一层、连接哪两面。TSV是硅通孔，TGV是玻璃通孔。
First identify the layer containing the via and the two surfaces it connects. TSV means through-silicon via; TGV means through-glass via.
02 基材差异
02 Substrate differences
硅与玻璃的材料差异影响寄生参数（图示R、C）、热变形和加工窗口。
Differences between silicon and glass affect parasitics (R and C illustrated), thermal deformation and the processing window.
03 制孔路线
03 Hole formation
成孔方法影响侧壁与后续覆盖。图示硅采用深硅刻蚀，玻璃采用激光改性后选择性湿刻。
Hole formation affects sidewalls and subsequent coverage. The diagrams show deep-silicon etching for silicon and laser modification followed by selective wet etching for glass.
04 绝缘界面
04 Insulating interfaces
绝缘、附着和阻挡各有职责。硅侧图强调电隔离，玻璃侧图强调附着/阻挡。
Insulation, adhesion and barrier layers have distinct roles. The silicon diagram emphasizes electrical isolation, while the glass diagram emphasizes adhesion/barrier functions.
05 孔内金属化
05 Via metallization
种子层连续性与镀铜结构共同决定导通。图示全填铜、孔壁镀铜及种子连续性。
Seed continuity and plated-copper structure jointly determine conduction. The diagrams show full copper filling, wall plating and seed continuity.
06 互连整合
06 Interconnect integration
通孔接上RDL才形成完整链路。图示TSV+RDL与TGV+RDL。
A via forms a complete link only when connected to redistribution layers (RDL). The diagrams show TSV+RDL and TGV+RDL.
07 热应力风险
07 Thermal-stress risks
铜与基材热失配考验长期可靠性，可能出现孔边裂纹、界面脱层与铜突出。
Thermal mismatch between copper and substrate challenges long-term reliability, with risks of via-edge cracks, interface delamination and copper protrusion.
08 工艺选择
08 Process selection
同层级、同任务下再比较性能与成本。图示芯片内TSV、中介层同层比较、玻璃芯基板TGV，并进行共同验证。
Compare performance and cost only at the same hierarchy and task. The diagrams distinguish chip TSV, same-level interposer comparison and glass-core-substrate TGV, followed by common verification.

records.text:
结构定位：先看通孔在哪一层
Structural location: first identify the via’s layer
芯片、中介层、封装基板，先分层再比较
Distinguish chip, interposer and package substrate before comparing
TSV 与 TGV
2.5D 3D 中介层 Interposer RDL 金属化 Metallization 可靠性 Reliability
核心判断与层级
Core conclusion and hierarchy
TSV贯穿硅，TGV贯穿玻璃；能否替代取决于层级与连接任务。图示芯片内TSV（含TSV的硅芯片）、硅中介层TSV（含TSV的硅中介层）、玻璃层TGV（含TGV的玻璃基板）。这是层级示意，并非具体产品。
TSV passes through silicon and TGV through glass; substitutability depends on hierarchy and connection task. The illustration separates TSV in silicon chips, TSV in silicon interposers and TGV in glass substrates. It represents hierarchy, not a specific product.
流程位置与辨认
Process stage and identification
封装架构定义阶段，明确通孔连接的上下端点，再交给基材、孔与布线设计并进入后续工艺。辨认流程：标出芯片/中介层/基板 → 找上下端点 → 确认贯穿材料 → 区分信号/电源/地 → 核对横向布线。
At package architecture definition, establish the upper/lower endpoints, then pass requirements to substrate, via and routing design before subsequent processing. Identify chip/interposer/substrate → locate endpoints → confirm traversed material → distinguish signal/power/ground → check lateral routing.
控制、权衡与失效
Controls, trade-offs and failures
控制封装层级、端点间距、互连长度和横向布线密度。缩短垂直路径可能需要更薄基材，也增加搬运和后续加工难度。接口错位会开路；回流路径安排不当会导致串扰或链路劣化。
Control package hierarchy, endpoint spacing, interconnect length and lateral-routing density. Shorter vertical paths may require thinner substrates and more difficult handling/processing. Misaligned interfaces cause opens; poor return-path arrangement causes crosstalk or link degradation.
反馈、影响与边界
Feedback, effects and boundaries
用截面确认层级和接续位置，结合导通检测核对完整路径；异常后复核接口与布线设计。架构决定制孔、RDL（重布线层）及组装接口要求。HBM内部硅芯片TSV不等同于玻璃芯基板TGV；同一封装可以在不同层级同时使用二者。
Verify hierarchy and junction positions in cross-section, and check complete paths with continuity tests; review interfaces/routing after anomalies. Architecture sets via, RDL and assembly-interface requirements. HBM’s internal silicon-chip TSV is not equivalent to glass-core-substrate TGV; one package can use both at different levels.

title.zh: 基材差异：绝缘优势也有边界
title.en: Substrate differences: insulation benefits have limits

records.text:
基材差异：绝缘优势也有边界
Substrate differences: insulation benefits have limits
电介质特性、寄生参数与热变形
Dielectric properties, parasitics and thermal deformation
TSV 与 TGV
2.5D 3D 中介层 Interposer RDL 金属化 Metallization 可靠性 Reliability
核心判断与图示
Core conclusion and diagrams
玻璃本体绝缘，有利于减少衬底导电相关损耗；整条互连电容、损耗和串扰仍须按结构验证。TSV图含RDL、硅衬底和TSV；TGV图含RDL、玻璃基材和TGV。简化寄生电路仅为R（电阻）、C（电容）的概念图；完整链路包含孔、RDL和回流路径，橙色为信号路径，蓝色为回流路径。
Bulk glass is insulating and can reduce substrate-conduction losses, but complete-link capacitance, loss and crosstalk still require structural verification. TSV and TGV diagrams each label RDL, substrate and via. The R/C parasitic circuit is conceptual. The complete link includes via, RDL and return path; orange marks the signal and blue the return.
流程与评估
Process and evaluation
架构确定后选择基材，为孔、RDL与封装设计提供材料输入。明确频段和负载 → 确认材料特性 → 提取孔与RDL寄生 → 联合电热评估 → 用测试结构校准。
Select the substrate after architecture definition to supply material inputs for via, RDL and packaging design. Define frequency/load → confirm material properties → extract via/RDL parasitics → jointly evaluate electrical/thermal behavior → calibrate using test structures.
控制、权衡与失效
Controls, trade-offs and failures
控制硅电阻率/玻璃介电特性、工作频段、热膨胀系数CTE、基材厚度和平整度。调整玻璃配方改变CTE，也可能改变介电与加工特性，不能分开选择指标。失效包括插入损耗超标、串扰增大、热变形影响接续。
Control silicon resistivity/glass dielectric properties, frequency, coefficient of thermal expansion (CTE), substrate thickness and flatness. A glass formulation change to modify CTE can also change dielectric and processing properties; these cannot be chosen independently. Failures include excessive insertion loss, crosstalk and thermally distorted connections.
量测、影响与边界
Measurements, effects and boundaries
用矢量网络分析仪测链路S参数，结合材料表征与温变形测量校准模型。材料选择改变布线、接地、散热和工艺温度安排。不同玻璃及不同电阻率硅表现不同；玻璃不代表零电容，低损耗也不自动保证更好散热。
Measure link S-parameters with a vector network analyzer and calibrate using material and thermal-deformation characterization. Material choice changes routing, grounding, heat dissipation and process-temperature planning. Glass types and silicon resistivities differ; glass does not mean zero capacitance, and low electrical loss does not automatically ensure better cooling.

title.zh: 制孔路线：孔形会传到下一站
title.en: Hole formation: geometry carries into the next process

records.text:
制孔路线：孔形会传到下一站
Hole formation: geometry carries into the next process
孔径、锥度、深宽比与侧壁完整性
Diameter, taper, aspect ratio and sidewall integrity
TSV 与 TGV
2.5D 3D 中介层 Interposer RDL 金属化 Metallization 可靠性 Reliability
核心判断与代表路线
Core conclusion and representative routes
制孔不仅要达到目标深度，还需为后续薄膜覆盖与金属化留下可用孔形。深硅刻蚀DRIE图示掩膜、硅基材与硅盲孔。玻璃路线为激光改性 → 选择性湿法刻蚀：激光使内部结构改变，改性区仍是玻璃、尚未去除；随后选择性湿刻去除改性区形成通孔。
Hole formation must meet depth targets and leave usable geometry for film coverage and metallization. The DRIE diagram labels mask, silicon substrate and silicon blind via. In glass, laser modification changes internal structure without removing the glass; selective wet etching then removes the modified region to form a through-hole.
流程位置与步骤
Process position and steps
制孔模块接收基材，输出合格孔结构供界面处理。TSV代表流程：掩膜定义 → 深硅刻蚀DRIE → 去掩膜/残留 → 清洗 → 孔形检查。TGV代表流程：玻璃与孔位确认 → 激光改性 → 选择性湿法刻蚀成孔 → 清洗干燥 → 孔形检查。
The via module receives substrates and delivers qualified holes for interface treatment. Representative TSV flow: mask definition → DRIE → mask/residue removal → cleaning → geometry inspection. TGV flow: confirm glass/locations → laser modification → selective wet etching → clean/dry → geometry inspection.
控制、权衡与失效
Controls, trade-offs and failures
控制孔径及锥度、深宽比、侧壁粗糙度、损伤和裂纹范围。更高深宽比提高覆盖与传质难度；增加去除量可能改变孔口与侧壁尺寸。失效包括未贯通或深度不足、侧壁异常、崩边与微裂纹。
Control diameter/taper, aspect ratio, sidewall roughness and damage/crack extent. Higher aspect ratio complicates coverage and mass transport; more removal can alter mouth/sidewall dimensions. Failures include incomplete penetration/depth, abnormal sidewalls, chipping and microcracks.
量测、影响与边界
Measurements, effects and boundaries
用孔口与适用孔出口光学量测、截面SEM检查轮廓，按位置统计偏差并复核制孔条件。孔形异常会造成种子断点、镀铜空洞或界面应力集中。TSV可先做盲孔、后经减薄露出；TGV还存在其他激光或蚀刻路线，并非均采用此改性湿刻流程。
Use optical measurements at mouths/applicable exits and cross-sectional SEM for profiles; map deviations by location and review conditions. Bad geometry can cause seed breaks, plating voids or stress concentration. TSV may start as a blind via revealed by thinning. TGV has other laser/etch routes and does not always use modification plus wet etching.

paragraphs.zh: 制孔不仅要达到目标深度，还需为后续薄膜覆盖与金属化留下可用孔形。深硅刻蚀DRIE图示掩膜、硅基材与硅盲孔。玻璃路线为激光改性 → 选择性湿法刻蚀：激光使内部结构改变，改性区仍是玻璃、尚未去除；随后选择性湿刻去除改性区形成通孔。
paragraphs.en: Hole formation must meet depth targets and leave usable geometry for film coverage and metallization. The DRIE diagram labels mask, silicon substrate and silicon blind via. In glass, laser modification changes internal structure without removing the glass; selective wet etching then removes the modified region to form a through-hole.

paragraphs.zh: 制孔模块接收基材，输出合格孔结构供界面处理。TSV代表流程：掩膜定义 → 深硅刻蚀DRIE → 去掩膜/残留 → 清洗 → 孔形检查。TGV代表流程：玻璃与孔位确认 → 激光改性 → 选择性湿法刻蚀成孔 → 清洗干燥 → 孔形检查。
paragraphs.en: The via module receives substrates and delivers qualified holes for interface treatment. Representative TSV flow: mask definition → DRIE → mask/residue removal → cleaning → geometry inspection. TGV flow: confirm glass/locations → laser modification → selective wet etching → clean/dry → geometry inspection.

paragraphs.zh: 控制孔径及锥度、深宽比、侧壁粗糙度、损伤和裂纹范围。更高深宽比提高覆盖与传质难度；增加去除量可能改变孔口与侧壁尺寸。失效包括未贯通或深度不足、侧壁异常、崩边与微裂纹。
paragraphs.en: Control diameter/taper, aspect ratio, sidewall roughness and damage/crack extent. Higher aspect ratio complicates coverage and mass transport; more removal can alter mouth/sidewall dimensions. Failures include incomplete penetration/depth, abnormal sidewalls, chipping and microcracks.

paragraphs.zh: 用孔口与适用孔出口光学量测、截面SEM检查轮廓，按位置统计偏差并复核制孔条件。孔形异常会造成种子断点、镀铜空洞或界面应力集中。TSV可先做盲孔、后经减薄露出；TGV还存在其他激光或蚀刻路线，并非均采用此改性湿刻流程。
paragraphs.en: Use optical measurements at mouths/applicable exits and cross-sectional SEM for profiles; map deviations by location and review conditions. Bad geometry can cause seed breaks, plating voids or stress concentration. TSV may start as a blind via revealed by thinning. TGV has other laser/etch routes and does not always use modification plus wet etching.

title.zh: 绝缘界面：绝缘和附着是两回事
title.en: Interfaces: insulation and adhesion are different functions

records.text:
绝缘界面：绝缘和附着是两回事
Interfaces: insulation and adhesion are different functions
电隔离、金属附着、扩散控制与缓冲
Electrical isolation, metal adhesion, diffusion control and buffering
TSV 与 TGV
2.5D 3D 中介层 Interposer RDL 金属化 Metallization 可靠性 Reliability
核心判断与图示
Core conclusion and diagrams
铜TSV通常需要铜与硅之间的介电隔离；玻璃自身绝缘，仍需解决金属附着及按需配置的阻挡/缓冲功能。硅基TSV半剖面标铜、电隔离、硅；玻璃基TGV半剖面标铜、附着/阻挡等按需配置、玻璃。
Copper TSV usually requires dielectric isolation between copper and silicon. Glass is inherently insulating but still needs metal adhesion and applicable barrier/buffer functions. The TSV half-section labels copper, electrical isolation and silicon; the TGV half-section labels copper, optional adhesion/barrier functions and glass.
流程位置与处理
Process position and treatment
制孔与清洗后建立孔壁功能层，为种子层及镀铜提供界面。去残留 → 表面处理 → 按堆栈形成所需功能层 → 检查覆盖与界面 → 转入种子层工序。
After hole formation/cleaning, establish functional sidewall layers for seed deposition and copper plating. Remove residue → treat surface → form required stack layers → inspect coverage/interfaces → proceed to seed processing.
控制、权衡与失效
Controls, trade-offs and failures
控制最薄处膜厚、附着强度、电隔离能力与热预算。增加隔离层厚度占用孔内空间；改善附着的表面处理也要控制粗糙度和损伤。常见失效为隔离层针孔或击穿、界面脱层、扩散控制不足。
Control minimum film thickness, adhesion strength, electrical isolation and thermal budget. Thicker isolation consumes via space; adhesion-enhancing treatments must control roughness/damage. Common failures are dielectric pinholes/breakdown, delamination and inadequate diffusion control.
量测、影响与边界
Measurements, effects and boundaries
适当截面分析检查孔口、孔壁及底部/出口，结合漏电与附着测试，判断能否进入镀铜。界面缺陷会导致镀层剥离、漏电或后续可靠性失效。绝缘层、粘附层、阻挡层职责不同；材料与层数按基材及整合路线确定，部分功能可由同一层承担。
Inspect mouths, walls and bottoms/exits with suitable cross-sectional analysis; combine leakage and adhesion tests before plating. Interface defects can cause plating peel, leakage or later reliability failures. Insulation, adhesion and barrier layers have distinct roles; material/layer count depends on substrate/integration, and one layer may serve multiple functions.

title.zh: 孔内金属化：连续导通比表面镀亮更重要
title.en: Via metallization: continuous conduction matters more than a shiny surface

records.text:
孔内金属化：连续导通比表面镀亮更重要
Via metallization: continuous conduction matters more than a shiny surface
种子连续性、镀铜分布与填充结构
Seed continuity, copper distribution and fill structure
TSV 与 TGV
2.5D 3D 中介层 Interposer RDL 金属化 Metallization 可靠性 Reliability
核心判断与设计区别
Core conclusion and design distinctions
孔内导电层要连续，最终金属结构符合设计。TGV可以全填铜，也可孔壁镀铜。全填铜是孔内完全填充；孔壁镀铜中间有设计留空、由铜壁导电；非设计空洞是未填充空间的工艺缺陷。连续种子层有利于镀铜均匀生长，断点可能导致镀铜不连续和缺陷。
The via conductor must be continuous and the final metal structure must match design. TGV can be fully copper-filled or wall-plated. Full fill fills the hole; wall plating intentionally leaves an empty center with a conductive copper wall; unintended voids are process defects. Continuous seed supports uniform plating, whereas breaks can cause discontinuous copper and defects.
结构图的透明蓝色体标注为玻璃基板，橙色标注为铜或孔壁铜；红色圈出非设计空洞。
The transparent blue body is labeled glass substrate, the orange material copper or via-wall copper, and the red circle marks an unintended void.
流程位置与典型步骤
Process position and typical steps
接收合格孔壁界面，形成垂直金属通路，再交给整平与互连接续。形成种子层 → 润湿排气 → 受控镀铜 → 按需热处理 → 整平/去多余金属 → 检查。
Receive qualified sidewall interfaces, form vertical metal paths and hand off to planarization/interconnect. Form seed → wet/degas → controlled copper plating → thermal treatment as needed → planarize/remove excess metal → inspect.
控制、权衡与失效
Controls, trade-offs and failures
控制种子连续性、电流分布、药液与孔内传质、填充形态/孔壁铜厚。相同长度及孔外径下，更多铜截面积有利于降电阻，但可能增加热失配和加工时间。失效包括种子断点、提前封口空洞、接缝、孔壁局部过薄。
Control seed continuity, current distribution, chemistry/in-via mass transport and fill shape/wall thickness. At equal length and outer diameter, more copper cross-section lowers resistance but may increase thermal mismatch and processing time. Failures include seed breaks, pinch-off voids, seams and locally thin copper walls.
量测、影响与边界
Measurements, effects and boundaries
用截面及分辨率适用的X射线检查内部结构，结合四线或导通链电阻定位异常，并复核前处理和镀铜条件。内部缺陷会带来局部发热、电阻漂移与开路。盲孔和通孔镀铜策略不同；设计为孔壁镀铜时，中心留空不能直接判为填充缺陷。
Inspect internals using cross-sections and X-ray with suitable resolution, combining four-wire/daisy-chain resistance to locate issues and review pretreatment/plating. Internal defects can cause heating, resistance drift and opens. Blind/through vias require different strategies; an intentionally empty wall-plated center is not automatically a fill defect.

title.zh: 互连整合：接上RDL才形成链路
title.en: Interconnect integration: RDL completes the link

records.text:
互连整合：接上RDL才形成链路
Interconnect integration: RDL completes the link
减薄露出、双面接续、平整度与对准
Thinning/reveal, two-sided connections, flatness and alignment
TSV 与 TGV
2.5D 3D 中介层 Interposer RDL 金属化 Metallization 可靠性 Reliability
核心判断与结构
Core conclusion and structure
垂直通孔与表面布线要正确接续；一个孔导通不代表整个封装链路合格。硅TSV盲孔路线从铜填充及正面RDL开始，背面减薄露出通孔，再做背面钝化、接触开口和背面RDL。玻璃TGV通孔路线构建双面RDL与端口接续，图中标顶面RDL、玻璃基板、铜通孔和底面RDL。
Vertical vias must connect correctly to surface routing; one conducting via does not qualify the complete package link. A silicon blind-TSV route starts with copper fill/front RDL, then back thinning/reveal, backside passivation, contact openings and back RDL. A glass through-TGV route builds two-sided RDL and terminal connections, labeled top RDL, glass, copper via and bottom RDL.
流程位置与代表流程
Stage and representative flows
通孔与表面互连整合为后续芯片组装提供端口。TSV：填孔及正面处理 → 临时键合支撑 → 背面减薄并露出通孔 → 背面钝化与接触开口 → 布线/端口接续与测试。TGV：完成通孔金属化 → 支撑与搬运控制 → 双面RDL构建 → 端口形成与接续 → 平整度及链路测试。
Via/surface integration supplies terminals for later chip assembly. TSV: fill/front processing → temporary bonding support → back thinning/reveal → backside passivation/contact openings → routing/terminal connection and testing. TGV: metallize via → support/handling control → build two-sided RDL → form/connect terminals → flatness/link testing.
控制、权衡与失效
Controls, trade-offs and failures
控制最终厚度与均匀性、端口高度/平整度、对准偏差、基板翘曲。减薄缩短互连路径但降低机械余量；更密端口收紧对准和整平窗口。常见失效包括露出不足或过度去除、RDL错位开路、局部非平整与裂纹。
Control final thickness/uniformity, terminal height/flatness, alignment error and substrate warpage. Thinning shortens paths but reduces mechanical margin; denser terminals tighten alignment/planarization windows. Failures include incomplete reveal/over-removal, RDL misalignment opens, local unevenness and cracks.
量测、影响与边界
Measurements, effects and boundaries
结合厚度、表面轮廓、翘曲、对准量测与导通链测试；异常后先核对接续位置和工序来源。影响键合接触、组装良率和链路完整性。以上是代表流程，TSV形成时点不同会改变顺序；TGV有通孔与盲孔路线，双面RDL和孔金属化也可协同制作。
Combine thickness, surface profile, warpage, alignment and daisy-chain continuity measurements; review connection locations/process origin first when abnormal. This affects bonding contact, assembly yield and link integrity. These flows are representative; TSV timing changes order. TGV may be blind or through, and two-sided RDL/via metallization can be co-fabricated.

title.zh: 热应力风险：冷热循环会考验界面
title.en: Thermal stress: temperature cycling tests interfaces

records.text:
热应力风险：冷热循环会考验界面
Thermal stress: temperature cycling tests interfaces
热膨胀失配、铜突出、裂纹与脱层
Thermal-expansion mismatch, copper protrusion, cracks and delamination
TSV 与 TGV
2.5D 3D 中介层 Interposer RDL 金属化 Metallization 可靠性 Reliability
核心判断与图示
Core conclusion and diagrams
铜与硅、铜与玻璃都可能产生热失配应力；初始导通合格不能替代长期可靠性验证。热变形图分别标铜、界面层、硅基底（有源硅）与玻璃基底；局部放大显示铜突出、界面脱层和孔边裂纹。
Both copper/silicon and copper/glass can develop thermal-mismatch stress. Passing initial continuity does not replace long-term reliability verification. Thermal-deformation diagrams label copper, interface layers, active silicon and glass substrates; close-ups show copper protrusion, delamination and via-edge cracks.
流程位置与验证
Stage and verification
贯穿镀铜后热处理、后续加工及服役验证，检查界面与结构稳定性。建立初始电性/形貌基线 → 施加规定热历程 → 分阶段量测 → 异常截面分析 → 反馈材料、结构与工艺控制。
Assess interface/structural stability throughout post-plating thermal treatment, later processing and service verification. Establish electrical/morphology baseline → apply specified thermal history → measure in stages → cross-section anomalies → feed findings into material, structure and process controls.
控制、权衡与失效
Controls, trade-offs and failures
控制热失配与温度历程、铜量/孔形、界面附着、孔间距与整体变形约束。减少铜量可能降低部分结构热变形，也减少导电截面积，不能只追求低电阻或低应力之一。失效包括铜突出、界面脱层、孔边裂纹和电阻漂移。
Control mismatch/temperature history, copper volume/via shape, adhesion, via spacing and global deformation constraints. Less copper may reduce deformation in some structures but also reduces conducting area; neither low resistance nor low stress should be optimized alone. Failures include protrusion, delamination, edge cracks and resistance drift.
量测、影响与边界
Measurements, effects and boundaries

Compare resistance, surface profile and warpage before/after thermal cycling; locate failures in cross-section and isolate, remeasure or analyze root causes. Failures can disrupt RDL, bonding planes and long-term connections. Active silicon requires assessment of TSV stress on nearby devices and keep-out zones (KOZ). Selectable glass CTE does not imply natural matching to copper or freedom from cracking.

title.zh: 工艺选择：同任务再比较路线
title.en: Process selection: compare routes for the same task

records.text:
工艺选择：同任务再比较路线
Process selection: compare routes for the same task
功能、布线、电热表现、可靠性与合格件成本
Function, routing, electrothermal performance, reliability and good-unit cost
TSV 与 TGV
2.5D 3D 中介层 Interposer RDL 金属化 Metallization 可靠性 Reliability
核心判断与三种任务
Core conclusion and three tasks
先判断连接任务是否相同，再比较整段制造和封装表现。芯片内TSV连接硅芯片顶面与背面电路，要评估与芯片工艺兼容性，不能直接换成TGV。无源中介层连接芯片与下层接口时，可同层比较硅中介层TSV与玻璃中介层TGV。玻璃芯封装基板则评估TGV及双面增层布线，并与其他层TSV协同设计。三者均用代表性测试结构验证。
First confirm the same connection task, then compare full manufacturing/package performance. Chip TSV connects front/back silicon circuits and requires chip-process compatibility; it cannot simply become TGV. For a passive interposer connecting chips to lower interfaces, compare silicon-TSV and glass-TGV interposers at the same level. Glass-core package substrates require assessment of TGV and two-sided build-up routing coordinated with TSV at other levels. Verify all using representative test structures.
流程与关键约束
Flow and constraints
架构与工艺共同选型，确定通孔类型、所在层及验证方式。锁定层级与端点 → 明确孔/RDL需求 → 检查电热与可靠性预算 → 比较完整流程和供应能力 → 代表性测试结构验证。约束为孔距与布线能力、电热指标、可靠性要求和每个合格件总成本。
Architecture and process jointly choose via type, hierarchy and verification. Fix hierarchy/endpoints → define via/RDL needs → check electrothermal/reliability budgets → compare complete flows/supply capability → test representative structures. Constraints are pitch/routing capability, electrothermal metrics, reliability and total cost per good unit.
耦合风险、反馈与边界
Coupled risks, feedback and boundaries
大尺寸或面板加工的潜在效率收益要计入搬运、翘曲、缺陷和设备投入；只看材料单价会低估开路、裂纹和组装损失。在目标频段、负载和封装条件下比较导通、损耗、温变与可靠性，结合实际合格件成本决策。选择决定供应链和封装接口；不预设TGV全面替代TSV，也不脱离具体设计给出成本或性能排名。
Potential large-format/panel efficiency must include handling, warpage, defects and equipment investment; material price alone can undercount opens, cracks and assembly losses. Compare continuity, loss, temperature response and reliability at target frequency/load/package conditions, using actual good-unit cost. Selection determines supply chain and package interfaces. Do not assume complete TSV replacement by TGV or rank cost/performance independently of design.

title.zh: 一张图看懂BARC与TARC
title.en: BARC and TARC at a glance

records.text:
一张图看懂BARC与TARC
BARC and TARC at a glance
一个在胶下，一个在胶上，分别解决什么反射
Below and above resist: which reflections do they address?
BARC 与 TARC
FEOL BEOL 抗反射 ARC 光刻 Lithography 图形转移 Pattern transfer
01 上下位置
01 Position
BARC在胶下，TARC在胶上，职责不只是位置不同。膜堆从上至下为TARC、光刻胶Photoresist、BARC、衬底/下方膜堆Substrate；TARC调节胶上界面反射，BARC控制胶下界面反射。
BARC lies below resist and TARC above it; their roles differ beyond location. Top-to-bottom stack: TARC, photoresist, BARC, substrate/lower stack. TARC tunes top-interface reflection and BARC controls reflection below the resist.
02 光学机理
02 Optical mechanism
通过吸收与相位干涉降低有效反射。入射光与多界面反射光相消叠加；无ARC时胶内站立波强，使用ARC后减弱。
Absorption and phase interference reduce effective reflection. Incident and multiple reflected waves combine destructively; standing waves are strong without ARC and weaker with it.
03 材料与堆栈
03 Materials and stacks
材料须匹配光学、界面和后续工艺。原图列有机BARC：吸收能力强、工艺窗口宽、与下层匹配好；无机ARC：热稳定性好、耐刻蚀性强、适合高端节点；水溶性TARC或Topcoat：改善胶面光学、易于显影去除、低残留风险。
Materials must match optics, interfaces and downstream processing. The source lists organic BARC as strongly absorbing, broad-window and compatible with lower layers; inorganic ARC as thermally stable, etch-resistant and suitable for advanced nodes; water-soluble TARC/topcoat as improving top-surface optics, readily removed during development and having low residue risk.
04 BARC窗口
04 BARC window
既要压反射，也要稳定打开和转移图形。BARC涂布/固化 → 涂布光刻胶 → 曝光显影 → BARC Open → 图形转移。
Suppress reflection while enabling stable opening and pattern transfer. BARC coat/cure → resist coat → expose/develop → BARC open → pattern transfer.
05 TARC窗口
05 TARC window
胶面光学改善不能换来显影和表面缺陷。涂布光刻胶 → 涂布TARC → 曝光 → 显影/漂洗去除TARC → 检查。可能缺陷：干燥不均形成水印、TARC残留影响图形、退润湿形成针孔/裸区。
Optical improvement must not introduce development/surface defects. Coat resist → coat TARC → expose → develop/rinse to remove TARC → inspect. Risks include watermarks from uneven drying, pattern-affecting TARC residue and dewetting pinholes/bare areas.
06 显影与刻蚀
06 Development and etching
TARC多在显影侧去除，再进入刻蚀/清洗等后续步骤；BARC显影后仍常需额外打开（BARC Open/刻蚀），再图形转移。具体去除方式依配方。
TARC is often removed around development before etching/cleaning. BARC commonly requires a separate post-development open/etch before transfer. Actual removal depends on formulation.
07 异常诊断
07 Diagnosis
CD摆动查光学反射、ARC匹配与工艺稳定性；站立波查反射过强、膜厚不当、材料吸收不足；残留查去除不完全、材料相容性与工艺窗口窄；水印/表面缺陷查表面能不匹配、干燥不均和涂膜缺陷。
For CD swing, inspect reflection, ARC matching and process stability. For standing waves, inspect excessive reflection, thickness and insufficient absorption. For residues, inspect removal, compatibility and narrow windows. For watermarks/surface defects, inspect surface energy, drying and coating.
08 工艺选择
08 Process selection
胶下反射主导时优先BARC；胶上界面主导时优先TARC；两者显著时用BARC+TARC；收益不足或工艺负担大时可不使用额外ARC。
Prefer BARC for dominant lower-stack reflection, TARC for dominant upper-interface effects, both when both matter, or no additional ARC when benefit is insufficient or process burden too high.

title.zh: 上下位置：BARC与TARC不是简单翻面
title.en: Position: BARC and TARC are not simple mirror images

records.text:
上下位置：BARC与TARC不是简单翻面
Position: BARC and TARC are not simple mirror images
Topcoat / Photoresist / Underlayer / Substrate
Topcoat / Photoresist / Underlayer / Substrate
BARC 与 TARC
FEOL BEOL 抗反射 ARC 光刻 Lithography 图形转移 Pattern transfer
核心结论与膜堆
Core conclusion and stack
BARC主要处理胶下膜堆反射，TARC主要调节胶上表面光学边界。膜堆由TARC（胶上涂层）、PR光刻胶、BARC（胶下ARC）、衬底构成。TARC抑制胶上反射、改善入射光场、减少驻波与不均；BARC抑制下方反射、吸收反射光、改善成像对比度。两者不等同。
BARC mainly addresses lower-stack reflection; TARC adjusts the optical boundary at the resist top. The stack is topcoat/TARC, PR, BARC and substrate. TARC suppresses top reflection, improves the incident field and reduces standing waves/nonuniformity. BARC suppresses lower reflection, absorbs reflected light and improves contrast. They are not equivalent.
分析流程：从膜堆到功能
Analysis: stack to function
1. 读膜堆：识别材料、确认顺序、结合工艺信息。2. 找PR：确定位置、胶层完整性和图形层。3. 辨下方ARC：确认BARC、材料类型和连续性。4. 辨上方涂层：确认TARC/Topcoat、材料特征与表面状态。5. 判断附加功能：是否兼顾抗反射、防粘/抗污、浸没/多层支持，并评估必要性。
1. Read the stack: materials, order and process context. 2. Locate PR: position, integrity and patterning layer. 3. Identify lower ARC: BARC presence, material and continuity. 4. Identify upper coating: TARC/topcoat, material and surface state. 5. Assess additional antireflective, anti-adhesion/contamination and immersion/multilayer functions and whether needed.
去除与图形转移：原图说明
Removal and transfer: source statements
原图写TARC“多数在显影前去除（随光刻胶去除）”，也可能按材料工艺单独去除；BARC通常显影后由后续刻蚀去除。原图称二者一般不直接参与图形转移，TARC主要提供光学/表面功能，BARC主要提供吸收/抗反射功能。具体去除方式依材料及后续工艺。
The source states that TARC is “mostly removed before development (with the photoresist)” or separately depending on material/process, and BARC is generally removed by etching after development. It describes both as generally not directly participating in transfer, with TARC serving optical/surface functions and BARC absorption/antireflection. Removal depends on material and subsequent processing.
耦合权衡与误区
Trade-offs and misconceptions
抑制反射、减少驻波、提升对比度，可改善成像；但多涂布步骤、界面和缺陷风险增加。需权衡图形质量与复杂度、性能与缺陷，并匹配整体工艺。“只有位置不同”不对；所有Topcoat并非都是TARC，还可能防粘或抗污；有ARC仍要优化PR膜厚，因为其影响成像、分辨率和窗口。
Reflection/standing-wave suppression and contrast improve imaging, but added coatings/interfaces increase complexity and defect risk. Balance quality, complexity and defects across the full process. “Only position differs” is incorrect. Not every topcoat is TARC; it may serve other surface functions. PR thickness still needs co-optimization because it affects imaging, resolution and process window.
量测证据与下游影响
Evidence and downstream effects
SEM/TEM截面确认层次、连续性并对比材料；椭偏等膜厚测量和反射率光谱比较无ARC、仅BARC、TARC+BARC；CD/形貌量测侧壁和底部，验证成像改善。下游依次为曝光窗口（更宽、更稳定）、显影（改善侧壁、减少残留缺陷）、BARC Open（稳定打开、避免残留）、刻蚀（完整转移、侧壁更垂直、减少微缺陷）。
SEM/TEM verifies layers/continuity and compares materials. Thickness metrology such as ellipsometry and reflectance spectra compare no ARC, BARC only and TARC+BARC. CD/morphology measurements inspect sidewalls/bottoms. Downstream stages are exposure (wider, more stable window), development (better sidewalls, less residue), BARC opening (stable open, no residual obstruction) and etching (complete transfer, more vertical walls, fewer microdefects).
具体功能随曝光波长、光刻胶体系及是否浸没而变化，须结合应用、材料与流程评估。
Functions vary with exposure wavelength, resist system and immersion use; evaluate the specific application, material system and flow.
原图“显影前去除（随光刻胶去除）”与本组总览所写“显影/漂洗去除TARC”不一致，已原意转录；实际顺序需按具体配方流程确认。原图对BARC不参与图形转移的概括，也不能取代具体堆栈整合要求。
The source’s “before development (with photoresist)” differs from this chapter’s overview stating TARC removal during development/rinse. It is transcribed faithfully; actual order requires the formulation-specific flow. Its general statement about BARC not participating in transfer does not replace stack-specific integration requirements.

paragraphs.zh: BARC主要处理胶下膜堆反射，TARC主要调节胶上表面光学边界。膜堆由TARC（胶上涂层）、PR光刻胶、BARC（胶下ARC）、衬底构成。TARC抑制胶上反射、改善入射光场、减少驻波与不均；BARC抑制下方反射、吸收反射光、改善成像对比度。两者不等同。
paragraphs.en: BARC mainly addresses lower-stack reflection; TARC adjusts the optical boundary at the resist top. The stack is topcoat/TARC, PR, BARC and substrate. TARC suppresses top reflection, improves the incident field and reduces standing waves/nonuniformity. BARC suppresses lower reflection, absorbs reflected light and improves contrast. They are not equivalent.

paragraphs.zh: 1. 读膜堆：识别材料、确认顺序、结合工艺信息。2. 找PR：确定位置、胶层完整性和图形层。3. 辨下方ARC：确认BARC、材料类型和连续性。4. 辨上方涂层：确认TARC/Topcoat、材料特征与表面状态。5. 判断附加功能：是否兼顾抗反射、防粘/抗污、浸没/多层支持，并评估必要性。
paragraphs.en: 1. Read the stack: materials, order and process context. 2. Locate PR: position, integrity and patterning layer. 3. Identify lower ARC: BARC presence, material and continuity. 4. Identify upper coating: TARC/topcoat, material and surface state. 5. Assess additional antireflective, anti-adhesion/contamination and immersion/multilayer functions and whether needed.

paragraphs.zh: 原图写TARC“多数在显影前去除（随光刻胶去除）”，也可能按材料工艺单独去除；BARC通常显影后由后续刻蚀去除。原图称二者一般不直接参与图形转移，TARC主要提供光学/表面功能，BARC主要提供吸收/抗反射功能。具体去除方式依材料及后续工艺。
paragraphs.en: The source states that TARC is “mostly removed before development (with the photoresist)” or separately depending on material/process, and BARC is generally removed by etching after development. It describes both as generally not directly participating in transfer, with TARC serving optical/surface functions and BARC absorption/antireflection. Removal depends on material and subsequent processing.

paragraphs.zh: 抑制反射、减少驻波、提升对比度，可改善成像；但多涂布步骤、界面和缺陷风险增加。需权衡图形质量与复杂度、性能与缺陷，并匹配整体工艺。“只有位置不同”不对；所有Topcoat并非都是TARC，还可能防粘或抗污；有ARC仍要优化PR膜厚，因为其影响成像、分辨率和窗口。
paragraphs.en: Reflection/standing-wave suppression and contrast improve imaging, but added coatings/interfaces increase complexity and defect risk. Balance quality, complexity and defects across the full process. “Only position differs” is incorrect. Not every topcoat is TARC; it may serve other surface functions. PR thickness still needs co-optimization because it affects imaging, resolution and process window.

paragraphs.zh: SEM/TEM截面确认层次、连续性并对比材料；椭偏等膜厚测量和反射率光谱比较无ARC、仅BARC、TARC+BARC；CD/形貌量测侧壁和底部，验证成像改善。下游依次为曝光窗口（更宽、更稳定）、显影（改善侧壁、减少残留缺陷）、BARC Open（稳定打开、避免残留）、刻蚀（完整转移、侧壁更垂直、减少微缺陷）。
paragraphs.en: SEM/TEM verifies layers/continuity and compares materials. Thickness metrology such as ellipsometry and reflectance spectra compare no ARC, BARC only and TARC+BARC. CD/morphology measurements inspect sidewalls/bottoms. Downstream stages are exposure (wider, more stable window), development (better sidewalls, less residue), BARC opening (stable open, no residual obstruction) and etching (complete transfer, more vertical walls, fewer microdefects).

paragraphs.zh: 具体功能随曝光波长、光刻胶体系及是否浸没而变化，须结合应用、材料与流程评估。
paragraphs.en: Functions vary with exposure wavelength, resist system and immersion use; evaluate the specific application, material system and flow.

title.en: Optical mechanism: reflection is not simply all absorbed

records.text:
光学机理：不是把反射光全部吸掉
Optical mechanism: reflection is not simply all absorbed
复折射率 / 膜厚 / 相位差 / 站立波
Complex refractive index / thickness / phase / standing waves
BARC 与 TARC
FEOL BEOL 抗反射 ARC 光刻 Lithography 图形转移 Pattern transfer
核心结论与对比
Core conclusion and comparison
ARC依靠吸收与多界面干涉共同降低进入光刻胶的有效反射。无ARC图：界面反射强（相位接近），PR内光强形成明显站立波；BARC图：吸收衰减反射，反射幅度降低，站立波减弱；TARC图：多界面干涉加吸收，进一步抑制反射，光强波动更弱。
ARC combines absorption with multi-interface interference to reduce effective reflection into resist. The no-ARC panel shows strong interface reflection and pronounced standing waves. BARC attenuates reflected amplitude and weakens standing waves. The TARC panel depicts interference plus absorption further reducing reflection and intensity variation.
多层传播过程
Propagation in a multilayer stack
光入射 → 多界面反射 → 相位与振幅改变（不同界面具有相位差、幅度差）→ 在PR内反射光与入射光叠加形成光强分布 → ARC吸收/相消降低有效反射。
Incident light → reflections at multiple interfaces → altered phase/amplitude → reflected and incident fields superpose inside PR → absorption/destructive interference reduces effective reflection.
四个关键控制
Four key controls
复折射率(n,k)：n决定相位，k决定吸收，影响界面反射强度和吸收能力。膜厚d：决定干涉相位差及相消条件。曝光波长λ：影响干涉条件，与材料光学常数耦合。入射角θ与偏振Pol.：改变界面反射强度，影响干涉和吸收。
Complex index (n,k): n controls phase and k absorption, affecting reflection and attenuation. Thickness d sets interference phase and cancellation conditions. Wavelength λ affects interference and couples to optical constants. Incidence angle θ and polarization affect interface reflectivity, interference and absorption.
权衡与典型异常
Trade-offs and anomalies
吸收太弱则反射强、站立波难抑制；吸收太强或膜厚设计不当可降低有效曝光、缩窄窗口、影响分辨率。站立波表现为PR光强周期变化与CD起伏；原图Swing Curve面板以焦点为横轴，描述焦深曲线波动与窗口变窄；侧壁波纹/刻蚀后粗糙可源于光强不均；CD随下层膜厚周期变化说明干涉显著。
Weak absorption leaves strong reflection/standing waves; excessive absorption or unsuitable thickness can reduce effective exposure, narrow the window and affect resolution. Standing waves cause periodic PR intensity and CD variation. The source’s “Swing Curve” panel uses focus as the horizontal axis and describes focus-curve fluctuation/window narrowing. Sidewall ripples/etched roughness may arise from nonuniform intensity; periodic CD versus lower-layer thickness indicates strong interference.
量测与边界
Metrology and boundaries
椭偏测n、k及膜厚均匀性；反射率光谱验证反射抑制；FEM光学仿真模拟光场并优化材料厚度；CD—膜厚实验关联确认周期趋势。吸收型或多层ARC不能套唯一通用四分之一波长公式，须综合光学常数、膜厚、入射条件和多界面干涉，用仿真与实验优化。
Use ellipsometry for n, k, thickness/uniformity; reflectance spectra for suppression; FEM optical simulation for fields and material/thickness optimization; and experimental CD–thickness correlation for periodic trends. Absorbing/multilayer ARC cannot use one universal quarter-wave formula; jointly optimize optical constants, thickness, incidence and interference through simulation/experiment.
原图TARC面板将“TARC（顶部ARC）”箭头指向PR下方，和本组定义不一致；本页保留图示作为参考并标出此疑点。Swing Curve面板标题与“焦点”横轴也存在术语对应疑点，未静默改图。

title.zh: 材料与堆栈：光学匹配还要服从界面
title.en: Materials and stacks: optical matching must also satisfy interfaces

records.text:
材料与堆栈：光学匹配还要服从界面
Materials and stacks: optical matching must also satisfy interfaces
有机BARC / 无机ARC / 水溶性TARC / Topcoat
Organic BARC / inorganic ARC / water-soluble TARC / topcoat
BARC 与 TARC
FEOL BEOL 抗反射 ARC 光刻 Lithography 图形转移 Pattern transfer
核心结论与完整膜堆
Core conclusion and full stack
材料不只满足n/k，还须兼容光刻胶、衬底、显影和刻蚀。堆栈为Topcoat/TARC、光刻胶、BARC/ARC及衬底。Topcoat/TARC优化胶面光学、保护PR并减少污染缺陷；有机BARC旋涂友好、平坦化强、适应复杂地形；无机ARC/SiARC除光学匹配还可兼顾硬掩膜，支持后续图形转移。
Materials must satisfy n/k and remain compatible with resist, substrate, development and etching. The stack is topcoat/TARC, PR, BARC/ARC and substrate. Topcoat/TARC improves surface optics, protects PR and reduces contamination/defects. Organic BARC supports spin coating, planarization and complex topography. Inorganic ARC/SiARC may also serve as a hard mask for transfer.
三类材料路线
Three material routes
有机BARC（旋涂型）：成熟旋涂、强平坦化、PR兼容、适应复杂地形，典型为有机聚合物。原图把无机ARC/SiARC列为沉积型：光学匹配宽、可兼硬掩膜、耐刻蚀强、适合先进节点，典型列SiARC、氮化物等。水溶性TARC/Topcoat：优化胶面光学、减少表面缺陷、水溶易去除、保护PR，典型为水溶性聚合物。并非所有Topcoat都是TARC：前者偏表面保护，后者有明确抗反射光学功能。
Organic spin-on BARC offers mature coating, planarization, PR compatibility and topography coverage, typically using organic polymers. The source groups inorganic ARC/SiARC as deposited materials with broad optical matching, hard-mask capability, etch resistance and advanced-node use, listing SiARC and nitrides. Water-soluble TARC/topcoat offers surface optics, defect reduction, easy aqueous removal and PR protection, using water-soluble polymers. Not every topcoat is TARC; topcoat may emphasize protection, while TARC has an explicit optical antireflective function.
完整工艺流程
Full process flow
衬底准备（清洁、活化）→ BARC涂布/沉积（成膜、平坦化）→ 固化/烘烤（去溶剂、稳定膜性）→ 涂PR（旋涂、软烘、均匀胶膜）→ 涂TARC/Topcoat（光学优化、保护）→ 曝光及后续显影、刻蚀/去除TARC、图形转移。
Prepare substrate (clean/activate) → coat/deposit BARC (film/planarization) → cure/bake (remove solvent, stabilize film) → spin/soft-bake uniform PR → coat TARC/topcoat (optics/protection) → exposure, development, etching/TARC removal and transfer.
四个控制与权衡
Four controls and trade-offs
附着力：界面牢固、防脱层、耐后续应力。溶剂正交性：上层溶剂不破坏下层，各层工艺互不影响。界面互混：减少扩散、保持清晰、避免影响光学和PR性质。吸收及膜厚均匀性：有效压反射、均匀覆盖大面积/复杂地形。有机体系易旋涂、平坦化好、窗口相对宽、适于细结构，但耐刻蚀相对有限；无机体系兼顾抗反射和硬掩膜、耐刻蚀强，但整合开口更复杂，界面匹配要求高。
Adhesion: strong interfaces, no delamination, resistance to later stress. Solvent orthogonality: upper solvents must not damage lower layers. Intermixing: limit diffusion and retain clear interfaces/PR properties. Absorption/thickness uniformity: suppress reflection with uniform coverage. Organic systems coat/planarize readily with relatively broad windows but limited etch resistance; inorganic systems can combine ARC/hard-mask functions and strong etch resistance but require more complex integration/opening and interface matching.
风险、量测与边界
Risks, measurements and boundaries
互混降低光学性能或改变PR；脱层/起泡破坏图形；涂布不均影响CD与良率；边缘堆积使开口困难；溶剂或界面导致PR性能异常。量测膜厚/n及均匀性、FTIR/化学结构与材料匹配、接触角/表面能与亲疏水、缺陷分布/颗粒沾污、截面界面清晰度与膜层完整性。部分SiARC/Underlayer兼具抗反射与转移功能，ARC不只是光学层。
Intermixing degrades optics or changes PR; delamination/bubbles disrupt patterns; nonuniform coating affects CD/yield; edge buildup complicates opening; solvents/interfaces alter PR. Measure thickness/n/uniformity, FTIR/chemistry and compatibility, contact angle/surface energy/wetting, defect/particle/contamination maps, and cross-sectional clarity/integrity. Some SiARC/underlayers combine antireflection and transfer functions; ARC is not only an optical layer.
“无机ARC/SiARC（沉积型）”为原图分组，不能视为所有SiARC均采用同一种成膜方法；选材仍以实际材料规格和工艺为准。
“Inorganic ARC/SiARC (deposited)” is the source grouping and should not imply that all SiARC uses one deposition method; use the actual material specification and process.

Process flow
1. 衬底清洁：去有机物与颗粒。2. BARC涂布/沉积并固化：形成连续均匀膜。3. PR涂布/烘烤：均匀胶膜。4. 曝光显影：形成PR图形，在BARC上方形成开口。5. BARC Open：选择性去除开口处BARC。6. 下层图形转移，去PR与残留。图例为紫色PR、橙色BARC、灰色衬底/下层。
1. Clean substrate of organics/particles. 2. Coat/deposit and cure continuous uniform BARC. 3. Coat/bake uniform PR. 4. Expose/develop PR openings above BARC. 5. Four key controls

Match thickness and n/k to suppress reflection/standing waves while maintaining etch/develop windows. Trade-offs and defects

Map thickness; compare reflectance with/without BARC; measure CD/sidewalls by CD-SEM; inspect open cross-sections and residue/particle scans. Budget PR for BARC etch consumption. Opening can produce positive/negative CD bias and affect lower-layer etch uniformity and fidelity.

Material boundaries

The source lists conventional organic BARC opening by oxygen-plasma ashing, sensitivity to developer solvents and the need to control cure/selectivity. Inorganic ARC such as SiON commonly uses fluorine-based plasma, is chemically stable and not easily removed by development, with selectivity depending on underlying materials. Hard-mask underlayers may need dedicated opening etches and integrated selectivity/transfer planning.
耐刻蚀性与残留风险的关系不能仅凭高低概括：原图的优势描述已保留，但也同时明确记载其开口更难及PR/CD损耗的权衡。
Etch resistance alone does not determine residue risk. The source’s benefit claim is retained together with its stated harder-opening and PR/CD-loss trade-offs.

title.zh: TARC窗口：胶面改善不能换来显影缺陷
title.en: TARC window: surface improvement must not cause development defects

records.text:
TARC窗口：胶面改善不能换来显影缺陷
TARC window: surface improvement must not cause development defects
表面反射 / 涂布均匀性 / 可去除性 / 浸没兼容
Surface reflection / coating uniformity / removability / immersion compatibility
BARC 与 TARC
FEOL BEOL 抗反射 ARC 光刻 Lithography 图形转移 Pattern transfer
核心结论与流程
Core conclusion and flow
TARC改善胶上光学边界，同时须保持PR化学与显影稳定。PR涂布/烘烤获得均匀膜并去溶剂 → TARC涂布/稳定 → 曝光 → 显影/漂洗去TARC（依配方）→ 干燥去残液、稳定形貌 → 外观、CD、缺陷检查。原图显影步骤写“去除未曝光PR，同时去除TARC”。
TARC improves the top optical boundary while preserving PR chemistry and development stability. Coat/bake uniform PR and remove solvent → coat/stabilize TARC → expose → develop/rinse away TARC as formulated → dry residual liquid/stabilize morphology → appearance, CD and defect inspection. The source’s development step says “remove unexposed PR while removing TARC.”
四个关键控制
Four key controls
膜厚与折射率n决定反射控制且须兼顾窗口；全片涂布均匀性影响曝光及CD，需看边缘/中心；可去除/溶解行为须与PR同步或按工艺选择性去除，避免残留、聚集及再沉积；PR/TARC界面须避免互溶/反应，保持清晰与适中附着，关注图形边缘。
Thickness/index n determine reflection control and the window. Coating uniformity affects exposure/CD, including center-edge differences. Removal/dissolution must be synchronized with PR or selectively processed without residue, aggregation or redeposition. Avoid PR/TARC intermixing/reaction; maintain clear interfaces, suitable adhesion and controlled pattern-edge interfaces.
耦合权衡与缺陷
Trade-offs and defects
增强保护/阻隔可降反射、减有害物质扩散、稳胶面、改善边缘，却可能难去除、残留、改变化学及显影速率、引入CD偏差。水印来自干燥不均；TARC残留来自去除不全，可在底部/侧壁；退润湿形成岛/针孔；涂布斑来自厚度不均；PR溶胀来自化学影响；CD漂移来自光学或化学变化。
Stronger protection/barriers can reduce reflection and harmful diffusion, stabilize surfaces and improve edges, but may complicate removal, leave residue, change chemistry/develop rate and shift CD. Watermarks arise from uneven drying; incomplete removal leaves bottom/sidewall TARC; dewetting creates islands/pinholes; thickness variation creates coating marks; chemical effects swell PR; optical/chemical changes shift CD.
量测与下游
Metrology and downstream
检查全片膜厚/反射率、表面和图形缺陷及残留颗粒；适用时测接触角/浸出物，评估表面能；CDU/FEM对比CD均匀性与窗口。目标是显影洁净无残留少聚集、无新缺陷；胶侧壁垂直、线形完整、表面平整低粗糙；转移前掩膜稳定，减少刻蚀异常。
Check wafer thickness/reflectance, surface/pattern defects and residual particles. Where applicable, measure contact angle/leachables and surface energy. Use CDU/FEM to compare CD uniformity/window. Targets are clean development with little aggregation/no added defects, vertical intact resist lines with smooth surfaces, and stable masks before transfer with fewer etch anomalies.
边界说明
Boundaries
常规TARC主要降胶面反射，兼顾化学稳定和可去除性；浸没Topcoat用于浸没光刻介质界面控制，并非所有TARC都是浸没Topcoat。Topcoat也可提供保护、润湿或界面控制，不只抗反射。
Conventional TARC mainly reduces top reflection while maintaining chemical stability/removability. Immersion topcoats control the immersion-medium interface; not all TARC is immersion topcoat. Topcoats can provide protection, wetting and interface control beyond antireflection.
“去除未曝光PR”为原图原话，适用性取决于光刻胶正/负性，不能作为所有PR显影的通用描述。本页未将其静默改为“已曝光”。
“Remove unexposed PR” is the source wording; applicability depends on positive/negative resist tone and is not a universal development description. It has not been silently changed to “exposed.”

title.zh: 显影与刻蚀：两种ARC的退出方式不同
title.en: Development and etching: the two ARCs leave differently

records.text:
显影与刻蚀：两种ARC的退出方式不同
Development and etching: the two ARCs leave differently
显影去除 / BARC Open / 胶厚预算 / CD Bias
Development removal / BARC opening / resist budget / CD bias
BARC 与 TARC
FEOL BEOL 抗反射 ARC 光刻 Lithography 图形转移 Pattern transfer
核心结论与两条路线
Core conclusion and two routes
TARC常在显影/漂洗中退出；BARC常在显影后保留、需刻蚀打开，依配方膜系而定。TARC路线：PR+TARC曝光 → 显影/漂洗溶解去除TARC → PR图形完成 → 后续刻蚀、离子注入或薄膜沉积。BARC路线：PR+BARC曝光显影 → BARC仍在底部 → BARC Open选择性刻蚀 → 后续图形转移。
TARC commonly leaves during development/rinse; BARC often remains and requires etch opening, depending on formulation/stack. TARC: expose PR+TARC → dissolve/remove during development/rinse → completed PR pattern → etch, implant or deposit. BARC: expose/develop PR+BARC → BARC remains at the bottom → selective BARC open → subsequent transfer.
四个关键控制
Four key controls
TARC去除性：充分去除、与显影液/PR/下层兼容，避免残留水印。BARC选择比：对PR高选择比、均匀且各向异性、减少CD偏差及下层损伤。剩余PR厚度：留足转移预算，兼顾分辨率，防过耗塌陷。残留/侧壁：查ARC/聚合物、侧壁角度，防回缩或不完全刻蚀，保证清洁与后续窗口。
TARC removability: complete removal, developer/PR/lower-layer compatibility, no residue/watermarks. BARC selectivity: high selectivity to PR, uniform anisotropic etch, limited CD shift/lower-layer damage. Remaining PR: enough transfer budget while preserving resolution and preventing collapse. Residue/sidewalls: check ARC/polymer and wall angles to avoid recession/incomplete etch and ensure cleanliness.
耦合权衡与风险
Trade-offs and risks
弱BARC刻蚀可能残留、影响转移、增加缺陷；更强Open可降BARC残留和Scum，但增加PR损耗、可能使CD增长或损伤下层。典型风险为TARC残留/水印干斑、BARC底部Scum、过刻/欠刻CD Bias、PR顶部损耗导致厚度不足或塌陷、侧壁回缩/角度变化降低保真度。
Weak BARC etching can leave residue and harm transfer; stronger opening reduces residue/scum but consumes PR, may enlarge CD or damage lower layers. Risks include TARC residue/watermarks, bottom BARC scum, over-/under-etch CD bias, top PR loss and collapse, and sidewall recession/angle changes that reduce fidelity.
量测、下游与边界
Metrology, downstream and boundaries
显影后缺陷图检查残留水印、密度和稳定性；CD-SEM测尺寸、偏差及侧壁；XSEM查多层结构、ARC残留及整体形貌；残膜检查定位表面异常并验证清洁；刻蚀前后CD对比量化变化和可接受性。下游关注掩膜强度/完整性和耐刻蚀、CD一致性/均匀性及器件良率规则、侧壁保持及偏差累积。可显影BARC、特殊Topcoat和多层胶的退出方式不同，按材料、光学和流程选择验证。
Post-develop maps inspect residue/watermarks, density and stability. CD-SEM measures dimensions/bias/walls; XSEM examines stacks, ARC residue and overall shape. Residual-film inspection locates anomalies; before/after CD quantifies acceptable changes. Downstream concerns are mask integrity/etch endurance, CD uniformity/device/yield rules and sidewall fidelity/cumulative bias. Developable BARC, special topcoats and multilayer resists may use different removal routes requiring material/optical/process-specific validation.

The source’s TARC-route label points to a blue layer below PR, inconsistent with top ARC. The original remains available; the text follows the chapter’s definition and does not treat the misplaced drawing as structural fact.

Residual-film inspection locates anomalies; before/after CD quantifies acceptable changes. Downstream concerns are mask integrity/etch endurance, CD uniformity/device/yield rules and sidewall fidelity/cumulative bias. Developable BARC, special topcoats and multilayer resists may use different removal routes requiring material/optical/process-specific validation.

title.zh: 异常诊断：先判断是光学还是材料问题
title.en: Diagnosis: distinguish optical from material problems

records.text:
异常诊断：先判断是光学还是材料问题
Diagnosis: distinguish optical from material problems
CD摆动 / 站立波 / 残留 / 水印
CD swing / standing waves / residue / watermarks
BARC 与 TARC
FEOL BEOL 抗反射 ARC 光刻 Lithography 图形转移 Pattern transfer
核心结论与五种线索
Core conclusion and five clues
相似CD与缺陷症状可能来自光学设计、膜厚均匀性、界面化学或去除工艺。四类候选根因：光学反射/干涉/窗口；膜厚涂布不均/波动；界面去除/漂洗/浸没；显影或BARC Open去除不足。
Similar CD/defect symptoms can come from optical design, thickness uniformity, interface chemistry or removal. Four candidate categories are optical reflection/interference/window, coating/thickness variation, interface removal/rinse/immersion, and incomplete development/BARC opening.
1. 侧壁周期波纹：周期与光波相关，厚胶/高反射结构常见，指向站立波/反射。2. CD随下层膜厚周期变化：峰谷关联干涉，指向光学窗口/下层厚度。3. 中心—边缘CD差：径向或环形，常关联涂布/烘烤/均匀性。4. 水印/圆斑：多见TARC去除/漂洗，可关联浸没界面或干燥。5. 底部残留：槽底PR/BARC未清除而侧壁正常，提示显影或Open不足。
1. Periodic sidewall ripples: wave-related, common in thick/high-reflection stacks, suggesting standing waves/reflection. 2. Periodic CD versus underlayer thickness: interference peaks/valleys, suggesting optics/thickness. 3. Center-edge CD differences: radial/ring patterns linked to coat/bake/uniformity. 4. Watermarks/circular spots: often TARC removal/rinse, immersion or drying. 5. Bottom PR/BARC residue with otherwise normal walls: insufficient development/opening.
系统化诊断流程
Systematic diagnosis
看分布：全片/边缘/局部及周期方向。做膜厚—CD关联：结合椭偏/反射率判断相关性和周期。看PR截面侧壁：找周期波纹、区分光学与材料主导。对照多层光学模型：仿真反射/干涉，与实测对比。检查显影后残留和BARC Open充分性。最后关联PR/BARC材料、涂布烘烤窗口、去除漂洗、设备状态和均匀性，综合验证根因。
Map whole-wafer/edge/local distribution and periodicity/direction. Correlate thickness/CD using ellipsometry/reflectance. Inspect PR sidewall cross-sections for periodic ripples and optical/material dominance. Compare multilayer reflection/interference simulations with measurements. Check development residue and opening completeness. Finally relate PR/BARC materials, coat/bake windows, rinse/removal, equipment state and uniformity to validate root cause.
控制与量测反馈
Controls and measurements
优化膜厚/涂布/烘烤均匀性，准确评估n/k并匹配层次，减少烘烤溶剂残留，优化显影窗口与去除一致性，提升刻蚀均匀性、减少叠加偏差。椭偏/反射率给膜厚及n/k；CD-SEM/XSEM查CD、侧壁、残留缺陷；FEM光场仿真验证反射干涉；缺陷图确认类型分布和周期；模型/实测CD—膜厚对比验证根因合理性。
Optimize thickness/coating/bake uniformity, assess n/k and stack matching, reduce solvent residue, improve development/removal consistency and etch uniformity. Ellipsometry/reflectance gives thickness/n/k; CD-SEM/XSEM checks CD, walls, residue and defects; FEM optical fields test interference; defect maps establish spatial/periodic signatures; measured versus modeled CD–thickness trends test root-cause validity.
避免误判与边界
Avoiding misdiagnosis and boundaries
不要仅凭一张截面锁定根因。相似形貌可由光学、材料或工艺多因素引起，须结合分布、量测和模型。先用空间分布、周期性和工艺前后对比建立证据链，再综合光学常数、膜厚、条件及多界面干涉逐步定位。
Do not identify a root cause from one cross-section alone. Similar shapes can arise from optical, material or process factors. Build evidence from spatial distribution, periodicity and before/after process comparisons, then integrate optical constants, thickness, conditions and interference using measurements and models.

title.zh: 工艺选择：先找主要反射界面
title.en: Process selection: identify the dominant reflecting interface

records.text:
工艺选择：先找主要反射界面
Process selection: identify the dominant reflecting interface
衬底反射 / 胶面反射 / 浸没保护 / 图形转移
Substrate reflection / resist-surface reflection / immersion protection / transfer
BARC 与 TARC
FEOL BEOL 抗反射 ARC 光刻 Lithography 图形转移 Pattern transfer
核心结论与四路决策
Core conclusion and four-way choice
按主反射来源与集成负担选BARC、TARC、组合或不加ARC。下层复杂膜堆反射强而胶上较弱：优先BARC。胶上表面/浸没界面关键、胶下较弱：优先TARC/Topcoat。上下反射均强、相互干涉显著：组合BARC+TARC。现有膜堆已有效控制反射或新增集成负担大：可不加额外ARC。图中分别标入射光、上下界面反射、浸没液、PR及衬底/下层膜堆。
Choose BARC, TARC, both or no added ARC by dominant reflection and integration burden. Strong lower-stack reflection: prefer BARC. Dominant upper/immersion interface: prefer TARC/topcoat. Strong upper/lower reflection and interference: combine them. Already-controlled reflection or excessive added burden: no extra ARC. Diagrams label incident light, upper/lower reflection, immersion liquid, PR and lower stack/substrate.
工艺选择流程
Selection flow
明确波长与光学条件（i-line、DUV、193i、EUV，干式/浸没，NA与偏振）→ 建立含所有功能层的完整膜堆和窗口 → 分析各界面反射及主干涉源 → 扫描ARC参数并仿真容差 → 检查涂布均匀、显影窗口、刻蚀选择比及后续兼容 → FEM与缺陷验证光学、成像和风险。
Define wavelength/conditions (i-line, DUV, 193i, EUV; dry/immersion; NA/polarization) → build full functional stack/window → analyze reflections/dominant interference → scan ARC parameters/tolerance → check coating, development, selectivity and compatibility → verify optics, imaging and defects using FEM/testing.
四项控制与耦合权衡
Four controls and trade-offs
控制n/k与膜厚窗口、衬底多层反射、PR厚度预算和显影/刻蚀兼容。PR厚度须满足分辨率与成像、匹配Topcoat并避免过厚问题；去除干净、选择比合适、不增新缺陷。新增ARC可扩大窗口与容差，也增加成本、缺陷机会、复杂度和后续耦合。
Control n/k/thickness window, multilayer substrate reflection, PR thickness budget and develop/etch compatibility. PR thickness must satisfy resolution/imaging, match topcoat and avoid excessive-thickness issues. Ensure clean removal, appropriate selectivity and no new defects. Added ARC may improve window/tolerance but adds cost, defects, complexity and downstream coupling.
风险与验证
Risks and verification
主反射界面误判导致方案错、抑制差；仿真实测不符可能是材料参数或工艺波动；BARC难开口导致残留、CD偏差；TARC难去除导致残留污染。用反射率比较方案，膜厚/n/k确认稳定性，FEM分析成像/强度，CDU评估CD与窗口，缺陷图查表面图形，刻蚀后截面验证转移、残留与损伤。
Wrong dominant-interface identification gives poor ARC choice/suppression. Simulation mismatch may reflect material parameters or process variation. Hard BARC opening causes residue/CD shift; hard TARC removal causes contamination. Compare reflectance, verify thickness/n/k stability, analyze FEM imaging/intensity, assess CDU/window, map defects and inspect post-etch transfer/residue/damage.
曝光体系边界：原图概括
Exposure-system boundaries: source overview
原图概括：i-line反射相对易控，通常以BARC为主，可不加TARC；DUV反射更强，常需BARC或TARC并优化胶膜；193i关注浸没界面，常用TARC/Topcoat并组合BARC；多层胶干涉复杂，需考虑各层匹配；EUV反射机理不同，不沿用传统ARC方案，依赖吸收与图形设计。具体策略随波长、胶结构和集成要求变化。
The source summarizes i-line as relatively easier to control, often BARC-led with optional TARC; DUV as stronger-reflection and needing ARC/resist optimization; 193i as immersion-interface-sensitive with topcoat/TARC and BARC combinations; multilayer resist as requiring complex layer matching; and EUV as a different reflection regime that does not simply reuse traditional ARC approaches. Actual strategy depends on wavelength, resist structure and integration.
底部各曝光体系为原图定性概括，并非对所有材料与节点的通用配方；EUV等体系不能直接套用前面的可见/DUV示意堆栈。
The bottom exposure-system comparisons are qualitative source summaries, not universal recipes for all materials/nodes. EUV and other systems must not directly inherit the earlier visible/DUV schematic stacks.

title.zh: 一张图看懂能带、导带与价带
title.en: Energy, conduction and valence bands at a glance

records.text:
一张图看懂能带、导带与价带
Energy, conduction and valence bands at a glance
从原子能级、费米能级到掺杂与能带弯曲
From atomic/Fermi levels to doping and band bending
能带物理
掺杂 Doping 费米能级 Fermi level 接触 Contact 载流子 Carrier
01 能带怎么来
01 How bands arise
原子靠近后，离散能级分裂并汇聚成允许能带。能量E向上；孤立原子离散能级 → 多原子靠近、能级分裂 → 大量能级聚集形成导带、价带，两者之间为带隙E_g。
As atoms approach, discrete levels split and collect into allowed bands. Energy E increases upward. Isolated atomic levels → splitting as atoms approach → many closely spaced levels form conduction/valence bands separated by E_g.
02 导带与价带
02 Conduction and valence bands
两类允许能带承担不同成键与输运角色。导带E_c为电子输运能带，价带E_v为原子成键能带；橙色表示负电电子，空心圆表示正电空穴。
The two allowed bands serve different bonding/transport roles. E_c marks the conduction band for electrons; E_v marks the valence band associated with bonding. Orange denotes negatively charged electrons; hollow circles denote positive holes.
03 带隙与费米能级
03 Band gap and Fermi level
带隙描述允许态间隔，费米能级E_F描述占据倾向。费米–狄拉克分布：f(E)=1/[1+exp((E−E_F)/kT)]；图中E=E_F处电子占据概率为0.5。
The gap describes separation between allowed states; E_F describes occupation tendency. Fermi–Dirac distribution: f(E)=1/[1+exp((E−E_F)/kT)]; occupation is 0.5 at E=E_F.
04 电子与空穴
04 Electrons and holes
电子受光/热激发至导带（图示能量≥E_g），价带留下空穴；图示电子传导、空穴传导以及复合发光/放热。
Optical/thermal excitation moves electrons to the conduction band (energy ≥E_g illustrated), leaving holes. The diagram shows electron/hole conduction and recombination releasing light/heat.
05 三类材料
05 Three material classes
原图以金属价带/导带重叠、无带隙，半导体带隙较小可热激发载流子，绝缘体带隙很大、载流子极少作示意；三者差异不只带隙大小。
The source schematically shows metal bands overlapping with no gap, a smaller semiconductor gap allowing thermal carriers, and a large insulator gap with very few carriers. Their differences are not only gap size.
06 掺杂改能带
06 Doping and bands
本征半导体E_F在带隙中部附近，电子和空穴浓度相等。n型施主能级E_D近导带，E_F上移、电子为多数；p型受主能级E_A近价带，E_F下移、空穴为多数。
Intrinsic E_F lies near midgap with equal electron/hole concentrations. N-type donor E_D lies near the conduction band, raising E_F with electrons majority. P-type acceptor E_A lies near valence, lowering E_F with holes majority.
07 能带为什么弯
07 Why bands bend
空间电势变化使E_c、E_v随位置移动。热平衡PN结图标p型、耗尽层、n型，E_c/E_v跨结弯曲而E_F平坦。
Spatial potential shifts E_c/E_v with position. The equilibrium PN junction shows p-region, depletion and n-region; band edges bend while E_F remains flat.
08 工艺选择
08 Process choice
按器件目标选材料、掺杂和界面势垒。原图举宽带隙用于高耐压/高温、中等带隙用于通用器件、窄带隙用于高速/光电；n型提高电子浓度，p型提高空穴浓度，本征/轻掺杂平衡特性；选择合适金属—半导体势垒高度φ_B以降低接触电阻、改善性能。
Select material, doping and interface barrier for device goals. Source examples associate wide gaps with high voltage/temperature, medium gaps with general devices and narrow gaps with high speed/optoelectronics. N/P doping raises electron/hole concentration; intrinsic/light doping balances properties. Choose a suitable metal–semiconductor barrier φ_B to reduce contact resistance and improve performance.

paragraphs.zh: 原子靠近后，离散能级分裂并汇聚成允许能带。能量E向上；孤立原子离散能级 → 多原子靠近、能级分裂 → 大量能级聚集形成导带、价带，两者之间为带隙E_g。
paragraphs.en: As atoms approach, discrete levels split and collect into allowed bands. Energy E increases upward. Isolated atomic levels → splitting as atoms approach → many closely spaced levels form conduction/valence bands separated by E_g.

paragraphs.zh: 两类允许能带承担不同成键与输运角色。导带E_c为电子输运能带，价带E_v为原子成键能带；橙色表示负电电子，空心圆表示正电空穴。
paragraphs.en: The two allowed bands serve different bonding/transport roles. E_c marks the conduction band for electrons; E_v marks the valence band associated with bonding. Orange denotes negatively charged electrons; hollow circles denote positive holes.

paragraphs.zh: 带隙描述允许态间隔，费米能级E_F描述占据倾向。费米–狄拉克分布：f(E)=1/[1+exp((E−E_F)/kT)]；图中E=E_F处电子占据概率为0.5。
paragraphs.en: The gap describes separation between allowed states; E_F describes occupation tendency. Fermi–Dirac distribution: f(E)=1/[1+exp((E−E_F)/kT)]; occupation is 0.5 at E=E_F.

paragraphs.zh: 电子受光/热激发至导带（图示能量≥E_g），价带留下空穴；图示电子传导、空穴传导以及复合发光/放热。
paragraphs.en: Optical/thermal excitation moves electrons to the conduction band (energy ≥E_g illustrated), leaving holes. The diagram shows electron/hole conduction and recombination releasing light/heat.

paragraphs.zh: 原图以金属价带/导带重叠、无带隙，半导体带隙较小可热激发载流子，绝缘体带隙很大、载流子极少作示意；三者差异不只带隙大小。
paragraphs.en: The source schematically shows metal bands overlapping with no gap, a smaller semiconductor gap allowing thermal carriers, and a large insulator gap with very few carriers. Their differences are not only gap size.

paragraphs.zh: 本征半导体E_F在带隙中部附近，电子和空穴浓度相等。n型施主能级E_D近导带，E_F上移、电子为多数；p型受主能级E_A近价带，E_F下移、空穴为多数。
paragraphs.en: Intrinsic E_F lies near midgap with equal electron/hole concentrations. N-type donor E_D lies near the conduction band, raising E_F with electrons majority. P-type acceptor E_A lies near valence, lowering E_F with holes majority.

paragraphs.zh: 空间电势变化使E_c、E_v随位置移动。热平衡PN结图标p型、耗尽层、n型，E_c/E_v跨结弯曲而E_F平坦。
paragraphs.en: Spatial potential shifts E_c/E_v with position. The equilibrium PN junction shows p-region, depletion and n-region; band edges bend while E_F remains flat.

title.zh: 能带怎么来：晶体把离散能级展开成带
title.en: How bands arise: a crystal spreads discrete levels into bands

records.text:
能带怎么来：晶体把离散能级展开成带
How bands arise: a crystal spreads discrete levels into bands
原子轨道 / 能级分裂 / 周期势场 / 允许态
Atomic orbitals / level splitting / periodic potential / allowed states
能带物理
掺杂 Doping 费米能级 Fermi level 接触 Contact 载流子 Carrier
核心结论与形成过程
Core conclusion and formation
能带不是电子运行轨道，而是晶体中大量允许量子态的能量分布。孤立原子有分立能级（图示n=1、2、3）；两个原子靠近，每个能级分裂；轨道重叠，N个原子形成密集能级；形成晶体能带，分为价带、禁带、导带。图标E_c、E_v和带隙E_g。
Bands are not electron trajectories; they are the energy distribution of many allowed quantum states in a crystal. Isolated atoms have discrete levels (n=1,2,3 shown); approaching atoms split levels; overlapping orbitals in N atoms produce dense levels that form valence/conduction bands separated by a forbidden gap. Labels are E_c, E_v and E_g.
形成机理与关键因素
Mechanism and factors
推理链：孤立原子离散能级 → 原子靠近、相互作用增强 → 轨道/波函数重叠 → 原图以泡利不相容描述每个能级分裂成N个 → 密集能级在宏观尺度呈连续能带。原子种类决定轨道能级与化学性质；晶体结构决定周期势场对称性；原子间距越小通常耦合越强；轨道耦合强度决定分裂大小。
Reasoning chain: discrete atomic levels → stronger interactions as atoms approach → orbital/wavefunction overlap → the source describes N-fold splitting through Pauli exclusion → dense levels appear as continuous bands macroscopically. Atomic species sets orbital energies/chemistry; crystal structure sets periodic-potential symmetry; shorter spacing generally increases coupling; coupling strength sets splitting.
常见误区与验证
Misconceptions and verification
能带不是轨道，电子在晶体中以波的形式运动；晶体能级并非凭空连续，而来自大量能级分裂聚集；缺陷和应变会引入局域态或改变带边。DFT等能带计算给出带隙、有效质量；ARPES直接量测动量空间能量关系；光学吸收边对应价带到导带跃迁，可确定带隙。
Bands are not orbits; electrons propagate as waves. Crystal energies do not become continuous arbitrarily but derive from many split, closely spaced levels. Defects/strain introduce localized states or shift edges. Band calculations such as DFT provide gaps/effective masses; ARPES measures energy versus momentum; optical absorption edges correspond to valence-to-conduction transitions and indicate the gap.
下游意义与边界
Implications and boundaries
带隙E_g影响导电类型与光学性质；有效质量m*影响迁移率和输运；载流子输运影响速度与功耗；材料选择按能带结构匹配需求（金属、半导体、绝缘体）。真实材料并非完全规则：缺陷、杂质、应变、温度、低维量子限域都会改变带边、带隙或引入局域态。不同材料和k空间方向的能带不同，不能用单一模型覆盖全部。
E_g affects conduction classification and optical properties; effective mass m* affects mobility/transport; transport affects speed/power; choose metal, semiconductor or insulator bands for the application. Real materials are not perfectly periodic: defects, impurities, strain, temperature and low-dimensional confinement can shift edges/gaps or introduce localized states. Bands vary by material and k-space direction; one model cannot describe all cases.
“泡利不相容导致能级分裂”为原图的教学简化表述；本页同时保留其原子间相互作用与轨道耦合的前提。
“Pauli exclusion causes level splitting” is the source’s pedagogical simplification; the preceding interaction and orbital-coupling context is retained.
